Vou corrigir seus erros e fazer atividades com você para tornar o aprendizado de inglês muito interessante para você. Vá em frente e reserve esta lição, pois estou pronto para conhecê-lo. teacher_info.about_teacher:

teacher_info.teaching_style:
My lesson styles incorporate both auditory and visual aid.
1. Auditory obviously is our voice, the best tool to communicate.
2. For visual aid, I will use document to note down your mistakes and give you structure in your speaking.  

We'll use Zoom or Tencent meeting to share screen. For those who have difficulty memorizing words, we'll create narratives and make flashcards to test your memory retention.

I look forward to meeting you online~

course_info.trial_description:
Hi I'm Chris, and I specialize in transforming how professionals communicate in English.
Your current level in English isn't your limit; it's simply your starting point. Over the last 9 years and 10,000+ hours of teaching, I've helped executives, academics, and global citizens move beyond language barriers to speak with clarity, confidence, and cultural intelligence.

What to Expect in Our 30-Minute Trial Lesson:
- A Strategy Session, Not Just a Chat:​ We'll start by identifying your specific goals—whether it's leading international meetings, delivering powerful presentations, or navigating social situations abroad.
- A Personalized Plan:​ I'll assess your current strengths and the one or two key areas that will make the biggest immediate difference for you.
- Experience My Method:​ I'll briefly introduce the tailored, structured approach I use, which blends real-world scenarios, immediate feedback, and practical frameworks you can use right away.
- All Your Questions Answered:​ We'll discuss how my courses are designed to fit your schedule and how we can build a roadmap to your success.

This trial is a dedicated space for us to map out your journey. It's an investment of $22 USD​ to determine if my expert guidance is the right fit to help you achieve tangible results.

I recommend we use Tencent Meeting for the best interactive experience.

I look forward to meeting you and discussing how we can achieve your English communication goals together.

Click "Book Now" to secure your spot.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
My journey as an English teacher began when overseas clients asked me to help them with pronunciation. They told me they’d studied English for years, but had never spoken it with a native speaker.
What started as a casual meetup at a Starbucks café quickly evolved into a weekly class, and that’s where my teaching style was developed.
I specialise in helping students sound natural and confident—like a native speaker. My lessons focus on pronunciation, rhythm, and intonation, using proven techniques to train both the tongue and the brain to overcome common challenges.
If you're ready to improve your spoken English and speak with clarity, let's get started.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My lessons typically begin with a relaxed conversation about what’s happening in your life.
From there, we might look at a short news article or a real-life text to read aloud and discuss. We’ll focus on how it’s presented, written, and spoken—building vocabulary, comprehension, and confidence. 
Next, we’ll work on pronunciation: identifying useful phrases or word groups and practising how they flow naturally in connected speech.
A typical session lasts between 40 to 60 minutes, depending on the depth of our conversation.
I can also give you simple exercises or speaking tasks to practise between lessons—designed to help you sound more natural and fluent over time.

My metholody is based on the 100 most common questions and answers in the language being learned, emphasizing the most useful vocabulary, word combinations, texts, and practical conversations.

Lessons with me will include friendly and natural conversation, with space for you to ask any questions that may come up. We will also focus on learning grammar if interested. While I tend to prioritize speaking ability, lessons are always tailored to the needs and goals of the student.

teacher_info.intro:
Hello English learners! I’m Christopher, a TEFL-certified native English teacher from Canada with a clear North American accent. My 12-year career in film and theater taught me the power of storytelling—now, I help students master IELTS, interviews, confident conversation as well as proofreading and editing your CVs, essays, research, etc.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
I was educated in Toronto, Canada, hold a diploma in Business studies, as well as a Bachelor degree in Sociology.  I am TEFL certified and have experience teaching English online as well as in in class.  I have also taught drum lessons and trained workers in the film industry.

I think you will find that I am very patient and encourage discussion.  Making mistakes is how you learn and I find reward in helping students overcome their obstacles.  I myself am currently learning Spanish and understand the difficulties.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
Whether it's for IELTS, mock interviews or general practice - you can enjoy customized lessons designed with you in mind.  Our classes will use whatever mix of Communicative Language Teaching (CLT) approaches that are the most useful to the student.

I offer guarantee results with regular attendance and practice.  Lessons are designed for success and to have a bit of fun getting there.

teaching_experience.description: Started at a buxiban, and later employed as a homeroom teacher at a English school in Taichung, Taiwan.

course_info.trial_description: I offer a 30 minute introductory session at a reduced rate.  This gives you a chance to meet me have a discussion and assess what is most suitable for your needs.   You have the opportunity to talk about subjects of interest while giving me guidance on what you are looking to gain from future lessons as well as learning tools and methods.

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar, Writing, Reading and Review - A comprehensive class
pro_course_detail.description:
For English speakers of all levels.  This class is more for students seeking a structured class with regular feedback.  Also suitable for business and IELTS practice.  

Reading/listening and writing exercises, vocabulary, pronunciation techniques and verb tenses - no problem.  During our sessions, Detailed correction sheets with grammar and pronunciation feedback and new vocabulary are taken each class and submitted along with personalized assignments for practice.

pro_course_detail.title: Proofreading and Editing Services
pro_course_detail.description:
I will help you proofread and write text documents.   I currently edit TOEFL AND IELTS essays using correction tags for immigration purposes.

I will guide and correct any problems with grammar, spelling, or punctuation as well as general editing to keep the material as clear and concise as possible.  Often it is not necessary to do this in-class.  I use the suggestion mode on Google documents to show and explain edits.

pro_course_detail.title: Discussion and debate - Topic of your choice.... No limits
pro_course_detail.description:
For English speakers of  all levels.  After some assessment, the class is designed to challenge your skills through engaging discussions on various topics.  Express yourself... that's what these sessions are all about.

Tools such as videos, news stories will likely be used as well as homework assignment.

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate IELTS Training (B1, B2)
pro_course_detail.description: This course will help prepare the student for General and/or Academic IELTS.  Folllowing a curriculum of the 4 topics:  Foundations and Listening Mastery, Reading Strategies and Vocabulary Expansion, Writing Structure and Coherence, and finally, Speaking Fluency and Mock tests.  All prepared using material from updated IELTS sources.

teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching style depends on you—the student. In general, I follow the “I Do, We Do, You Do” model, along with the 70:30 principle, which encourages more student talk time compared to teacher talk time.

As a flexible and dynamic educator, I adapt my approach based on each learner’s needs and level. I incorporate a range of teaching styles including the Demonstrator, Facilitator, Delegator, and Hybrid styles, depending on what best supports the student’s learning.

I strongly believe that effective teaching comes from the ability to adjust and respond to the student, ensuring that every class is meaningful, engaging, and focused on progress.

course_info.trial_description:
Welcome to your 30-minute trial lesson. In this session, we will begin with a short introduction to get to know each other and understand your background, interests, and reasons for learning English or Filipino (Tagalog).

Next, I will assess your current speaking level through natural conversation and a short guided activity. This helps me identify your strengths, areas for improvement, and overall proficiency without pressure or formal testing.

You will also experience my teaching style through a brief demo lesson, where I provide clear explanations, gentle corrections, and practical language tips. I will then introduce the materials and methods I use to support different learning goals and levels.

Finally, we will discuss your objectives and outline a personalized learning plan for future lessons, whether your focus is conversation, grammar, confidence-building, or specific purposes.

By the end of the trial lesson, you will have a clear understanding of your level, my teaching approach, and how we can work together to achieve your language goals.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Kids: Fun, Games & Active Learning (Age: 4-6)
pro_course_detail.description:
Is your child ready to start their English journey with a smile? In this high-energy, interactive session, I focus on making English feel natural, exciting, and pressure-free. Every lesson is adapted to your child’s unique interests—whether they love animals, space, or storytelling. We use games, visuals, and movement to build foundational vocabulary and the confidence to start speaking from day one.

Lesson Structure:

25 Minutes: Active, high-engagement 1-on-1 teaching.

5 Minutes: Teacher's dedicated time to create and send your child’s Customized Written Feedback Report, detailing what we learned and how they can practice before the next class.

What to Expect:

Thematic Learning: We explore the language through exciting "Monthly Themes" relevant to a child’s world.

Engagement First: No boring lectures! We use toys, props, and digital games to keep your child focused and motivated.

A Positive Environment: I prioritize building a strong bond with my students, ensuring they feel safe and encouraged to try new words.

pro_course_detail.title: Filipino/Tagalog Conversation (Free Talk)
pro_course_detail.description: Tara na sa one-on-one na Filipino/Tagalog lesson! Sa session na ito, pag-uusapan natin ang iba't ibang paksa base sa iyong interes—mula sa kasalukuyang kaganapan, personal na karanasan, hanggang sa kultura. Mag-practice ng pagsasalita sa isang relaxed at supportive na paraan, palawakin ang bokabularyo, at pahusayin ang iyong fluency sa Filipino/Tagalog. Sa pagtatapos, mas magiging kumpiyansa ka sa araw-araw na usapan at mas maiintindihan ang ganda ng wika at kultura. Simulan na natin ang kwentuhan!

pro_course_detail.title: Professional & Academic English (ESP): Career, Exams & Success
pro_course_detail.description:
Lesson Description
Ready to achieve your specific professional goals? This session is designed for highly motivated adults and students who need English for a Specific Purpose (ESP). We move beyond "General English" to focus on the practical, real-world language you need to succeed in your career or studies.

What to Expect in Our Sessions:

Custom Needs Analysis: In our first meeting, we identify exactly why you need English (e.g., a promotion, an exam, or a relocation) and focus only on the skills and vocabulary that matter to you.

Authentic Industry Materials: We use real-world resources relevant to your field—such as your own company reports, presentation slides, resumes, or medical/legal manuals—to ensure every minute is practical.

Goal-Driven Results (No "Filler" Activities):

Business ESP: Rehearsing for meetings, practicing negotiations, and mock interviews.

Academic ESP (EAP): Intensive preparation for IELTS, TOEFL, and Cambridge exams (A2–C1).

Industry Specifics: Specialized vocabulary and functional language for Medicine, Aviation, Hospitality, Law, IT, and more.

We spend 55 minutes in active, high-level coaching. I dedicate the final 5 minutes to writing your Customized Executive Report. This includes a list of industry-specific vocabulary we covered, pronunciation tips, and "Pro-Style" grammar corrections you can use immediately.

Target Audience & Levels
Ages: 15–99 (High School, University, and Working Professionals).

Levels: Intermediate to Advanced (B1–C2).

Requirement: For the best results, please send any materials you wish to work on (resumes, slides, or articles) at least 24 hours before our lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: TAGALOG/FILIPINO BEGINNER LESSON
pro_course_detail.description:
Maligayang pagdating sa iyong leksyon sa Tagalog para sa mga absolute beginner! Sa sesyong ito na pasimula, sisimulan natin ang pundasyon para sa iyong paglalakbay sa pag-aaral ng Tagalog, simula sa wala. Kasama ang isa't isa, tatalakayin natin ang mga batayang bahagi ng wika ng Tagalog, kasama ang mahahalagang bokabularyo, pagbati, at simpleng mga parirala. Sa pamamagitan ng mga interaktibong gawain at gabay na praktis, sisimulan mong makilala ang mga tunog at istraktura ng Tagalog, na magtataas ng iyong kumpiyansa sa mga pundamental na bahagi ng wika. Kung ikaw ay bago pa lamang sa Tagalog o may kaunting kaalaman na sa wika, itong leksyong ito ay binuo upang magbigay sa iyo ng suportadong at nakaaaliw na kapaligiran upang simulan ang iyong paglalakbay sa pag-aaral. Sa pagtatapos ng sesyon na ito, magkakaroon ka na ng iyong unang hakbang patungo sa pagiging bihasa sa Tagalog at magiging handa ka na na magpatuloy sa iyong pag-aaral ng wika. Tayo na at simulan ang nakaka-engganyong paglalakbay na ito sa pag-aaral ng wika!




Welcome to your Tagalog absolute beginner lesson! In this introductory session, we'll lay the foundation for your journey into learning Tagalog, starting from scratch. Together, we'll dive into the basics of the Tagalog language, covering essential vocabulary, greetings, and simple phrases. Through interactive activities and guided practice, you'll begin to familiarize yourself with the sounds and structure of Tagalog, building a solid understanding of the language fundamentals. Whether you're brand new to Tagalog or have some familiarity with the language, this lesson is designed to provide you with a supportive and encouraging environment to start your learning journey. By the end of this session, you'll have taken your first steps towards mastering Tagalog and be equipped with the confidence to continue your language-learning adventure. Let's get started on this exciting linguistic exploration together!

pro_course_detail.title: Casual English Conversation (Ages 8–17 & Adults | All Levels)
pro_course_detail.description:
Looking for a friendly, stress-free way to practice your English? This session is designed for learners of all ages (8–17 and adults) and all levels who want to move beyond textbooks and start having real conversations.

Whether you are a beginner, intermediate, or advanced student, we will talk about topics that actually interest you. My goal is to create a "Safe Space" where you can make mistakes, learn new words naturally, and build the confidence to speak English in any situation.

What to Expect:

Flexible Topics: We can talk about your day, your hobbies, travel, movies, or current trends—no rigid curriculum or boring lectures!

Natural Corrections: I provide gentle, real-time feedback on your pronunciation and grammar to help you sound more like a native speaker.

A Professional Partner: With over 6 years of teaching experience, I know how to keep the conversation flowing for any level.

The "Real English" Feedback Loop:

Active Chat: We spend the majority of our time focused on speaking and listening.

Customized Feedback Report (Final 5 Mins): I dedicate the final 5 minutes of our session to writing a personalized report for you. This includes a list of new vocabulary we used, pronunciation tips, and "Real English" phrases to help you level up before our next chat.

pro_course_detail.title: General English (GE) A1 – B2 Real English: Confidence, Fluency & Everyday Conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
Lesson Description
Bridge the gap between "textbook English" and the way adults actually communicate. This lesson is designed for motivated adult learners who want to feel natural and confident in the real world—whether for travel, relocating abroad, or building international friendships.

What We Build Together:

Life-Focused Subjects: Master the language of adulthood—from discussing family and relationships to navigating shopping, travel, and sharing complex stories from your past.

Practical Grammar: We focus on grammar on a "need-to-know" basis. You learn the structures required for real-life functions, ensuring you can use what you learn immediately in conversation.

Social & Cultural Etiquette: Understand the "unspoken rules" of English-speaking cultures, including social manners, small talk with strangers, and local customs.

Contemporary Topics: We use current events, trending news, and real-life scenarios to keep every lesson intellectually engaging and relevant to your world.

The Lesson Structure (55+5):

Active Coaching (55 Mins): High-level speaking practice, interactive role-plays (such as navigating a social event or resolving a travel issue), and real-time corrections.

Personalized Progress Report (Final 5 Mins): I dedicate the final 5 minutes to finalizing your Customized Feedback Report, featuring new vocabulary, pronunciation tips, and key takeaways from our session.

Target Audience & Levels
Ages: Adults (18+).

Levels: Beginner to Upper-Intermediate (A1–B2).

Vibe: Mature, supportive, and 100% focused on Connection over Perfection.

pro_course_detail.title: Pronunciation & Delivery Workshop (Provided Materials) (All Ages)
pro_course_detail.description:
Lesson Description
Refine Your Voice and Speak with Clarity. This session is a dedicated space for students to master the mechanics of spoken English. If you have specific articles, scripts, or academic materials you are currently studying, this is the perfect environment to practice them with expert guidance.

This is a student-led practice session. You provide the reading materials, and I provide the professional ear to help you sound natural, confident, and clear.

What We Refine Together:

Phonetic Precision: Identifying and correcting specific "trouble sounds" and improving mouth positioning for challenging English words.

Natural Rhythm & Intonation: Mastering word stress and pausing so you sound like a natural speaker, not a robot.

Guided Oral Practice: A line-by-line review of your provided text, focusing on pacing, flow, and clear articulation.

Confidence in Delivery: Perfecting your reading so you feel prepared for school presentations, exams, or professional settings.

The Lesson Schedule:

Live Coaching & Practice (55 Mins): Our one-on-one time is focused entirely on active correction and drills using your chosen materials.

Session Documentation (Final 5 Mins): To maximize our time together, our live call concludes at the 55-minute mark. I utilize the final 5 minutes of the hour to finalize a customized written progress report for you, highlighting the specific sounds and words we refined during the session.

Target Audience & Levels
Ages: 7 to Adults.
Levels: A2 to C1 (Intermediate to Advanced).
Vibe: Technical, focused, and highly corrective.

pro_course_detail.title: The Skills Builder: General English for Kids & Teens (7–15) (A1-B1)
pro_course_detail.description:
Lesson Description
Building Confidence through Active Speaking. This is a structured General English course specifically designed for students aged 7 to 15 who are ready to move beyond basic English and start communicating naturally.

I provide a professional, academic foundation tailored to your child's current level. Whether they are a beginner (A1) or moving toward intermediate fluency (B1), I create a supportive environment that ensures steady progress in every session.

What We Build Together:

Dynamic Speaking & Fluency: We prioritize active talk-time. Students practice expressing their ideas, hobbies, and interests in full, natural sentences.

Structured Vocabulary & Grammar: Moving past "one-word" answers. I teach students how to use correct grammar and vocabulary to share detailed stories and opinions.

Comprehensive Skills: Strengthening the Reading, Writing, and Listening foundations needed for school success and real-world confidence.

Practical Application: We focus on the "why" behind the language, helping students take what they learn and use it correctly in real-time conversation.

The Lesson Schedule:

Live Video Session (55 Mins): This is our dedicated one-on-one time. We focus entirely on getting the student talking through interactive tasks and visual lessons.
Session Documentation (Final 5 Mins): To maximize our time together, our live call concludes at the 55-minute mark. I utilize the final 5 minutes of the hour to finalize a customized written progress report for you, detailing the key takeaways and "Speaking Wins" mastered during the session.

teacher_info.intro:
Salut,
Je suis Daphny, un Parisien à l’esprit cosmopolite - je pense qu’apprendre sur les autres, c’est un peu apprendre sur soi-même. 
Natif d’Haïti, c’est toutefois à Paris, Paname, la ville lumière, la cité de l’amour …, où j’ai grandi et acquis mon éducation.  

Hello, I’m Daphny—a Paris-raised native of the French Caribbean with a cosmopolitan outlook shaped by living between France and the United States for the past decade. I believe that learning about others is also a way to gain deeper insight into oneself. My open-minded approach to language and culture is rooted in my diverse background and international experiences. I am passionate about building connections through literature, art, information technology, manga, anime, and sports such as working out and biking. If you are interested in exploring language and culture from a universal perspective, I look forward to learning and growing together.

Ma méthodologie mélange une vision traditionnelle à une vision, que l’on pourrait qualifier de moderne ou d’atypique. Tout dépend de vous, de vos objectifs et de votre niveau de langue. On peut étudier un article, une chanson, un extrait de film, une vidéo…
Il ne faut pas se limiter.

My teaching style is open and fluid. I believe that some traditional methods are useful.
One should nevertheless not be prisoner of them. Some things work for some people and others don’t. I just adapt to the need of the student.

pro_course_detail.title: Road to Fluency / Vers l’Aisance (All levels, A1 to C2) - For Robin only - special prices !
pro_course_detail.description:
Lessons for beginners, intermediate and advanced learners/Cours pour les débutants et pour les élèves intermédiaires ou plus expérimentés.

While I’m a native French speaker, I consider myself a passionate student of the language.
Moreover, I have a valuable teaching experience.
I know what works. 
“Road to Fluency ” is a complete and well-balanced class (it’s the right recipe): conversation practice, grammar study, reading and listening activities while learning a rich and very diversified vocabulary.

Bien que le français soit ma langue maternelle, je m’efforce sans cesse d’élargir mes connaissances linguistes. En plus de cela, j’ai une solide expérience dans l’enseignement.
Pour ces raisons, je connais les méthodes qui fonctionnent, et celles qui fonctionnent moins.
« Vers l’Aisance » est un cours complet et équilibré : la pratique de l’expression orale, l’étude de la grammaire, différents exercices permettant le développement de l’écoute et de la lecture, l’acquisition d’un vocabulaire riche et varié.

If you are a beginner, we will focus on the basics of the French language. Learning those mechanisms makes the process more fluid. 
Apprentissage des bases de la langue françaises. Cela permet aux débutants de se familiariser au français.

Regarding intermediate and advanced learners, we are going to focus on complex sentences, texts, videos... The goal is to become spontaneous and self-confident.
Ces leçons sont également destinées aux élèves d’un niveau intermédiaire ou avancé, qui veulent apprendre à s’exprimer avec plus d’aisance et de spontanéité.

Lessons for intermediate learners/Cours pour les débutants et pour les élèves ayant un niveau intermédiaire.

While I’m a native French speaker, I consider myself a passionate student of the language.
Moreover, I have a valuable teaching experience.
I know what works. 
“Road to Fluency ” is a complete and well-balanced class (it’s the right recipe): conversation practice, grammar study, reading and listening activities while learning a rich and very diversified vocabulary.

Bien que le français soit ma langue maternelle, je m’efforce sans cesse d’élargir mes connaissances linguistes. En plus de cela, j’ai une solide expérience dans l’enseignement.
Pour ces raisons, je connais les méthodes qui fonctionnent, et celles qui fonctionnent moins.
« Vers l’Aisance » est un cours complet et équilibré : la pratique de l’expression orale, l’étude de la grammaire, différents exercices permettant le développement de l’écoute et de la lecture, l’acquisition d’un vocabulaire riche et varié.

 Dear intermediate learners, we are going to focus on these more sophisticated sentences, texts, watch videos that natives watch... The goal is to become more spontaneous and self-confident.
Ces leçons sont destinées aux élèves d’un niveau intermérmediare, qui veulent apprendre à s’exprimer avec plus d’aisance et de spontanéité.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
Two things set me apart: I’m frank and honest. As your teacher, I won’t tell you that learning a language is easy—it isn’t. We’ll face storms along the way. But I’ll be your second-in-command, guiding you and helping you chart the best course toward your destination. I’ll give you the tools to weather the roughest seas, lift you when you stumble, and help you stay the course until the light of your goal appears on the horizon.

My Grammar, Business, Hospitality English, and IELTS lessons follow a textbook-based path, enriched with real-life materials and lively debates. I adapt to your needs, keeping the journey flexible and engaging.

I completed my TEFL certification a few years ago and have been teaching English for over 15 years to students of all ages and levels. Teaching has been such a rewarding journey — I truly enjoy watching my students grow in confidence and feel proud as they master new language skills.

I also help you to prepare for whatever goals you are heading for, offering practical tips and strategies to help you feel more relaxed and confident throughout the process. My goal is to make learning enjoyable and effective, so you can achieve the best possible results.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I design and tailor each lesson to suit your personal goals and learning style. My classes often include open conversations and engaging topics to help you feel relaxed and get your English flowing naturally.

To keep learning fun and effective, I use a mix of quizzes, flashcards, books, and activity sheets — and sometimes assign light homework with feedback to help you review and improve.

We’ll also discuss your hobbies, interests, and real-life experiences to make every lesson meaningful and connected to your world. Whether you prefer a structured approach or casual conversation practice, I’ll make sure you feel comfortable, confident, and supported every step of the way.

teacher_info.intro:
Hello! I’m originally from London in the UK, which means I am a native British English speaker with a clear accent and pronunciation. 
Over the years, my passion for languages and travel has taken me to many different countries around the world, often in places where English is not the first language. This international experience has given me the opportunity to work with people from a wide range of backgrounds, ages, and English levels. 
As a result, I am very familiar with the unique challenges that come with learning and using English as a second language. I specialise in helping students develop practical, real-world communication skills—whether you’re preparing for a business meeting, working on a school project, or simply want to feel more confident having everyday conversations in English. 
My outgoing and friendly personality, combined with my patience and flexibility, means I can easily adapt my teaching style to suit your individual needs and learning pace. If you’re looking for a supportive tutor who makes learning enjoyable and effective, I would love
 to help you achieve your English language goals!

course_info.trial_description:
This is an opportunity for you to get to know me a little bit an hear how I speak,as well as to ask me any questions you may have.
It is also an opportunity for me to understand a little bit about what level you are at, what your expectations are and what areas you would like to focus on and see if we are a good fit for each other.
I look forward to meeting you.

pro_course_detail.title: British English reading practise - All levels
pro_course_detail.description:
The option here is that either you read something to me and I'll correct your pronunciation and intonation, or I'll read something and you can repeat so that you can hear how it sounds when spoken by a native speaker.
We can also hear the difference between a more 'correct' pronunciation and then more 'natural' or accented speech.
The texts we use can either be provided by yourself if you have a special interest or something you are working on, or I can provide texts to you.
Recording of the speech can also be done by yourselves, or I can possibly provide recordings for you to refer to and practise offline (this is by arrangement only and does not form part of the standard lesson).

This lesson would suit anyone who is just starting to read and speak English through to advanced level students.

pro_course_detail.title: British English conversational practise - All levels
pro_course_detail.description:
Here, we can talk about any topics you wish and focus on areas where you are having difficulty or have a special interest.
I can help students at any level here from absolute beginner through to advanced or near native speakers.
We can look at written texts, or focus on pronunciation and intonation or just general chit chat and vocabulary, as well as typical slang and words or phrases that have multiple meanings depending upon the situation.

pro_course_detail.title: British English freestyle:  Intermediate to Advanced
pro_course_detail.description:
This is an option for you to have a lesson completley tailored to your own requirements.

We can practise reading, writing, spelling, conversation you pronunciation and listening skills. We can focus on any topics you wish - the time is yours!

We can also use this time to review presentations or documents; draft correspondence; proofread documents or anything else you can think of.

This is catchall, for anything that isn't covered by my other lessons!! :-)

This is more suited to students who are anywhere from an Intermediate through to an advanced level and have specific areas that they would like to focus on.

pro_course_detail.title: British English - For younger learners
pro_course_detail.description:
This type of lesson is for younger students that require text books, other teaching material, interactive games, reading material at different levels as well as writing exercises and homework etc. This provides a more structured approach to learning.
Since teaching children online requires more preparation, variety and extra materials, this is reflected in the increase in price, over concersational lessons. I also only offer a maximum of 60 minutes for these sessions, as otherwise it would be too long for younger learners

pro_course_detail.title: British English - Structured lessons for Adults/Teens
pro_course_detail.description:
This type of lesson, is specifically for adults or teenagers, who want to practise more than just conversation or reading. 
I will provide teaching materials for these lessons, as well as homework and feedback as required. 
We will practise reading, comprehension and understanding, pronunciation, spelling, small-talk, interview preparation, as well as grammar topics and written exercises.
It is adviseable to have a laptop or device with a larger screen for this type of lesson as I will often have to share my screen.
These lessons are a little more expensive, as there is a lot more work before and after the session for me to do!
I only offer these classes for 60 or 90 minutes, as it is impractical to do anything useful in a shorter time!!
I look forward to seeing you in one of these classes.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
Bonjour !

Je m'appelle Aya, j'ai 25 ans et je suis votre prof de langues ! Je parle français, arabe et anglais, et je suis certifiée DELF & TOEFL.

En tant qu’enseignante, je veille toujours à comprendre les besoins spécifiques de chaque élève. C’est pourquoi j'opte pour une simple conversation pendant la première leçon, afin de définir ensemble vos objectifs. 

Au fil des cours, je prend soin à ce que mes élèves s’expriment un maximum, dans une ambiance détendue et amicale.Nous parlerons d’actualité, de tes centres d’intérêt, et de bien d’autres sujets qui te passionnent; pour t’aider à améliorer ta communication et tes compétences linguistiques, tout en prenant plaisir à apprendre !
teacher_info.teaching_style:
We will work on improving your speaking skills in a way that won’t feel like you’re in a stuffy classroom but rather simply enjoying a conversation with a friend. I will help you learn grammar, vocabulary and pronunciation to help you communicate as if you were a native speaker in no time! 
  From my own experience learning English, French and Modern Standard Arabic from scratch, sticking to classic classroom rules can get quite boring, and doesn’t really help you become comfortable speaking the language. Instead, we will incorporate grammar and theory during our talks. This gives you the opportunity to progress at your own pace in a fun learning environment.

course_info.trial_description:
Durant cette première leçon d'essai, j'aimerais qu'on aie une simple conversation durant laquelle nous allons ensemble définir nos objectifs. De cette façon je pourrais préparer un cursus adapté à tes besoins personnels. Pendant l'enseignement, j'essaie toujours de m'assurer que mes élèves s'expriment autant que possible dans la bonne ambiance!

During this trial lesson, i'd like for us to have a simple conversation in which we define your goals and needs as well as your subjects of interest. This enables me to prepare a customized lesson plan for you. My own experience has taught me that speaking a language is one of THE most effective ways to get better. So, I’m here to practice with you!

pro_course_detail.title: PHRASAL VERBS
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to GET INTO more natural expressions?

We are learning over +100 Phrasal Verbs from A-Z !! Learn other ways to express formal vocabulary by TEARING INTO these everyday phrasal verbs. 
This is a great way to expand your vocabulary, practice making grammatically correct sentences, thinking in English, and become familiar with English print (spelling, alphabet) and we will naturally base conversation around these phrasal verbs.
 
You will always be corrected on pronunciation and grammar. 
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ 

¿Quieres entrar en expresiones más naturales?
¡Estamos aprendiendo más de 100 verbos compuestos de la A a la Z! Aprenda otras formas de expresar vocabulario formal DESTROZANDO estos verbos compuestos cotidianos. 
Esta es una excelente manera de ampliar su vocabulario y praticar hablar.

좀 더 자연스러운 표현을 배우고 싶으신가요? 우리는 A-Z까지 +100개 이상의 구동사를 학습하고 있습니다!! 일상적인 구동사를 TEARING INTO하여 형식적인 어휘를 표현하는 다른 방법을 알아보세요. 이는 어휘력을 확장하고, 문법적으로 올바른 문장을 만드는 연습을 하고, 영어로 생각하고, 영문자체(철자, 알파벳)에 익숙해지는 좋은 방법입니다. 발음과 문법은 항상 교정해드립니다.

pro_course_detail.title: General English  (A0 - C1)
pro_course_detail.description:
You have decided to embark on this great adventure of learning English but you do not know where to start? In this course, we can start from zero. No previous knowledge needed or from where you are. We build on our way to learn English, step by step, so you can learn at your own pace!

This course will make you improve all aspects of English (listening, speaking, reading and writing). It comprises a complete range of immersive exercises carefully organised in order to optimise progression.

***This course includes teaching materials and a report sent after the course. In this report, you will find a reminder of grammar rules and exercises***

A1 - A2 : We will start with the alphabet, pronunciation & reading, numbers & phone numbers, expressions (such as greetings, introducing yourself etc), the basics of grammar, vocabulary, and simple conversational English.

B1 - B2 : After covering the basics in the beginner level, we move onto more in-depth grammar and vocabulary and more sophisticated conversations and written exercices. at this stage, you also start learning to balance three skills of language learning: focus, structure and intuition so you progressively learn to correct yourself, become your own teacher and gain autonomy.

B2 - C1 : We dive into the deep intricacies of English grammar, the subtleties of English vocabulary, including idiomatic expressions. at this level, oral and written expression can really find a true outlet.

Learning English through songs is a fun and effective way for kids to improve their language skills. Songs can help with vocabulary, pronunciation, rhythm, and even grammar. Here are some popular children's songs that can be used to teach English:

Alphabet Song

Focus: Learning the alphabet and letter sounds
Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star

Focus: Vocabulary related to stars and night, simple sentence structures
Old MacDonald Had a Farm

Focus: Animal names and sounds, farm vocabulary
Head, Shoulders, Knees, and Toes

Focus: Body parts, actions, and movement
If You're Happy and You Know It

Focus: Emotions, actions, and following instructions
The Wheels on the Bus

Focus: Transportation vocabulary, actions, and routines
Baa Baa Black Sheep

Focus: Colors, numbers, and polite expressions
Five Little Monkeys Jumping on the Bed

Focus: Numbers, actions, and simple sentences
Row, Row, Row Your Boat

Focus: Rhyming words, actions, and rhythm
London Bridge Is Falling Down

Focus: Vocabulary related to bridges and construction, actions
Itsy Bitsy Spider

Focus: Insects, weather vocabulary, and actions
Mary Had a Little Lamb

Focus: Animals, possessive adjectives, and simple past tense verbs
The Hokey Pokey

Focus: Body parts, directions (left, right), and actions
Baby Shark

Focus: Family members, actions, and sea animals
Happy Birthday

Focus: Celebrations, birthday vocabulary, and singing together

pro_course_detail.title: How to Learn English
pro_course_detail.description: What do we need  to do to reach a high level of proficiency when we are not in an English-speaking country? Please note that while this course is taught in English, this course is designed to help students develop strategies to learn English, not teach English itself. All students receive the following: custom-designed lessons, homework, and a language learning plan.  This course is recommended for intermediate to advanced level students ( B1-C2).

All students receive the following: custom-designed lessons, a grammar correction guide, homework, and a language learning plan. This course is recommended for intermediate-advanced level students ( B1-C2).

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate English Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
Imagine sitting down for a relaxed chat with someone who’s got your back when it comes to improving your English. That’s exactly what conversational practice with me is like. We’ll keep things casual but super effective - no boring textbooks, just real conversations that help you sound natural and confident.  

We’ll talk about things you find interesting - your hobbies, travel, work, or even the latest Netflix show you’re hooked on. 

Along the way, I’ll help you:  
- Use more natural phrases and expressions.  
- Get comfortable with tricky sounds and improve your pronunciation.  
- Build your confidence to handle any conversation, be it with colleagues, strangers, or friends.  

If you make mistakes, don’t stress. I’ll be gently correcting you throughout our conversations.

It’s more like chatting with a friend who happens to know exactly how to help you improve. Ready to level up your English and have some fun while you’re at it? Book a lesson. I’d love to meet you.

pro_course_detail.title: Advanced English Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
So, your English is already impressive, but you want to take it to the next level? That’s where I come in. My conversational practice sessions are designed to help advanced learners like you fine-tune the nuances of your English and really own the language.

Think of our lessons as a space to polish your skills and stretch your comfort zone. We’ll tackle thought-provoking topics, current events, cultural quirks, and dive into complex debates. Along the way, I’ll help you:

Refine your vocabulary to sound more natural and precise.
Nail the subtle differences that take you from “good” to “native-like.”
I’ll also point out any little habits or phrases that could be tweaked to make your speech sound polished and effortless. We’ll work together to keep your English sharp, dynamic, and authentically you.

It’s like a tailored workout for your language skills, but way more enjoyable (and no sweat involved). If you’re ready to master the art of confident, polished conversation, let’s get started!

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate English Pronunciation / Accent Coaching
pro_course_detail.description:
Want to sound clearer, more natural, and more confident when you speak English? You’re in the right place. My pronunciation and accent coaching sessions are all about helping you refine your speech in a fun, relaxed way.

I specialise in Modern RP - a smooth, natural British accent that sounds polished but not overly formal. We’ll work on the sounds and speech patterns that make the biggest difference, helping you fix common mistakes, smooth out tricky words, and speak in a way that feels effortless and confident.

Ready to level up your pronunciation? Book a lesson today.

pro_course_detail.title: Advanced English Pronunciation / Accent Coaching
pro_course_detail.description:
Your English is already great - now let’s make it flawless. My advanced pronunciation and accent coaching sessions are designed to fine-tune the details that take you from “really good” to truly polished.

I specialise in Modern RP, the smooth, natural-sounding British accent you hear from well-spoken native speakers. We’ll focus on the small but powerful changes that make your speech sound effortless - intonation, rhythm, word stress, and those last tricky sounds that still trip you up.

This isn’t just about getting the sounds right - it’s about speaking with confidence, clarity, and natural flow. You’ll get real-time feedback and plenty of practice to help you sound sharp in every conversation.

Let’s take your pronunciation to the next level. Book a session and let’s get started!

pro_course_detail.title: English Grammar (All Levels)
pro_course_detail.description:
Grammar doesn’t have to be boring or confusing. I’ll make it simple, clear, and actually useful. My lessons are designed to help you finally understand the rules and fix common mistakes.

We’ll focus on what you need most, from tricky tenses to prepositions that never seem to make sense. I’ll break everything down in a way that’s easy to follow, so you can start using correct grammar without overthinking every sentence.

No confusing jargon, no endless worksheets - just practical tips, real examples, and plenty of practice to help you feel confident in your English. Ready to master grammar without the headache? Let’s get started.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
Over the past few years, I've helped adult learners develop greater fluency and confidence in English. Many of my students already speak at an intermediate or advanced level, but they want to go further — to expand their vocabulary, refine their grammar, and improve pronunciation.
I believe these three elements — vocabulary, grammar, and pronunciation — form the foundation of any effective conversation class. My role as a teacher is to create a space where you can actively practice, make mistakes, and grow — all while keeping lessons engaging, relevant, and tailored to your needs.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I work exclusively with adults (18+), offering one-on-one lessons from pre-intermediate to advanced levels. This allows me the flexibility to choose materials and tools that best match each student’s goals and interests.
Before each lesson, I send a short article or video clip for you to review. During class, we discuss the content in your own words, helping you develop fluency and confidence in expressing complex ideas. Reading aloud gives us the chance to clarify vocabulary, explain grammar in context, and fine-tune pronunciation — gently and consistently.

These materials are always a springboard for real conversation, which is the core focus of my lessons.

Hello! My name is Naomi. I hold a bachelor's degree in literature and have been teaching English to different nationalities since 2007. I'm also TEFL/TESOL certified. 

Since my students’ English levels vary, I make sure that my lessons cater to their proficiency. I can teach grammar, vocabulary, news article reading and discussion, IELTS speaking and writing, pronunciation, and punctuation. If you’re aiming to practice speaking, I’m also capable of holding conversations about a variety of topics. pro_course_detail.description: In this course, the student is provided with a news article pre-lesson, which he will read during class. The discussion of the day's topic will follow, where the teacher will ask the student for his opinion or thoughts on the given topic. This will be a good opportunity for the student to showcase his speaking ability, not to mention his comprehension and ideas. As homework, the teacher will ask the student to use some vocabulary in his own sentences.

teacher_info.short_signature: Hi, I'm Nick, a professional British English teacher. 26 years experience. Customised lessons.
teacher_info.introduction: I'm a professional English teacher. I have a TEFL qualification and I have been teaching since 1999. My career started in Japan where I was a conversational English teacher. Within a year I had become the headmaster of a private English school serving 400 students. In 2014 I returned to the UK where I established an online presence. In 2016 I became an MBA consultant preparing students for the rigorous admissions test and interview. If you are preparing for the VIVA interview, I can help with that too. I'm a published author with many years experience proofreading. I'd be happy to have a look at your essays. I am very patient, and you can ask me all the questions you want, as many times as you want, until you understand very well. Let me know what you need and how I can help you, and I will be here for you. I will do my best to help you achieve your goals of becoming fluent in English. I'll introduce a bit more information about me. I am British and I live in Bournemouth. I'm a B1 speaker of Japanese. After a career in the civil service in England, I travelled to New Zealand where I resided for 8 years. I attended university there and studied computer science at Massey University. In New Zealand and then moved into the private sector where I gained experience in the technology market and the insurance industry. In 1998, I resumed my education and took a CELTA course to pursue a dream of teaching English in Japan. After gaining some experience in a school in Saitama, I opened my own schools in Chiba and Tokyo and became a registered Japanese corporation. I employed 10 Japanese support staff and several foreign teachers. I ran those schools for 16 years and taught hundreds of students of all ages and levels. In my downtime, I like to watch movies and read books. I’m the author of the book Fluency Secrets and I’m writing some new books on English language study. I love mountain biking, running and swimming. One day I would like to do a triathlon. See you online!

pro_course_detail.description:
Focus on interpersonal skills relevant to your field.
Gain the confidence you need and communicate effectively in the demanding healthcare career of your choice.

Medical English courses develop general English speaking and listening skills with 1-to-1 Medical English.

The 1-to-1 Medical English lessons will focus on your individual needs, taking into account your specific line of work.

Medical English courses are suitable for doctors, nurses, dentists, pharmacists, students of medicine and other professionals working in the medical sector.

CEFR Course level B2 – C1 
What to expect:
・improve general and social English language skills and your pronunciation
・enhance your communication skills for dealing with English-speaking patients and colleagues
・raise awareness of intercultural issues and ‘international English’
・develop specific vocabulary and expressions for English used in the medical sector
・practice giving presentations in English or taking a patient history, if necessary
・ work on writing medical reports, emails or case studies · taking a medical history
・conducting physical examinations
・breaking bad news · dealing with problematic patients
・effective patient handovers
・Study language associated with a range of medical situations
・Learn specialized terminology
・Focus on interpersonal skills relevant to your field.

If you are a healthcare professional or university student and you want to improve your English language skills in a context relevant to your career, this is the course for you.

For those working in a medical field, it is important to be highly accurate and clear in their communication but they also need to be able to show tact and sensitivity.
During the course, you will develop these English language skills in a variety of contexts.
This will help you increase your confidence when communicating with patients and their families as well as with colleagues.

course_info.trial_description:
"Ad Astra per aspera" - "Through difficulties to the stars ". My own personal mantra for language learning. As a student of Mandarin, Italian, Latin & Greek myself, I know how hard it can be and the learning never stops! I specialise in teaching Italian & Mandarin Chinese speaking students, though everyone is welcome in my lessons. 

The dichotomy of language learning is that it can be the greatest joy and biggest pain. 
That is what I am here for. As your teacher getting you through the tough times and cheering you on to the endless rewards that come from knowledge.  

As a Native English speaker and Teacher from England, I can help you- whatever level you may be at. From beginner to advanced. My teaching style is patient and non judgmental though I will offer endless constructive critics to enable you to improve. 

This is about you so please tell me your language goals and what you would like to focus on and I will do my very best to help you reach them. We can focus on causal conversation in which I give you tips to improve. Or go down the academic learning route, focusing on the big three - Speaking, Listening & Grammar. But I will make it fun by using your hobbies and interests to make it feel like less of a slog and make the lessons fun  

Go ahead and book a trial with me. Trust me I know it can be scary to take the plunge but I will do my very best to put you at ease. Whatever happens you will have learnt something from this and that is what is most important. lets work together to level you up on your language journey!

pro_course_detail.title: Eddies Conversational English
pro_course_detail.description:
It does what it says on the tin! 

An invaluable lesson - This is preparation for using your English in the real world but in a safe and comfortable non judgmental environment. We can role play here or just chat. If you want to prepare for a job interview or are planning a trip to London lets brush up on your English speaking, there is always room to learn. Trust me I know a few English natives who could do with one of these classes!

My recommendation - Though this lesson can be what you make of it. 
This is a very helpful Lesson for intermediate and Advanced English speakers when used in conjunction with my other - classroom English Lesson . In this way you will be able to hone your English Languages skills with formal lesson first and then take the skills you have learnt from the classroom to practice using them with me in conversation.

Also do please message me if you have any specific requirements and I can tailor a conversation for you in advance of our chat. 

Thank you!

pro_course_detail.title: Eddies English Classroom
pro_course_detail.description:
It is with utter joy that I Welcome you to my English Language  Classroom.  

This is the class that you do not get to see behind the scenes at Hogwarts! After all even wizards need to know how to speak their native tongue. 

Please join me in jumping down the rabbit hole and exploring the language of some of the greatest literary writers and poets in History from my personal favourite - J. R. R. Tolkien to Shakespeare and of course Hogwarts's own J. K . Rowling.  I would love to hear about some  of yours. 

In this class we will be breaking down barriers and cracking your personal language nightmares. The big three - Speaking, Listening and everyone's most feared Grammar!  
Though there is no way around it it is handwork -  I wont lie to you. But that does not  mean we can not have fun studying it together. 

If you would like a more tailored or less traditional approach we can look at English through so many lenses, for example the music of the Beatles or Stones, to voyaging on seascape of Turners painting and discussing his style, or if you prefer we can catch a flight with the eagles and our good friend Bilbo. 

I will start by determining what level you are at and work with you on a study plan. The more information you give me the better and the more you share your passions and hobbies the more fun we will have. But have no fear, if you are not sure, a good place to begin is by booking a trial lesson with me and we can have a nice chat over tea with Alice and the Mad Hatter. 

Above all learning is about the pursuit of gaining knowledge and I hope you will give me the chance to do so. 

Many happy returns, 

Eddie.

teacher_info.intro:
Hi and welcome! I'm native Russian speaker + Italian teacher + I speak English, French, a bit Turkish. Former TV editor who now helps people survive Russian grammar—basically the same stress, but less tears involved.
I love music (studied academic vocal, but then decided to stop torturing neighbours), sport & existential crises. I host a podcast in Russian about inspiring women, wrote a book about femme fatale.
Also, I'm part mermaid 🧜‍♀️ Freediving, swimming, anything with water... Oh, and I sail.

In our lessons, we talk not only about the language itself, but also about history, culture, psychology, travel, and everyday life.

teacher_info.intro:
I was born in Australia, but I have become a person of the world. When I was 27 years old I moved to England, where I lived for seven years and Scotland for five, before moving to Spain, where I continue to live today. I am married to a Spanish girl and speak Spanish quite well, so it can be easier to explain things to Spanish students if they have any doubts.
I have written five books and done some acting on stage. I am interested in history and the environment. I have an open mind, so I enjoy exploring new ideas and different cultures.

teacher_info.short_signature: Good pronunciation and accent, encouraging, fun and interesting, with 20 years experience.
teacher_info.introduction: I’m Australian, but lived in England before coming to Spain, where I have lived for thirteen years, teaching in academies. Many students learn a lot of grammar but don’t practice speaking and listening. I know from my experience learning Spanish that grammar can give you some tools, but practice teaches you how to use them. For example, with beginners, I don't like to teach a list of words by repeating them like a parrot - I believe it is better to practice using them in sentences. Normally I do a class in three parts: 1, Conversation, to practice speaking and listening; 2, Reading, to practice pronunciation and learn not only new words, but also English forms of saying things because it’s not often possible to translate word for word; 3, Translation, from Spanish to English, to practice sentence construction. As a writer who has written six books, (including a children's book in Spanish), I offer a course in writing in English, which includes editing, proofreading and help in publishing. Finally, having studied nutrition for twenty years, I offer a course in dieting, which can be a good way to intensively practice English while learning how to lose weight.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
I have twenty years experience teaching English. I have taught private one-on-one classes, in academies and online.
I have a “Received Pronunciation” accent, which many people think of as an English accent, but it is like a correct, standard form of speaking, which can help in listening.
Something that I love about teaching on italki is having had the opportunity to meet students from all parts of the world. I respect, and I am interested in, different cultures, religions, races and politics. I believe learning languages can help us understand others, which is so important in this world today.
I am very supportive and encouraging.  I believe mistakes are not bad – they can help us learn.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My style of teaching comes from own experience learning a language, Spanish. I have two children who are bilingual and it has been useful to observe how they learn… and with ZERO grammar! They have learnt by listening and using the language.
So in my classes we do a lot of intensive practice. I usually find an article from the news to read and discuss. This helps with learning pronunciation, which can be very difficult when a word does not sound how it is written. It helps to learn new words and expressions – we have different forms of saying things. We also describe photos, to practice flexibility in speaking and finding ways to continue communicating, even if we have a limited vocabulary.

pro_course_detail.title: Accent Reduction + Correct Pronunciation
pro_course_detail.description:
We need to go back to the beginning and learn the correct pronunciation of the letters.
We do a lot of reading, where you listen to the words first and then repeat. We can use tonguetwisters, phrases designed to practice one particular sound.
I understand it is difficult when you have spent all your life pronouncing letters in your own language in a different way, so to change that doesn't feel natural. I know from experience, having learnt Spanish and a little bit of Chinese, Portuguese and French, that new sounds are hard to say. For this I am very patient and encouraging.
I come from Australia, but I speak with Received Pronunciation, a "correct/standard" form of British English, but very much a NEUTRAL accent, which I think is important to be understood in whatever country you are living in.
Having a good vocabulary and correct grammar means nothing if the other person cannot understand what you want to say!
I am strict and we will work hard, but I believe it should be a relaxed, positive class - I don't want you to feel stressed. Remember, mistakes are not bad, we can learn from them.
Let's improve now.

pro_course_detail.title: SONG Writing
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you a singer or musician?
Writing a song in English is not just a question of translating it from your own language. We want it to sound good - we need to think of good/cool expressions; find words that rhyme or sound similar, and keep in mind the number of syllables so that it conforms to the beat.
Sometimes we need to look for alternative words to avoid difficult sustained notes at the end of a line, such as the long "ee" sound. An example of this is the song, "And I am telling you", in particular the Jennifer Hudson version.
For singers, I can also help you with pronunciation. So, if you're interested in breaking into the English market, or just as a hobby, let's get writing!

This is the perfect first step. In this lesson we get to know each other, talk about your English goals, and do a short practice session together. I want to understand exactly where you are now and where you want to be so I can build lessons that actually work for you. 

Whether you are a complete beginner or an experienced professional looking to sharpen your communication, this session gives us both a chance to see if we are a good fit.

No preparation needed. Just come ready to have a conversation and we will take it from there.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English for Professionals
pro_course_detail.description:
The difference between a good professional and a great one is often how clearly they communicate.

This lesson is built for professionals who need English that actually works in the real world. Not textbook English. Not classroom English. The kind of English that closes deals, leads meetings, and builds credibility with clients and colleagues.

We work on the language and communication skills that matter most in your specific role. Meetings, presentations, negotiations, client conversations, status updates, difficult conversations with leadership. Real scenarios, real vocabulary, real practice.

With 20 years of experience leading teams across Canada and Europe in healthcare, technology, and business, I know what professional English actually sounds like under pressure. I will help you sound confident, clear, and credible in every business situation you face.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English
pro_course_detail.description:
The best way to get better at speaking English is simple. Speak more English.

This lesson is all about real conversation. No grammar drills, no memorizing rules, no boring exercises. Just two people talking about interesting topics at your level and pace.
We can talk about anything that interests you. Travel, sports, movies, food, culture, current events, your work, your life. The topic does not matter as much as the practice. Every conversation builds your fluency, expands your vocabulary, and makes you more comfortable expressing yourself naturally.

I correct you gently during conversation without breaking your flow. You learn by doing, not by stopping every two minutes to discuss grammar rules.

Whether you are a complete beginner saying your first English sentences or an advanced speaker looking to sound more natural and fluent, this lesson meets you exactly where you are.

pro_course_detail.title: Interview Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
Job interviews are nerve wracking enough without worrying about your English.

This lesson is designed to get you ready for the real thing. We practice the most common interview questions, work on how to structure your answers clearly and confidently, and focus on the specific vocabulary and phrases that make a strong impression on interviewers.

We also work on the softer side of interviews. How to sound natural under pressure, how to handle unexpected questions, how to speak about your experience in a way that is compelling and memorable.

With experience coaching professionals across healthcare, technology, and business environments, I understand what employers are looking for and how to help you communicate your value clearly and confidently.

By the end of our sessions you will walk into your interview feeling prepared, focused, and ready to perform at your best.

pro_course_detail.title: Beginner English
pro_course_detail.description:
Every expert was once a beginner. The most important step is simply getting started
.
This lesson is designed specifically for students who are just starting their English journey or who know a little English but want to build a stronger foundation. We go slowly, clearly, and at a pace that feels comfortable for you.

We focus on the basics that matter most. Simple vocabulary for everyday situations, essential phrases for common conversations, and the confidence to actually use what you are learning in real life.

I keep everything simple, encouraging, and practical. No complicated grammar explanations. No overwhelming vocabulary lists. Just clear, useful English that you can start using immediately.

30 or 60 minute sessions are perfect for beginners. Focused, manageable, and effective without feeling overwhelming. Every lesson builds on the last one and your progress will surprise you.

pro_course_detail.title: Pronunciation and Fluency
pro_course_detail.description:
You know the words. You understand English well. But when you speak, something does not feel quite right.

This lesson is for students who want to sound more natural, more confident, and more fluent in English. We focus specifically on pronunciation, rhythm, stress, and intonation. The things that make English sound natural rather than stilted or robotic.

We work through real words and phrases that come up in your daily life, practicing the sounds that are most challenging for speakers of your native language. I help you understand not just how to say something correctly but why it sounds the way it does.

Fluency is not about speaking fast. It is about speaking smoothly, naturally, and with confidence. By the end of our sessions you will notice a real difference in how comfortable and natural your English sounds to other people.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Information Technology and Digital Professionals
pro_course_detail.description:
Technology moves fast. Your English needs to keep up.

This lesson is built for IT professionals, software developers, cloud architects, SaaS teams, AI practitioners, digital health specialists, and anyone working in fast moving technical environments who needs to communicate with clarity, precision, and confidence.

Whether you are presenting a cloud migration strategy to executive leadership, explaining an AI solution to a non-technical client, participating in an agile sprint or scrum meeting, writing technical documentation, managing a SaaS implementation, or navigating stakeholder conversations in a complex digital environment: how you communicate is just as important as what you know.

With 20 years of hands-on experience across healthcare IT, enterprise technology, government digital programs, and international business in Canada and Europe, I have worked across the full technology stack from clinical systems and interoperability to cloud platforms, project delivery, and emerging technologies. Real scenarios, real terminology, and real practice built around your specific technology environment and career goals.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Project and Program Management Professionals

Whether you are presenting a business case to a steering committee, managing stakeholder expectations, facilitating a team meeting, negotiating scope and timelines, or writing a project status report, the way you communicate directly impacts your outcomes.

We work on the language of leadership and delivery. How to present project updates with clarity and confidence, how to manage difficult conversations with stakeholders, how to communicate risks and issues without causing panic, and how to facilitate meetings that actually move things forward.

We also focus on the everyday communication that separates good project managers from great ones. Emails that get action, status reports that are read, and conversations that build trust across teams and cultures.

Real scenarios, real PM vocabulary and terminology, and real practice built around your specific role, methodology, and industry.

So if you are interested in diving into faith conversations or learning religious language/phrasology for things, this class was made for you!

pro_course_detail.title: Interview Preparation - Get the job you deserve - All industries
pro_course_detail.description:
I will get you ready for your job interview, no matter your industry or country. 

I have successfully completed many job interviews in the USA (Hollywood, Silicon Valley), South Korea and Mexico. I also have over 20 years of experience in preparing people for their job interviews, in fields/roles including flight attendant, IT, Business Management, supervisory roles, Masters and Ph.D. programs, education and many more.

How I will help you: 
- CV and resume review (only during our class). 
- Mock interviews and role-plays. 
- Professional and suitable vocabulary. 
- Confidence and attitude. 
- Behavior, such as greeting, body language, and etiquette. 

Thanks to having completed many job interviews around the world and also owning my own educational company, I know exactly what employers are looking for and I am happy to share all my secrets with you if you choose to become my student. 

We will achieve this primarily through role-plays and mock interviews, during and after which I will give you helpful feedback on your body and facial expressions, vocabulary, grammar, tone, and overall performance.

My lessons also cover other important areas of a successful job interview, including the greeting, general behavior, answering difficult questions, and presenting yourself confidently from beginning to end. I am especially familiar with the last part, confidence, thanks to my own experience completing interviews and helping my students do the same. In the same way that I have helped actors make it onto the big screen working in Hollywood, I will get you ready for the most important conversation of your life. 

As with all my students, you will be my main focus from the moment we start taking classes together to the moment you get your dream job and beyond. If you would like to get to know me first, feel free to book a trial lesson anytime.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational Masterclass - Get your point across and influence people and situations
pro_course_detail.description:
I have been teaching conversation classes online and offline to English learners of all levels (beginner - intermediate - fluent) in the USA, South Korea, and Mexico for over 20 years.

I can help you with all types of conversation for all areas of your life, including: 
- Small-talk & leisure chatting (for public and social situations). 
- Getting your point across. 
- Commanding (getting) attention. 
- Making people fall in love with you (in business, friendships, and dating). 
- Influencing people and situations to get the outcomes you deserve. 

How I will help you: 
- Starting conversations and keeping them going. 
- Creating a flow of conversation and staying in it. 
- Pronunciation, intonation, and connotation. 
- Body language and facial expressions. 
- Become fluent. 
- American phrases, idioms, phrasal verbs and sayings. 
- Listening and showing your conversation partners that you are understanding them. 
- Sounding more natural and native. 
- Become comfortable & confident. 

As with most people who grew up in Southern California, small talk and conversation are very important to me. I have been fortunate enough to improve this craft while living, teaching, and conversing all over the world for over two decades - and I will share everything I have learned with you in this class. 

If you would like to get to know me first, feel free to book a trial lesson anytime.

pro_course_detail.title: Accent Reduction - Sound like an American native speaker, no matter where you are from
pro_course_detail.description:
I have helped thousands of students from over a hundred countries (South Korea, Spain, and Germany to name a few) improve and lose their accents. 

How I will help you achieve the same: 
- Conversation practice that is adapted to your individual needs and level. 
- Mouth, lip, and tongue movement. 
- Intonation practice. 

With over 20 years of teaching ESL, I know all the common mistakes and how to fix them. My goal is to make you sound like a native English speaker and the best way to achieve this is through talking, talking, talking. Lucky for you, conversation and making people feel comfortable are my strengths, so together we will work on your accent until you achieve your goals - this is my promise to you. 

If you would like to get to know me first, feel free to book a trial lesson anytime.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English - Successfully Perform Resumes & Emails, Phone Calls, Pitching, Selling and much more
pro_course_detail.description:
I have taught Business English to professionals working in huge global companies, like BBVA, Amazon, Google and the revolutionary biotechnology company Genentech for many years. I have worked in a variety of jobs globally and even run my own educational company. In this class, I will share with you everything I have learned in 20 years as an instructor, leader, partner, and employee.

This class is perfect for anybody wanting to improve their Business English for all situations, including: 
- Presentations- 
- Meetings (leading, organizing and participating). 
- Phone Calls (Cold calling, customer relationship etc.). 
- Negotiations. 
- Emails. 
- Hiring. 
- Cross-industry terminology. 
- Selling. 
- Perfecting ideas. 
- Employee Management. 
- Pitching to investors, potential partners or clients. 

How I will help you achieve this: 
- Role-plays. 
- Conversation. 
- Giving you specific tips and tricks. 
- Writing and improving your resume. 
- Speaking and presenting yourself confidently. 
- And anything else you may need. 

In a world where even business is becoming more and more international, you may need a teacher like me to get on top of your Business English game. My work and business experience along with many years of teaching Business English have allowed me to uncover the secrets of succeeding in an English-speaking career. Over almost 20 years, these experiences have taught me many lessons, which I am now excited to share with you, including presenting, leading meetings, phone calls, negotiating, communicating professionally and confidently, and much more. 

My experience in this field is vast and I know just how important of a role the English language plays. Together we will make you the success you were meant to be. If you would like to get to know me first, feel free to book a trial lesson anytime.

pro_course_detail.title: NEW: Grammar Review - Perfect your English grammar with all its tenses, clauses and conditions
pro_course_detail.description:
Does English grammar sometimes overwhelm you? Are you not sure when to use the past, present or future tense? Don’t worry, this Grammar Review class will put your mind at ease.

What this class focuses on:
- Reviewing the rules for various grammar points (tenses, phrases, conjugations, clauses, etc.) and how to use them.
- Comparing different grammar points and when and how to use them.
- Practicing our grammar points using exercises, conversations, worksheets, and presentations.

Grammar is tricky, it can make us fear making mistakes and speaking out loud. As a native speaker and teacher with over 20 years of experience teaching English, I will help you understand and confidently use English grammar.

When booking this class, please send me a message with some details about what you would like to work on, thank you!

If you would like to get to know me first, feel free to book a trial lesson anytime.

pro_course_detail.title: NEW: Proofreading/Editing - Have an important document that needs to be proofread? This class is for you!
pro_course_detail.description:
If you have an important document that needs to be proofread or edited, there is a quick and affordable solution...

I have been proofreading all types of documents for over 20 years, including essays, novels, short stories, press releases, doctoral theses, resumes, letters of interest and many more.

Here is how this class works: 
1. Choose a class duration (30 minutes, 60 minutes, 45 minutes, or 90 minutes). 
2. Send me your document either via the italki chat or via email (as Microsoft Word or Apple Pages document). 
3. I will proofread it for you and get it back to you within 48 - 72 hours, depending on the size of the document (as Microsoft Word document).

Choose a class depending on the size of your document: 
0 - 1,000 words: 30 minutes.
1,000 - 1,500 words: 45 minutes. 
1,500 - 2,000 words: 60 minutes. 
2,000 - 3,000 words: 90 minutes. 
Does your document have more words (for example a thesis or script)? Contact me and we will map out a plan of action.

Important: 
- I will not delete anything, instead, I will add my suggestions and improvements. 
- Sometimes I will add notes on what might sound better depending on what you want to get across.
- I will focus on improving your grammar, word choice, phrases, metaphors, spelling, sentence structure. 
- If you prefer, we can also go through your document together in Skype, FaceTime or the italki classroom. 

If you would like to get to know me first, feel free to book a trial lesson anytime.

❌ Note: If my calendar is full, simply message me and I can fit you in ❌
