pro_course_detail.title: 🇵🇱Polski dla Początkujących / Polish for Beginners🇵🇱
pro_course_detail.description:
Kurs został stworzony z myślą o osobach, które rozpoczynają naukę języka polskiego lub wracają do niej po dłuższej przerwie. Podczas zajęć będziemy pracować z podręcznikiem „Polski na dobry start” na poziomie A1. Po każdym spotkaniu uczeń otrzyma zdjęcie kart pracy, aby samodzielnie utrwalić słownictwo z lekcji.

The course is designed for people who are beginning to learn Polish or returning to it after a longer break. During the classes, we will work with the textbook "Polski na dobry start" at the A1 level. After each session, the student will receive a photo of the worksheets to independently review and reinforce the vocabulary from the lesson.

Курс створено для людей, які починають вивчати польську мову або повертаються до неї після тривалої перерви. Під час занять ми працюватимемо з підручником «Polski na dobry start» рівня A1. Після кожного заняття студент отримає фото з робочих аркушів, щоб самостійно закріпити лексику з уроку.

pro_course_detail.title: 📚Polski dla Średniozaawansowanych (A2 / B2/ Polish for Intermediate Students (A2 / B2)📚
pro_course_detail.description:
Kurs przeznaczony jest dla osób, które opanowały podstawy języka polskiego i chcą rozwijać swoje umiejętności w zakresie komunikacji codziennej. Skupiamy się na poszerzaniu słownictwa, poprawnej gramatyce oraz budowaniu dłuższych wypowiedzi ustnych i pisemnych przy pomocy podręcznika pt. "Polski na Dobry Start" na poziomie A2/B2. Po każdym spotkaniu uczeń otrzymuję karty pracy do wypełnienie, aby utrwalić słownictwo oraz gramatykę.

The course is intended for people who have mastered the basics of the Polish language and want to develop their everyday communication skills. We focus on expanding vocabulary, improving grammar, and building longer spoken and written statements using the textbook "Polski na dobry start" at the A2/B2 level. pro_course_detail.title: Improve your English writing
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you feel anxiety when you need to write an email to a colleague? Do you feel frustrated when you have to write an essay or report in English?  Do you feel annoyed because you're relying on Google translate?

That's because English writing is very difficult, even for native speakers. However, with this course you can improve your writing for exams, for university assignments, or for work. 

You know that you have to improve your writing because if you don't, you will continue to lack confidence and this will prevent you from carrying on with the other work or study that you need to do. But where to start? 

My writing course can help you improve the quality of your writing and help you to feel more confident when you write in just 5 lessons. That way, you can continue with the other things you have to do. 

Why should you choose this course? 

- Because you want to improve the overall quality of your writing in English
- Because you want to learn how to structure your essays, reports, or emails in situations that are specific to your needs
- Because your tired of lacking confidence in your writing

In this course, you'll:

- learn with a native English speaker who gained top marks for writing assignments at university. 
- improve your academic, work-related, or general writing
- get practice exercises covering a variety  of topics and writing styles (or we can use your own writing)
- get practical feedback

If you want to know more, you can book a trial lesson with me or send me a message. You can even just type "improve my writing" and I'll contact you.

pro_course_detail.title: Learn Scots
pro_course_detail.description:
*Please note, if you want to practice conversations in English with a Scottish teacher, this is not the correct course. Please see details of my English Conversation Practice course * 

This course is an introduction to the Scots language. 

Scots is one of 3 official languages (along with English and Scottish Gaelic) in Scotland. It is a minority language and one that we use a lot in conjunction with English. 

So if you plan to visit Scotland and want to know what you'll hear on the streets, book a lesson today. 

In this course you'll learn: 

- what Scots is and how it is used in Scotland
- the sounds of Scots
- the most common Scots words
- differences between the West and East coasts
- some basic grammar
- communicating in practical situations and reading real dialogues

To do this course, it would be best if you have at least B2 level of English as the instructions  and materials will be given in English.

pro_course_detail.title: Advanced English
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you at intermediate level and getting frustrated trying to reach advanced level? Or are you already advanced and finding it difficult to get beyond that plateau? Do you feel frustrated at not making full use of vocabulary? 

Perhaps you want to reach the next step in your English-learning journey but aren't sure where to start? 

If any of this resonates with you then my advanced English course is exactly what you need.

We can focus on your goals and objectives and we can practice any and all aspects of the language (listening, speaking, writing, and reading). We can also incorporate any subject or topic you like -  travel, work, job interviews, study. 

My advanced English course can help you communicate like a native speaker and will help you feel more at ease when you communicate in either professional or personal situations. 

With me, you'll get: 

- lessons with a native teacher from Scotland 
-  lessons that use a variety of resources used (dialogues, videos, articles, PowerPoint documents)
- practical, useful feedback to improve your accuracy and fluency
- lessons with a patient teacher who has a positive attitude and gives you lots of encouragement. 
- the chance to test yourself and prove what you can do

My course is the result of 10 years of teaching English and helping people to improve their confidence when they communicate. We'll decide on a goal for you You'll see the difference in just 5 lessons

Book a trial lesson today or send me a message and I'll give you all the details.

pro_course_detail.title: Scots Poems, Songs, Literature
pro_course_detail.description:
If you have an interest in poems, songs, and literature that are written in the Scots language, this is the perfect course for you. 

In each lesson, we can choose a particular song, poem, or verse and work together to translate and understand it. By doing this, you will be able to have a greater appreciation of Scots culture. Some examples that I have used in previous lessons include:

- poems and songs by Robert Burns
- a poem that tells the story of a Scottish village choosing its memorial to honour their war dead
- Harry Potter in the Scots language.

You can make your own suggestions too. 

This course is best suited for those who have at least B2 English and have also taken the introductory course in Scots.

pro_course_detail.title: English for University
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you planning on studying at a university in an English-speaking country? Or are you enrolled on a university Cours in your own country that is taught in English? If so, you should take this course so that you can gain the skills you need to study in English at university level. 

Academic English is not like general English - it has its own subtle rules and conventions and this applies to reading, writing, speaking, and listening. So, whether you are already enrolled on a course and want support with your essays or presentations, or you are due to start a university course soon, you can help, support, and practice with doing university tasks in English. 

We can start by talking about your strengths, weaknesses, and goals. Some of the things we can practice can include: 

Speaking - presentations, pair discussions, group discussions. 
Listening - Listening during a meeting and a lecture.
Writing - planning, structure, quoting, references, taking notes. 
Reading - reading for general message and for detail

I have teaching materials but we can use your own work or materials that you have been assigned. 

Requirements: You should already have at least B2 level of general English and have (or be working towards) your institution's required IELTS or TOEFL score. You should also make sure you have enough study time available between lessons. This course will require a lot of self study so you should make sure you have time to dedicate to it. 

Sign up today or book a trial lesson if you want to improve your English for academic study.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Teachers / Educators
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you a teacher in a school, training institute, or university? 

Do you have a good knowledge of English but feel nervous when you have to use it in your classroom? Do you struggle to communicate with your students either in writing or speaking? 

You need to improve your English for your job and you know that if you don't, it will prevent you from teaching your students effectively and making progress in your career. 

If any of this seems familiar to you, my English for Teachers / Educators course is perfect for you. 

My course can help you feel more confident when you communicate with your learners in the classroom or online and allow you to carry on with the rest of your work and make progress in your career. 

This course is the result of ten years of helping teachers at all levels and you will see a difference in just 3-4 lessons. 

Here are some of the things we can practice: 

- giving instructions
- communicating with your learners in writing (email, forum, social media)
- teaching a topic in English (if you don't normally teach in English)
- giving presentations, lectures, and workshops
- giving feedback

We can choose the objective that is best for you and we can use materials that you need to use. 

With my course, you'll get: 

- lessons from a native teacher from Scotland
- lessons from a patient, encouraging teacher
- lessons that help you achieve your goal
- practical feedback and advice

If you're still not sure, you can read testimonials from my previous students on my page. 

I can help you if:

- you are a primary school teacher (5-11) who needs to teach their class partly or entirely in English
- you are a high school teacher who teaches a specific subject and wants to use English in some/all of the lesson
- you teach adults at university and need to or want to give classes in English

pro_course_detail.title: Writing-Check Service
pro_course_detail.description:
Have you written an assignment for school or university? Or a report for work? Or another important document that must be perfect?

Errors in spelling, grammar, punctuation, and sentence structure can seriously detract from your message. They can also look unprofessional. 

But you can take advantage of my writing-check service to ensure your document is perfect for your audience. 

The service includes: 

- Checking spelling, grammar, punctuation, and sentences structure.

- Checking citations and references 

- Checking document structure and flow

How does it work? 

- send me a message on Italki and include your document in Microsoft Word

- I will read it and tell you the approximate time and cost

- If you are happy and agree to it, I will send you a lesson invite with the total price. You MUST accept the lesson invite before I begin to check your document. 

- Once you receive the document back (usually in 2 working days, NOT including the weekend), you MUST confirm the lesson or allow it to confirm automatically. If you fail to do this or cancel the lesson, you will be reported to Italki. 

Why choose me to do this? 

- I am an experienced proofreader with 5 years of experience
- I specialise in checking assignments in psychology and sociology
- As an experienced  university teacher, I understand what universities and professors look for in assignments. 

So, send me a message today and see how I can help you with your assignment or document. 

* Please note, that this service is only to check your document for errors. It is not a writing service. You must write the document and I will check it. I also take no responsibility for any grade received or any negative feedback. Also, the minimum price for this service is $40 p/h.

During our lessons, I'll equip you with the practical skills and knowledge needed to thrive in a business environment. Whether you're a recent graduate 🎓 or an experienced professional 💼, I can help you enhance your language and communication skills to achieve your goals.

You will learn to create a standout Resume/CV 📄 that highlights your strengths, and write a compelling motivation letter ✍️ that distinguishes you from other candidates.

We’ll develop your reading comprehension skills 📚, enabling you to analyze complex business materials, such as reports and industry journals. Through realistic role-playing exercises 🎭, you’ll gain hands-on experience in various business scenarios, including calls, speeches, and meetings.

You’ll learn effective communication strategies with colleagues, clients, and customers 🤝, and build your business vocabulary and expressions 🗣️. I’ll guide you in negotiating with confidence and clarity.

Additionally, you'll master the art of delivering engaging presentations 📊 and receive constructive feedback to improve your skills.

Finally, we’ll prepare for job interviews by simulating common questions and providing feedback on your responses. You'll learn how to present yourself professionally and confidently, helping you stand out as a candidate 🌟.

NEW STUDENTS: If you are booking a lesson with me for the first time, please send a brief message along with your request. I ask for this so I know prospective students have read my profile description and watched my introduction video. For example:

- Hello, Aura. I'd like to practice my English conversation skills. I'm looking forward to speaking with you soon.

As long as you have a basic understanding of English, you are welcome to practice English conversation with me. We can talk about everyday topics, or maybe you have an interesting life story to share.

I'm open to different topics, but I always enjoying talking about food, cooking, nutrition, health, holistic living, yoga, creativity, language learning, Japan, travel, world cultures, music, and technology, for example.

- Scene description using pictures, photographs, or film clips
- The student describes a word and I try to guess the word, or vice versa
- I teach an idiom or other expression, and the student tries to guess the meaning
- Practicing tongue twisters

As a native speaker of American English, I can help you find the words and expressions to express yourself naturally.

pro_course_detail.description:
*We can use Teams or Google Meet*

NEW STUDENTS: If you are booking a session with me for the first time, please send a message with your request. This is especially important if you would like me to proofread a document or other piece of writing. For example:

- Hello, Aura. Could you help me proofread my one-page essay for my English class?
- Hello, Aura. Can we practice reading an article together and then discuss it afterwards? Can you correct my pronunciation when I read the article?
- Nice to meet you, Aura. I would like to practice giving my work presentation with you. If I book a session, could you give me some feedback?

Reading Practice:
We can practice reading online articles, or maybe you have your own material you'd like to practice reading with me.  I can correct your pronunciation, word stress, and tell you how to properly link certain words together. For example, the phrase, "What are you going to do today?" sounds more like: "Whaddar ya gonna do taday?" when spoken out loud. We can do shadowing practice. I can read some text and then you can repeat after me, trying to match my rhythm, intonation, pronunciation, and word stress. Or, you can read it by yourself without shadowing me.

Proofreading:
I can check pieces of writing such as e-mails or short essays for errors and clarity. I proofread documents during the lesson time, with the student.

Presentation Practice:
Maybe you need to give a PowerPoint presentation or speech at an event or assembly. You can practice it with me while I give necessary corrections and feedback.

Whether you’re starting from zero or aiming for C1, this 30‑minute session is designed to kick‑start your confidence and fluency. During our time together, we will:

	2.	Core Vocabulary & Phrases

	3.	Guided Conversation

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational Spanish 💬📚
pro_course_detail.description:
I have specifically crafted this instructional program for individuals like myself who are eager to enhance their verbal communication skills, seek constructive feedback, and aspire to attain proficiency in idiomatic expressions. The curriculum I've developed also encompasses a structured approach to grammar instruction, aiming to be both effective and enjoyable. My objective is to create an environment that nurtures speech improvement, facilitates the assimilation of feedback, and supports the acquisition of idiomatic expressions, all while ensuring that grammatical principles are taught through engaging and efficient methods. 😁🌟

‼️‼️ Important information (ENG 🇬🇧)‼️‼️

1. Lessons are 55 minutes long, it may include a brief break for the professor at the beginning/end of the lesson.

2. If not being able to attend the lesson, please let know the professor at least 1 hour before the lesson starts, otherwise the lesson will be charged and credits transferred to the professor.

3. This type of lesson is only for B2 - C2 students.

4. Once the student books a lesson, he/she accepts these rules  ✍️.

1. Mis lecciones tienen una duración de 55 minutos y pueden incluir un breve descanso para mí al principio o al final de la lección.

3. Este tipo de lección está específicamente destinado a hablantes de nivel B2 - C2.

4.  Al agendar la lección, el estudiante acepta estas reglas  ✍️.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation and Reading for Kids
pro_course_detail.description:
Children have a natural curiosity but a short attention span—especially when learning a new language! That’s why this English lesson is packed with visual, interactive elements designed to keep kids engaged and having fun. 

Through games, songs, and dynamic activities, children pick up English in a way that feels more like play than study. The focus is on conversation, so they quickly build confidence speaking in real-life scenarios, from greeting others to expressing their ideas. 

As soon as they reach a basic level of fluency, we also introduce early reading to further support their progress. By nurturing a love for language at an early age, our program helps children grow into enthusiastic, fluent English speakers, ready to connect with the world around them. 

With a child-centered approach, they’ll be excited to join every lesson, and parents will be thrilled with their progress!

teacher_info.intro: Hello! I’m Jasmon, your fun, red-head ESL teacher with a passion for helping students speak English confidently! Born in Kentucky (USA) and now based in Atlanta, I’ve taught English for 6 years, specializing in conversational practice, business english and exam prep (IELTS). My secret? I’ve been in your shoes: I learned Spanish the hard way and now speak it fluently, so I get the struggles of language learning! teacher_info.about_teacher:

I spent years studying but not speaking enough, and I felt stuck at a B1-B2 level for a long time. Once I started actively using the language—speaking, listening, and making mistakes—I finally began to improve. That experience really shapes how I teach today.

I have three years of experience teaching in classroom settings, I have 3 years of experience teaching ESL online.  I first started teaching in 2014 in Atenas, Alajuela, Costa Rica at Green Valley Academy and that's when I became passionate about teaching ESL.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
In my classes, we focus a lot on conversation, especially speaking and listening, because that’s where most students need the most practice. We also work on vocabulary, useful expressions/phrases, note-taking, and sometimes short readings with discussion to help you sound more natural and confident.
I can help you prepare for exams like the IELTS, improve your business English, job interview practice, document writing help or just get more comfortable speaking without overthinking.  

My classroom is a safe, RELAXED space where mistakes are welcome and learning feels comfortable. If you’re ready to take your English to the next level, I only ask for 2 things from you in class: RELAX & talk.

teacher_info.about_teacher:

Mi aula es cálida, estructurada y sin juicio. Celebramos tu progreso real (no el perfecto de libro de texto), y cada error es una pista, no un veredicto. Me formé en psicología antes que en pedagogía, así que no solo machacamos gramática: te ayudo a creer que puedes hablar.

teacher_info.teaching_style:

course_info.trial_description:
What to Expect in Your Trial Lesson
In our first session, we’ll set the foundation for your English learning journey by:

🔹 Exploring Your Learning Style – Are you a visual, auditory, or kinesthetic learner? I’ll assess your preferences and tailor the materials accordingly to make learning easier and more effective for you.

🔹 Presenting Class Materials – You’ll get an overview of the books, programs, and resources we’ll use to ensure a structured and engaging learning experience.

🔹 Mapping Out Your Progress – I’ll walk you through the topics we’ll cover over the semester and the level of English you can expect to achieve by the end of our lessons.

🔹 Understanding Our Class Activities – Expect fun and interactive exercises that will boost your confidence in English—no boring drills, just practical learning that keeps you engaged.

🔹 Assessing Your Current Level – To personalize your learning plan, we’ll complete a short test to determine your starting point and the best approach to help you improve efficiently.

📌 Tracking Your Progress (Without the Stress!) – Every now and then, we’ll have light, no-pressure quizzes to see how much you’ve improved. Think of them as friendly checkpoints rather than tests—no stress, just a way to celebrate your progress!

pro_course_detail.title: English A1 for Beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
🔹 Practice Real-Life Conversations – Whether it’s introducing yourself, ordering at a café, or expressing your ideas clearly, we’ll work on natural, everyday communication skills.

🔹 Boost Your Confidence – We’ll ease into speaking, listening, and writing exercises at your pace, so you feel comfortable and excited to improve.

🔹 Learn with Tailored Materials – Based on your learning style, I’ll provide the right mix of visual, audio, or interactive resources to make learning easier and more enjoyable for you.

🔹 Practice Basic Introductions – You’ll learn how to introduce yourself and others with simple sentences like:
“Hello, my name is…” / “I am from…” / “Nice to meet you!”
→ Exercise: Short role-play where you introduce yourself and ask a partner basic questions.

🔹 Master Essential Greetings & Common Phrases – From "Good morning!" to "See you later!", we’ll cover key expressions used in daily conversations.
→ Exercise: Matching activity where you pair greetings with their appropriate responses.

🔹 Build Simple Sentences – Learn the structure of basic sentences like "I am a student" or "She is from Spain."
→ Exercise: Fill in the blanks using "am / is / are" to complete sentences correctly.

🔹 Strengthen Your Listening Skills – You’ll listen to slow, clear dialogues and practice understanding key words.
→ Exercise: Listen to a short conversation and answer simple questions like "What is his name?" or "Where is she from?"

🔹 Set Your First Milestone – We’ll establish small, achievable goals so you can track your progress and feel accomplished every step of the way.

pro_course_detail.title: English A2 for Basic Beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
🔹 A2 – Everyday Conversations Made Easy
Perfect for beginners ready to take the next step! You’ll improve your ability to express yourself in common situations and start forming more natural sentences.

✅ Expand Your Daily Vocabulary – Talk about your hobbies, routines, and plans.
→ Exercise: “A Day in My Life” – Describe your daily routine using simple present and future tenses.

✅ Handle Everyday Situations – Learn to order food, ask for directions, and shop with confidence.
→ Exercise: Role-play ordering in a café or asking for help in a store.

✅ Improve Your Listening – Understand slow, clear speech in real-life contexts.
→ Exercise: Listen to short dialogues and answer simple questions.

pro_course_detail.title: English B1 for Intermediate
pro_course_detail.description:
🔹 B1 – Speak with More Freedom & Accuracy
If you already manage basic conversations but want to speak more naturally, this level is for you!

✅ Communicate Your Ideas Clearly – Express opinions, describe experiences, and tell simple stories.
→ Exercise: “Tell Me About Your Last Holiday” – Practice using the past simple and past continuous.

✅ Master Social Conversations – Engage in friendly small talk and express likes/dislikes.
→ Exercise: Role-play a casual conversation with a friend or coworker.

✅ Strengthen Your Listening & Grammar – Learn to recognize key phrases and improve sentence structure.
→ Exercise: Listen to a short podcast and summarize the main ideas.

pro_course_detail.title: English B2 for High Intermediate
pro_course_detail.description:
🔹 B2 – Speak Fluently & Express Yourself Naturally
For independent speakers who want to sound more confident and precise in discussions and everyday life.

✅ Debate & Discuss – Learn how to defend your opinions and participate in engaging conversations.
→ Exercise: “Agree or Disagree” – Express your opinion on different topics using persuasive language.

✅ Boost Your Vocabulary – Discover idioms, phrasal verbs, and natural expressions.
→ Exercise: Fun quiz on common idioms and their meanings.

✅ Understand More Complex Audio & Texts – Improve comprehension with real-world materials.
→ Exercise: Analyze a short news article and discuss key points.

pro_course_detail.title: English C1 for Advanced
pro_course_detail.description:
🔹 C1 – Speak Like a Pro with Advanced Skills
Take your English to the next level with natural, nuanced communication.

✅ Master Complex Conversations – Express ideas fluently in both formal and informal situations.
→ Exercise: “Problem-Solving Discussion” – Work through a real-world challenge with structured conversation techniques.

✅ Sound More Native – Perfect your pronunciation, intonation, and word choice.
→ Exercise: Imitate native speech patterns and receive personalized feedback.

✅ Work with Advanced Texts & Audio – Understand fast-paced conversations and abstract ideas.
→ Exercise: Watch a TED Talk and summarize the main arguments.

pro_course_detail.title: English C2 for Very Advanced
pro_course_detail.description:
🔹 C2 – Achieve True Fluency & Native-Like Mastery
At this level, it’s all about refining your skills and sounding as natural as possible.

✅ Master Subtle Nuances – Learn advanced collocations, idioms, and cultural expressions.
→ Exercise: “Say It Like a Native” – Replace common phrases with more sophisticated alternatives.

✅ Speak Without Hesitation – Improve flow and natural rhythm in conversations.
→ Exercise: Debate a thought-provoking topic with near-native fluency.

✅ Analyze & Create Complex Texts – Develop academic and professional writing skills.
→ Exercise: Write a persuasive essay or analyze a complex literary text.

pro_course_detail.title: ✨📘 ESPAÑOL A1 PARA PRINCIPIANTES✨
pro_course_detail.description:
🔹 Practica conversaciones reales: Ya sea presentándote, pidiendo en un café o expresando tus ideas con claridad, trabajaremos en habilidades de comunicación cotidianas y naturales.

🔹 Aumenta tu confianza: Practicaremos ejercicios de expresión oral, comprensión auditiva y escritura a tu propio ritmo, para que te sientas cómodo y motivado para mejorar.

🔹 Aprende con materiales personalizados: Según tu estilo de aprendizaje, te proporcionaré la combinación ideal de recursos visuales, auditivos e interactivos para que aprender sea más fácil y ameno.

🔹 Practica presentaciones básicas: Aprenderás a presentarte y a presentar a otros con frases sencillas como: «Hola, me llamo…» / «Soy de…» / «¡Mucho gusto!»

→ Ejercicio: Breve juego de roles donde te presentas y le haces preguntas básicas a un compañero.

🔹 Domina saludos esenciales y frases comunes: Desde «¡Buenos días!» Para decir "¡Hasta luego!", repasaremos expresiones clave que se usan en las conversaciones cotidianas.

→ Ejercicio: Actividad de emparejamiento donde relacionarás saludos con sus respuestas adecuadas.

🔹 Construye oraciones simples: Aprende la estructura de oraciones básicas como "Soy estudiante" o "Ella es de España".

→ Ejercicio: Completa los espacios en blanco usando "am / is / are" para formar oraciones correctamente.

🔹 Mejora tu comprensión auditiva: Escucharás diálogos claros y pausados, y practicarás la comprensión de palabras clave.

→ Ejercicio: Escucha una conversación breve y responde preguntas sencillas como "¿Cómo se llama?" o "¿De dónde es ella?".

🔹 Establece tu primer objetivo: Fijaremos metas pequeñas y alcanzables para que puedas seguir tu progreso y sentirte satisfecho/a en cada paso.

pro_course_detail.title: Español A2 para principiantes básicos
pro_course_detail.description:
🔹 A2 – Conversaciones cotidianas fáciles

¡Perfecto para principiantes listos para dar el siguiente paso! Mejorarás tu capacidad de expresarte en situaciones comunes y empezarás a formar frases más naturales.

✅ Amplía tu vocabulario diario: Habla de tus aficiones, rutinas y planes.

→ Ejercicio: «Un día en mi vida»: Describe tu rutina diaria usando el presente y el futuro simples.

✅ Maneja situaciones cotidianas: Aprende a pedir comida, preguntar direcciones y comprar con confianza.

→ Ejercicio: Practica cómo pedir en una cafetería o pedir ayuda en una tienda.

✅ Mejora tu comprensión auditiva: Entiende el habla pausada y clara en contextos reales.

→ Ejercicio: Escucha diálogos cortos y responde preguntas sencillas.

pro_course_detail.title: Inglés B1 para nivel intermedio
pro_course_detail.description:
🔹 B1 – Habla con más fluidez y precisión

Si ya te desenvuelves en conversaciones básicas pero quieres hablar con mayor naturalidad, ¡este nivel es para ti!

✅ Comunica tus ideas con claridad: expresa opiniones, describe experiencias y cuenta historias sencillas.

→ Ejercicio: «Cuéntame sobre tus últimas vacaciones». Practica el uso del pasado simple y el pasado continuo.

✅ Domina las conversaciones sociales: participa en charlas informales y expresa tus gustos y preferencias.

→ Ejercicio: Representa una conversación informal con un amigo o compañero de trabajo.

✅ Mejora tu comprensión auditiva y gramática: aprende a reconocer frases clave y mejora la estructura de las oraciones.

→ Ejercicio: Escucha un podcast corto y resume las ideas principales.

pro_course_detail.title: Inglés B2 para nivel intermedio alto
pro_course_detail.description:
🔹 B2 – Habla con fluidez y exprésate con naturalidad
Para hablantes autónomos que desean sonar más seguros y precisos en conversaciones y en la vida cotidiana.

✅ Debate y debate: Aprende a defender tus opiniones y a participar en conversaciones interesantes.

→ Ejercicio: «De acuerdo o en desacuerdo»: Expresa tu opinión sobre diferentes temas con un lenguaje persuasivo.

✅ Amplía tu vocabulario: Descubre modismos, verbos frasales y expresiones coloquiales.

→ Ejercicio: Divertido cuestionario sobre modismos comunes y su significado.

✅ Comprende audios y textos más complejos: Mejora tu comprensión con materiales del mundo real.

→ Ejercicio: Analiza un breve artículo de noticias y comenta los puntos clave.

pro_course_detail.title: Inglés C1 para nivel avanzado
pro_course_detail.description:
🔹 C1 – Speak Like a Pro with Advanced Skills
Take your English to the next level with natural, nuanced communication.

✅ Master Complex Conversations – Express ideas fluently in both formal and informal situations.
→ Exercise: “Problem-Solving Discussion” – Work through a real-world challenge with structured conversation techniques.

✅ Sound More Native – Perfect your pronunciation, intonation, and word choice.
→ Exercise: Imitate native speech patterns and receive personalized feedback.

✅ Work with Advanced Texts & Audio – Understand fast-paced conversations and abstract ideas.
→ Exercise: Watch a TED Talk and summarize the main arguments.

pro_course_detail.title: Inglés C2 para nivel muy avanzado
pro_course_detail.description:
🔹 C2 – Logra una fluidez auténtica y un dominio casi nativo

En este nivel, el objetivo es perfeccionar tus habilidades y sonar lo más natural posible.

✅ Domina los matices sutiles: Aprende colocaciones avanzadas, modismos y expresiones culturales.

→ Ejercicio: «Habla como un nativo»: Sustituye frases comunes por alternativas más sofisticadas.

✅ Habla con fluidez: Mejora la fluidez y el ritmo natural en las conversaciones.

→ Ejercicio: Debate un tema que invite a la reflexión con una fluidez casi nativa.

✅ Analiza y crea textos complejos: Desarrolla habilidades de escritura académica y profesional.

→ Ejercicio: Escribe un ensayo persuasivo o analiza un texto literario complejo.

Por ejemplo, sabias que en Argentina le llaman "pileta" a lo que aquí le llamamos "piscina" (water pool)? 
Demás esta decir que también puedo recomendarte lugares para visitar, y hablar de la cultura Uruguaya.

teacher_info.intro:
Luckily, my hobby (the English language) has become my career, so, teaching English has always been a pleasant chore for me. I'm an English tutor with a Master's degree from a teachers' training university. As a teacher, I’m very adaptable in terms of the teaching methods I use, although my personal favorite is discussion as it presupposes a two-way flow of thought. I believe in the flexibility of educational approach. All my classes are tailor-made according to the students' requirements and abilities, using original course books, audio, and video materials. Together, we are usually able to make good progress to our mutual satisfaction. Due to my vast work experience, I can handle students almost of all ages and background educational levels as long as they are motivated and focused. My field of expertise, therefore, includes various tests preparation and intensive courses for beginners of any age.

teacher_info.intro:
Hi, I’m Erin—an American English teacher in Sevilla since 2008! I specialize in helping intermediate to advanced learners *speak* English confidently, whether for travel, work, or just loving the language. My secret? Making lessons feel like lively chats over tapas (my Sevilla life rubbed off on me!). Fun fact: My social work background means I *listen* deeply—so I’ll catch your stumbling blocks and turn them into strengths. When I’m not teaching, you’ll find me swapping book recommendations, lifting weights (balance, right?), or trying out new recipes. Let’s make English feel *yours*—with humor, pop culture, and zero stress!

I have a TEFL certificate from TEFL International and I've also taught in academies or have given private lessons since 2008. As a teacher, I really care about my students and try to help them and give them support as much as I can. I always try to explain things as thoroughly as possible, often by giving examples or playing games, if you're interested, to help reinforce what we're studying. 

I like to give dynamic lessons to keep everyone interested through games, activities, songs or videos. I try to make sure that each lesson incorporates some sort of skills needed when learning a language, such as reading, writing, listening and speaking.  I cater to my students' needs and what they're interested in.

teacher_info.intro:
Hello friends and prospective students,

My name is Jonathan and I am here to help you achieve your language learning goals! 
I am a native English speaker from the Florida, United States and I am a professional English language instructor since 2012. I have a Master's degree in Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages (TESOL) Education (University of South Florida, 2016), a Bachelor's degree in Communications and a Cambridge CELTA teaching certificate (2013).

I can help you prepare for Cambridge exams (KEY, PET, FCE, CAE, IELTS) and TOEFL, help your writing, speaking and communication skills as well as help you refine your pronunciation and fluency.  Furthermore, I aim to provide a comfortable, enjoyable and safe space to develop fluency with proven methods to help create a sense of progress and, as a result, grow more confident when speaking.

I also offer proofreading services and have experience reviewing and revising scientific papers that have been published in renowned academic journals. Human expertise will always be more valuable than AI!

24-hour cancellation policy: If you have to re-schedule the classes, please do so with at least 24 hours advance notice in order to allow other students to reserve a lesson at that time. If you have to cancel within 24 hours, the italki credits will be transferred. Thank you for understanding!

As always, if you have any questions, comments or concerns please do not hesitate to contact me.

teacher_info.introduction:
NOTE: 
Dear current and prospective students:
I am making the transition back to Ecuador and will be henceforth unavailable until September. I apologize for any inconvenience caused by this sudden development and for having to reschedule forthcoming lessons but we'll pick up right where we left off in a few weeks' time!

Hello friends and amigos, My name is Jonathan and I am looking forward to teaching and learning with you! I am a native English speak from the United States and I have been teaching English in South America since 2012 where I have also been studying Spanish. 
I have a Master's degree in TESOL Education, a Bachelor's degree in Communications and a Cambridge CELTA certificate. I have extensive experience teaching Cambridge exam preparation courses, conversation classes and daily language courses in English learning institutes. I have also been learning Spanish for nearly 10 years. 
As a fellow language learner, I understand and identify the challenges of learning another language. Additionally, I've learned a few tricks to becoming fluent, like: Don't be afraid to make mistakes! Errors are valuable learning opportunities and everyone makes them -- including native speakers (myself included). 
In addition to having many personal and professional interests, I am deeply interested in refining my teaching craft. But above all, I want to help students achieve their learning objectives. I would also love to share stories, hobbies, knowledge, passions, culture and especially language with other people all around the world. After all, we are all part of the human family and there are many things that we share and have in common, sometimes without even realizing it! 
Let's both learn to speak the same language so that we may connect and help each other reach our goals grow as learners!

exp_info.description: This experience will help me guide and engage students who are tasked with taking the FCE for Schools exam (CEFR: B2) because I know how to make the course materials interesting, relevant to the students' context and objectives, authentic, challenging and enjoyable with the creative use of games and activities.

University teaching demands dedication to the teaching craft, a high degree of professionalism and consistent practice of sound pedagogical approaches to instruction. Teaching at UDEP undoubtedly enriched my understanding of what it means to be a teacher and helped me recognize the challenges that students ages 16-22 face by balancing their studies, work, and personal circumstances. exp_info.job: English Language Instructor; FCE Curriculm Designer and Instructor

course_info.trial_description:
Welcome! Booking a trial lesson is the ideal way to decide the ideal way to achieve your language learning goals. In addition to discussing your aims and objectives in detail, we will also identify which aspects of English we can focus on and also formulate a learning plan to define the structure of lessons that you will receive in the future. Above all, you will have valuable practice and also see if my teaching methods are suitable for you.
I can't wait to work with you to help you along your language learning journey. Thank you for your consideration!

pro_course_detail.title: English A1 - C2
pro_course_detail.description:
Beginner to advanced learners of all ages are welcome! 

The lessons are adapted to your needs and interests. I use a variety of audiovisual materials and incorporate worksheets and homework that are specific for each student according to their needs and wants. If you need to refine your composition skills for work purposes, then the lessons will focus on reading and writing skills in accordance with writing conventions in a professional setting. If you would like to feel more confident speaking to native speakers, then the lessons will revolve around conversational topics along with speaking and listening skills. If you simply want to improve your overall proficiency, then we will take a holistic approach and integrate all the skills into the lessons and post-lesson practice (homework!). In summary, the language learning plan is a collaborative process and is adapted according to the results that you wish to attain!

The first lesson / trial lesson serves as a diagnostic tool to help identify language gaps, specify preferences and interests, and discuss goals and how to best approach the lessons so that you may receive a more personalized learning experience that will help you achieve them. 

Lesson packages include a personalized learning plan, learning materials, writing assessments and feedback outside of lesson time, and a free speaking assessment after every 5 lessons. Since you've read up to this point, it's evident that you are serious about improving your language skills. So, what are you waiting for? Book a trial lesson today and let's talk about how we can bring you closer to your goals!

NOTE: The 30-minute lesson option lasts 25 minutes, the 60 minute-lesson option lasts 55 minutes and the 90-minute lesson option lasts 85 minutes.

pro_course_detail.title: The English Café (Informal Conversation)
pro_course_detail.description:
The English Café is a place to talk freely about anything and everything under the sun!

Here you can practice your speaking and listening skills while feeling relaxed and free of judgment. Remember, language learning is a process -- practice makes progress!

The focus for the English Café is on informal conversation with some error correction. The idea is to help you refine your language skills and reinforce good practice in a pleasurable way.

If you would like lessons with more structures and greater emphasis on using varied grammatical structures and vocabulary acquisition, I recommend taking the English A1 - C2 course instead.

pro_course_detail.title: VIP English
pro_course_detail.description:
As a token of my gratitude, these discounted lessons are reserved for long-time students who take classes regularly. 
Thank you for your devotion to your learning and trust in me as your teacher / language partner / tutor. Keep up the good work, and remember: practice makes progress!

NOTE: The 30-minute lesson option lasts 25 minutes, the 60 minute-lesson option lasts 55 minutes and the 90-minute lesson option lasts 85 minutes.

pro_course_detail.title: Proofreading Service
pro_course_detail.description:
I have wide range of experience in writing in several styles for numerous purposes and would therefore like to offer my help to you! I provide proofreading services for several text types, including CV’s, cover letters, statement of purpose, motivational letters, letters of reference, grant proposals, e-mails, technical reports, academic articles, scientific writing, essays, and Spanish to English translation.
The pricing scheme is as follows.
•	$8/page – proofreading for errors and correction
•	$10/page – more profound revision for effectiveness of the redaction, clarity of expression, and conciseness
•	$12/page – multiple drafts of profound revision (one-time fee)
•	$0.10/word – Spanish to English translation
Prices are negotiable. Please consult internally via message for consultations.

teacher_info.intro:
Hi! I’m Demi, a language tutor and actor with over 10 years of experience helping students unlock the expressive power of language. I create a dynamic, supportive environment where learners feel encouraged to explore, take risks, and grow with confidence. I believe language is, above all, a tool for human connection—allowing us to share ideas, emotions, and stories in meaningful and authentic ways.

By blending storytelling, improvisation, and theatrical techniques, I make lessons interactive, engaging, and memorable, helping you develop natural communication skills, spontaneity, and confidence. My background in philosophy shapes my teaching approach, encouraging reflection, curiosity, and deeper understanding. I see language as a living, creative medium through which we interpret and express both our inner and outer worlds.

To ensure each learning journey is effective and personal, I incorporate elements of psychoanalysis to better understand your personality, motivations, and learning style. This allows me to fully tailor each lesson to your unique needs and abilities, making the process both meaningful and impactful.

I am highly flexible in my teaching style. I can offer structured, academic guidance focused on clarity and precision, or a more playful, creative approach that encourages imagination and exploration. My goal is to help you communicate clearly, confidently, and authentically, while making learning enjoyable, empowering, and deeply connected to who you are.
teacher_info.short_signature: Certified and Passionate Language Tutor& Actor | 10+ Years Using Drama to Make Learning Come Alive
teacher_info.introduction: Ahoy hoy! If you are reading this, it means that something drew you attention. I am very glad to know that. I come from that what is called philosophical background, which is very unclear to some extent. And some philosophical observations led me to the phenomena of language. It was the time when I started to be interested in different languages. In this case, I would say that linguistics and philosophy are neighbours. The most important thing in case of learning a foreign language is a reflection upon it, consequently it becomes not a simple learning, but a discovery, first of all discovery of yourself. I have to say that I have been teaching English for 2,5 years so far and I have been learning other languages at the same time. I finally found that what I appreciate and totally adore. I have been in those uncomfortable but dynamic situations ( I mean the struggle inside the language) so many times and now I can understand the mechanisms of it. It made my progress faster and more interesting, since I found what works for me. I want you to find the same for you, dear reader.  So here and now I would like to invite you into the wonderland of language and march with me through different obstacles and vicissitudes that the language brings us daily. Dear boys and girls! I'd be delighted to work with you and spend quality time together. At the moment I can work with three language and it seems already as an achievement for me, but there are new horizons that are waiting for us. I would like to offer you my helping hand in case of previously mentioned languages. And the main thing that I work on is actual speaking of the language, so I create those magical conditions for you to feel the freedom of speaking with the variety of methods. Ad fontes! I look forward to hearing from you Cordially yours, Demi

pro_course_detail.title: 📚 Test-Ready English - IELTS, TOEFL, and exam strategies that work
pro_course_detail.description:
IELTS and TOEFL are aimed at people who want to study in an English-speaking environment, work in or emigrate to an English-speaking country, or get a job in your own country where English proficiency is required. The Exam Preparation lessons are focused on; 

1. Listening - This section assesses how well you understand ideas, recognise opinions and follow the development of an argument.

2. Reading - This section assesses how well you read for general sense, main ideas and details, and whether you understand the author's inferences and opinions.

3. Writing - This section evaluates how well and how accurately you organise your ideas and write a response, along with your ability to use wide-ranging vocabulary and grammar.

Speaking - This section assesses how well you can communicate opinions and information on everyday topics and common experiences, as well as how you express and justify your opinions.

Online Teaching and Learning - I know exactly how to structure my lessons within an online environment for optimal benefit to my students.

teacher_info.about_teacher: I try to meet my students where they are when it comes to their level. I've had students of ages ranging from 2 up to 65, so it always excites me to find different ways to build that rapport that creates the most productive atmosphere for classes. I am patient - you have to be to work with 2-year-olds - and creative, so I'll definitely do my best for you to enjoy studying with me.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My objective  is to make sure that my students live the classroom with more knowledge about the language as well as more confidence to move forward. In my first years, I worked with more or less old-fashioned teaching methods which explored language acquisition primarily through grammar and reading. However, the last seven years I have been building my lessons around the Conversational approach, getting my students to express themselves to their best ability while also making sure that they get enough general knowledge necessary to continue growing. 

And I love to throw a few games in the process. Languages should scare people off, so making the whole thing as fun as it can get is my goal.

course_info.trial_description:
In our trial lesson, my goal is to understand you — your background, your motivation for learning English, and the specific areas where you want to improve.  
We’ll start with a relaxed conversation so I can learn who you are, where you’re from, and how you use English in your daily life. From there, I’ll ask a few focused questions about your goals, challenges, and the skills you want to strengthen (speaking, confidence, vocabulary, fluency, pronunciation, etc.).

Once I understand your needs, I’ll give you a clear plan for how we can work together. I also like to give each student a small, personalized task to complete before our next class — something practical that helps you build confidence and stay motivated. Many students find this helpful and often return excited to show their progress.

By the end of the trial, you’ll know exactly what to expect from future lessons and how we can work together to help you grow in English.

pro_course_detail.title: American English Coach | Learn Real Language, Real Culture, Real Confidence
pro_course_detail.description:
This class is designed to help you speak English naturally and confidently by learning the real language and real culture behind American English.  
In each lesson, we focus on practical communication, cultural understanding, and the specific skills you want to improve. Whether you need help with fluency, vocabulary, pronunciation, confidence, or everyday conversation, I tailor every session to your goals.

We’ll explore how American culture shapes the way English is spoken — expressions, tone, humor, small talk, social norms, and the “hidden rules” that textbooks don’t teach. This helps you sound more natural, understand native speakers better, and communicate with confidence in real situations.

Every lesson includes personalized feedback and a small task designed to help you improve between classes. These tasks are simple, practical, and based on your level — for example, preparing questions for our next conversation, practicing a short reading, or trying a real‑life English activity. Students often return excited to show their progress, and these tasks help you build momentum quickly.

By the end of each class, you’ll know exactly what you’re improving, why it matters, and how to continue growing in American English with clarity and confidence.

pro_course_detail.title: Kids English Lesson (Ages 3–18) — Patient, Fun, and Confidence‑Building
pro_course_detail.description:
A fun, patient, and confidence‑building English lesson designed especially for young learners.

I truly love working with children — I see my own son in every child I teach. Because of that, I bring patience, warmth, and clear communication to every lesson. I speak in a way your child can understand, no matter their age or level, so they always feel safe, supported, and excited to learn.

What your child will learn
Everyday vocabulary and simple sentences

Listening and speaking skills

Pronunciation and confidence

Reading practice (for older kids)

Creative expression through games and stories

How the lesson works
Each class follows a predictable, child‑friendly routine:
Warm‑up → Vocabulary → Speaking activity → Mini‑task → Review

I use pictures, games, storytelling, movement, and real‑life objects to keep your child engaged and smiling.

After each lesson
Parents receive a short progress update, new vocabulary, and a simple practice activity to help reinforce learning at home.

My teaching style
I’m extremely patient, gentle, and energetic. I adapt every lesson to your child’s personality, attention span, and learning style so they feel confident and proud of their progress.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Coaching — Pass the Test with Real Practice Lessons
pro_course_detail.description:
A focused, structured IELTS preparation lesson designed to help you improve your score with real exam practice and clear, step‑by‑step guidance.

I use authentic IELTS lessons and materials that I’ve successfully used to help many students pass the exam. Every lesson is practical, targeted, and built around the exact skills the test measures.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English: Real American Communication, Confidence & Culture
pro_course_detail.description:
Learn how American professionals really communicate — beyond textbooks, beyond formal scripts, beyond “perfect grammar.”  
This lesson helps you speak naturally, confidently, and effectively in real U.S. workplace situations.

You’ll learn:

How Americans actually speak at work (tone, rhythm, directness, small talk, natural phrasing)

How to sound confident without sounding rude or robotic

How to understand American humor, nuance, and “hidden rules”

How to avoid sounding too formal, stiff, or unnatural

How to communicate clearly in meetings, emails, presentations, and interviews

How American workplace culture works — expectations, communication styles, hierarchy, teamwork, and social cues

How to build rapport with American colleagues and clients

How to express disagreement, ask questions, or negotiate — the American way

This is not a grammar class.
This is real American communication coaching for professionals who want to succeed in global business.

teacher_info.intro:
Hello! My name is Stanislav, but everyone calls me Stan.

I am a 50-year-old teacher from Bosnia, married, a father, a war veteran, and a Bachelor of Science graduate from the University of Toronto. I have been using English for well over 30 years, not only as a language, but as a tool for thinking, learning, teaching, and arguing politely — most of the time.

My background is a bit unusual. I am a computer engineer by trade, I also have a welder’s license, worked as an archivist, and served in the military. Because of that, I bring real-life experience, discipline, humor, and patience into my lessons. I love cats, dogs, gaming, music, movies, anime, reading, and learning new things.

As a teacher, I believe in clear explanations, critical thinking, and step-by-step progress. Students do not become fluent by magic. They improve by trying, making mistakes, asking questions, correcting those mistakes, and trying again. My job is to guide that process calmly and patiently.

My students often describe me as kind, funny, patient, and easy to talk to. I enjoy interactive lessons with real conversation, useful vocabulary, honest opinions, and questions that make students think. However, I can also be structured and “old school” when needed: grammar, textbooks, exercises, correction, and repetition.

My goal is simple: to help you become more confident, more precise, and more natural in English — one useful step at a time.

Improve reading and listening comprehension

Practice expressing opinions clearly and naturally

Prepare for exams or interviews in a relaxed but focused way

Build vocabulary and confidence with every lesson

Each session includes:

A short reading or listening task

Follow-up questions that test your understanding

Opinion-based speaking prompts (nothing too scary—just real-life thinking!)

By the end, I want you not only to sound fluent, but to *think* fluently.

pro_course_detail.title: Coffee talk with Stan - come on in, sit down, take a load off
pro_course_detail.description:
No scripts. No textbooks. No artificial “dialogue practice.” You bring the topic, you set the tone.
I want "Coffee Talk with Stan" to be the kind of conversation you’d have over a quiet cup of coffee with someone who actually listens.
You speak freely. You say what you think. You make mistakes — and that’s fine. I help you express your ideas clearly, naturally, and confidently.
We talk about life, work, travel, culture, strange stories, philosophy, daily frustrations, and everything in between.
The goal is simple:
to help you feel at home in English — not like you're performing it.
Bring your thoughts. Bring your opinions. Bring your real self.
We’ll talk.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English: Speak and Improve (B1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
Practice English through real conversations while building your personal language resource.

How it works:

Each class, we discuss topics that interest you:

- Your life and experiences
- Current events and news
- Articles, videos, or podcasts (read/watch beforehand or together)
- Questions, debates, and ideas

As we talk, I listen for useful vocabulary you need, errors worth fixing, and phrases that make you sound more natural. We pause occasionally to work on these, then continue the conversation.

Your language grows:

Every class, we update a shared Google Document with:

- New vocabulary from our discussion
- Grammar corrections
- Native-speaker phrases and expressions
- Useful collocations

Over time, this becomes your personalized phrasebook.

Perfect for:

- Intermediate to advanced speakers (B1-C2)
- Anyone needing regular speaking practice
- Students who want natural conversation, not textbook exercises
- Learners who want to sound more fluent and accurate

You'll improve:

- Speaking confidence and fluency
- Natural vocabulary and expressions
- Grammar accuracy through gentle correction
- Listening skills

Send me a message or book a trial class today!

pro_course_detail.title: English Foundations (A1-B1)
pro_course_detail.description:
Learn English systematically while getting personalized support for your unique needs.

The approach:

This class follows a complete textbook curriculum that takes you from beginner (A1) to intermediate (B1). Each lesson combines structured learning with real conversation, ensuring you build solid skills while practicing what matters to you.
What happens in class:

- Work through textbook lessons (grammar, vocabulary, skills)
- Practice speaking and conversation every lesson
- Address your specific questions and challenges
- Adjust our focus based on what you need most
- Track your progress with clear goals

Perfect for learners who:

- Want a clear path from beginner to intermediate
- Need structure but also flexibility
- Want to improve speaking, listening, reading, and writing
- Prefer one-on-one personalized attention
- Are building general English before specializing (business, travel, exams, etc.)

My teaching style:

Patient, supportive, and adaptable. I create a comfortable space where you can make mistakes and learn from them. We follow the textbook to ensure steady progress, but I always make time for real conversation and the things YOU need to work on.

You'll gain:

- Confidence speaking English
- Strong grammar and vocabulary foundation
- Better listening and reading skills
- Practical communication abilities
- A learning plan designed for your goals

Ready to take the next step in your English journey? Send me a message or book a trial lesson!

pro_course_detail.title: Business English in Action (B1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description: Business English in Action is a personalized course designed around you — your job, your goals, and the real situations you face at work. Perfect for intermediate to advanced non-native professionals working in fields like finance, tech, marketing, healthcare, or international trade. We start with a needs analysis so every lesson is relevant from day one. Using a task-based approach crafted by an experienced Business English teacher, you'll practice the skills that actually matter: leading meetings, delivering presentations, negotiating deals, writing professional emails, and navigating job interviews — all through realistic role plays and scenarios drawn from your professional world. No generic textbook exercises. Just targeted, practical English that helps you perform with confidence at work.

pro_course_detail.title: English with TV Series & Movies (A2-C1)
pro_course_detail.description: Your favorite shows and films aren't just entertainment — they're some of the best English teachers out there. In this class, we use scenes from the TV series and movies _you_ already love as the launchpad for real, meaningful language practice. We'll dig into how characters speak, argue, joke and persuade; dissect accents, slang and subtext; and bring scenes to life through role-play, improv and performance. It's active, creative and genuinely fun — and that's not just good luck, it's good science. Task-based learning and comprehensible input are among the most well-supported approaches in language acquisition research, and using content you're emotionally invested in accelerates vocabulary retention, improves pronunciation and builds the kind of confident, natural fluency that textbooks rarely can. Whether you're obsessed with Friends, Succession, a telenovela dubbed in English or the latest Netflix hit, we'll make it work. Bring your favorite show — we'll do the rest.

pro_course_detail.title: English Language features GCSE Language
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is based around English Language features including similes, metaphors, onomatopoeia and alliteration. It also comprises of answering foundation, and slightly more intense questions to test your understanding of the content taught; including questions where you have to pick out the features from a paragraph then we discuss your answers and chart your progress session by session. It is mainly geared towards GCSE English (a British qualification) but can also apply to many other qualifications. I cover both AQA and Edexcel exam boards and focus in on exam technique, mainly for year 10 and 11, in order to gain as many marks as possible. We look at past papers and I get students to make an attempt, then provide comprehensive feedback on their writing. We then examine our responses and look at areas where we can write a better answer in order to have a great response to a lengthy question.
Just ask!

pro_course_detail.description:
Preparation for the First Certificate in English. Reading, Writing, Speaking, Grammar and Listening.
 We will be practicing on authentic material for the Reading comprehension part of the test. 
Learn about all types of writing that are required for the test and how to write properly. 
Learn speaking expressions and practice pronunciation and what is expected of you from examiners. 
Practice listening and learn tips and tricks on how not to be intimidated by the listening exam. 
Explain grammar rules and practice common use of English tasks.
For the General English course you can choose which one of the five skill you would like to improve and we will focus on that.

pro_course_detail.title: CAE
pro_course_detail.description:
The Cambridge CAE is at CERF level C1. 
The format is the same as in FCE so there is Speaking, Listening, Reading, Writing and Grammar; only at this level we will be focussing on expanding our vocabulary - synonyms, antonyms - and practicing more specific grammar items, like passive voice, mixed conditionals, inversion and clauses.

pro_course_detail.title: CPE
pro_course_detail.description:
CPE is at CERF level C2. 
Again there will be practice on the test format. Listening, Speaking, Writing, Reading and Use of English. 
Proficiency is a lot of vocabulary exercises and a deeper understanding of the English language. It is English at academic level; the difference between spoken and written English.

pro_course_detail.title: A1-A2 -Beginner courses
pro_course_detail.description:
Beginner courses are the basic tenses of English language. Present Simple, Present Continuous, Past Simple, Past Continuous, Present Perfect, Present Perfect Continuous, Past Perfect, Past Perfect Continuous, Future Simple, Future Continuous, Future Perfect, Future Perfect Continuous and Be going to. 
And simple every day vocabulary.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS
pro_course_detail.description:
There are two IELTS exams, one is Academic and the other is General Training. 
There is a scale and your target should be the scale that is required of you from the organisation you are applying to. 
We will focus on general English Grammar and vocabulary but we will also practice the specific tasks that the test requires, aiming at a higher score than the one set by the institution you are targeting.

pro_course_detail.title: 💵 Język angielski w biznesie 💵
pro_course_detail.description: Kurs przygotowujący ucznia do posługiwania się językiem angielskim w środowisku biznesowym. Idealnie sprawdzi się dla osób, którym zależy na pomyślnym przejściu rozmowy kwalifikacyjnej (job interview) w języku obcym, rozwinięciu własnych kompetencji językowych, a także dla osób ciekawych słownictwa biznesowego. pro_course_detail.title: 🛍️ Conversational Polish Lessons (A1 - C2) 🛍️
pro_course_detail.description: If you would like to improve your conversational skills then this course is perfect for you. We will both discuss various topics of your choice and eradicate any conversational errors.

pro_course_detail.title: 🇵🇱Polski dla Początkujących / Polish for Beginners🇵🇱
pro_course_detail.description:
Kurs został stworzony z myślą o osobach, które rozpoczynają naukę języka polskiego lub wracają do niej po dłuższej przerwie. Podczas zajęć będziemy pracować z podręcznikiem „Polski na dobry start” na poziomie A1. Po każdym spotkaniu uczeń otrzyma zdjęcie kart pracy, aby samodzielnie utrwalić słownictwo z lekcji.

The course is designed for people who are beginning to learn Polish or returning to it after a longer break. During the classes, we will work with the textbook "Polski na dobry start" at the A1 level. After each session, the student will receive a photo of the worksheets to independently review and reinforce the vocabulary from the lesson.

Курс створено для людей, які починають вивчати польську мову або повертаються до неї після тривалої перерви. Під час занять ми працюватимемо з підручником «Polski na dobry start» рівня A1. Після кожного заняття студент отримає фото з робочих аркушів, щоб самостійно закріпити лексику з уроку.

pro_course_detail.title: 📚Polski dla Średniozaawansowanych (A2 / B2/ Polish for Intermediate Students (A2 / B2)📚
pro_course_detail.description:
Kurs przeznaczony jest dla osób, które opanowały podstawy języka polskiego i chcą rozwijać swoje umiejętności w zakresie komunikacji codziennej. Skupiamy się na poszerzaniu słownictwa, poprawnej gramatyce oraz budowaniu dłuższych wypowiedzi ustnych i pisemnych przy pomocy podręcznika pt. "Polski na Dobry Start" na poziomie A2/B2. Po każdym spotkaniu uczeń otrzymuję karty pracy do wypełnienie, aby utrwalić słownictwo oraz gramatykę.

The course is intended for people who have mastered the basics of the Polish language and want to develop their everyday communication skills. We focus on expanding vocabulary, improving grammar, and building longer spoken and written statements using the textbook "Polski na dobry start" at the A2/B2 level. After each session, the student receives worksheets to complete in order to reinforce vocabulary and grammar.

Курс призначений для тих, хто вже опанував основи польської мови й хоче розвивати свої навички повсякденного спілкування. Ми зосереджуємося на розширенні словникового запасу, вдосконаленні граматики та побудові довших усних і письмових висловлювань за допомогою підручника «Polski na dobry start» рівня A2/B2. Після кожного заняття студент отримує робочі аркуші для заповнення, щоб закріпити лексику та граматику.

teacher_info.intro:
Hi and welcome! I'm native Russian speaker + Italian teacher + I speak English, French, a bit Turkish. Former TV editor who now helps people survive Russian grammar—basically the same stress, but less tears involved.
I love music (studied academic vocal, but then decided to stop torturing neighbours), sport & existential crises. I host a podcast in Russian about inspiring women, wrote a book about femme fatale.
Also, I'm part mermaid 🧜‍♀️ Freediving, swimming, anything with water... Oh, and I sail. 
Fun fact: Moscow is a "port of five seas" thanks to Soviet engineering. Ridiculous? Yes. Love it? Absolutely. 
Lessons will be surely very boring and painful. Dark humor upon request

I strive to build my lessons around each student’s interests, needs, and goals, creating a learning process that feels both effective and enjoyable. For me, learning a language is much more than memorizing grammar or vocabulary — it is a way to discover new ways of thinking, better understand other people and cultures, and expand the way we see the world.

I enjoy creating lessons that go beyond textbooks. I often recommend podcasts, documentaries, interviews, and lectures, because authentic content helps language come alive. In our lessons, we talk not only about the language itself, but also about history, culture, psychology, travel, and everyday life.

pro_course_detail.title: Italian for English speakers
pro_course_detail.description:

pro_course_detail.description:

Знакомство с русским языком через музыку! На уроках мы:

Поем и работаем над произношением

pro_course_detail.title: Fitness & Wellness Russian
pro_course_detail.description:

Workout vocabulary and gym commands
Body parts and anatomy terms
Nutrition and healthy lifestyle discussions
Pilates, running – whatever moves you!

Perfect for fitness professionals, athletes, or anyone passionate about wellness who wants to discuss their interests in Russian. Lessons focus on natural conversation, not grammar drills.

pro_course_detail.title: Literature & Poetry Russian
pro_course_detail.description:
For B1+ students ready to discuss Russian literature in Russian. We'll read excerpts from classic and contemporary works, then dive into conversations about:

Themes, characters, and cultural context
Your personal interpretations and reactions
Connections between literature and Russian life

Bring your favorite Russian authors or discover new ones together. This is about meaningful conversation, not translation exercises.
