course_info.trial_description:
Not sure where to start? 

This is the perfect first step. In this lesson we get to know each other, talk about your English goals, and do a short practice session together. I want to understand exactly where you are now and where you want to be so I can build lessons that actually work for you. 

Whether you are a complete beginner or an experienced professional looking to sharpen your communication, this session gives us both a chance to see if we are a good fit.

No preparation needed. Just come ready to have a conversation and we will take it from there.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English for Professionals
pro_course_detail.description:
The difference between a good professional and a great one is often how clearly they communicate.

This lesson is built for professionals who need English that actually works in the real world. Not textbook English. Not classroom English. The kind of English that closes deals, leads meetings, and builds credibility with clients and colleagues.

We work on the language and communication skills that matter most in your specific role. Meetings, presentations, negotiations, client conversations, status updates, difficult conversations with leadership. Real scenarios, real vocabulary, real practice.

With 20 years of experience leading teams across Canada and Europe in healthcare, technology, and business, I know what professional English actually sounds like under pressure. I will help you sound confident, clear, and credible in every business situation you face.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English
pro_course_detail.description:
The best way to get better at speaking English is simple. Speak more English.

This lesson is all about real conversation. No grammar drills, no memorizing rules, no boring exercises. Just two people talking about interesting topics at your level and pace.
We can talk about anything that interests you. Travel, sports, movies, food, culture, current events, your work, your life. The topic does not matter as much as the practice. Every conversation builds your fluency, expands your vocabulary, and makes you more comfortable expressing yourself naturally.

I correct you gently during conversation without breaking your flow. You learn by doing, not by stopping every two minutes to discuss grammar rules.

Whether you are a complete beginner saying your first English sentences or an advanced speaker looking to sound more natural and fluent, this lesson meets you exactly where you are.

pro_course_detail.title: Interview Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
Job interviews are nerve wracking enough without worrying about your English.

This lesson is designed to get you ready for the real thing. We practice the most common interview questions, work on how to structure your answers clearly and confidently, and focus on the specific vocabulary and phrases that make a strong impression on interviewers.

We also work on the softer side of interviews. How to sound natural under pressure, how to handle unexpected questions, how to speak about your experience in a way that is compelling and memorable.

With experience coaching professionals across healthcare, technology, and business environments, I understand what employers are looking for and how to help you communicate your value clearly and confidently.

By the end of our sessions you will walk into your interview feeling prepared, focused, and ready to perform at your best.

pro_course_detail.title: Beginner English
pro_course_detail.description:
Every expert was once a beginner. The most important step is simply getting started
.
This lesson is designed specifically for students who are just starting their English journey or who know a little English but want to build a stronger foundation. We go slowly, clearly, and at a pace that feels comfortable for you.

We focus on the basics that matter most. Simple vocabulary for everyday situations, essential phrases for common conversations, and the confidence to actually use what you are learning in real life.

I keep everything simple, encouraging, and practical. No complicated grammar explanations. No overwhelming vocabulary lists. Just clear, useful English that you can start using immediately.

30 or 60 minute sessions are perfect for beginners. Focused, manageable, and effective without feeling overwhelming. Every lesson builds on the last one and your progress will surprise you.

pro_course_detail.title: Pronunciation and Fluency
pro_course_detail.description:
You know the words. You understand English well. But when you speak, something does not feel quite right.

This lesson is for students who want to sound more natural, more confident, and more fluent in English. We focus specifically on pronunciation, rhythm, stress, and intonation. The things that make English sound natural rather than stilted or robotic.

We work through real words and phrases that come up in your daily life, practicing the sounds that are most challenging for speakers of your native language. I help you understand not just how to say something correctly but why it sounds the way it does.

Fluency is not about speaking fast. It is about speaking smoothly, naturally, and with confidence. By the end of our sessions you will notice a real difference in how comfortable and natural your English sounds to other people.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Information Technology and Digital Professionals
pro_course_detail.description:
Technology moves fast. Your English needs to keep up.

This lesson is built for IT professionals, software developers, cloud architects, SaaS teams, AI practitioners, digital health specialists, and anyone working in fast moving technical environments who needs to communicate with clarity, precision, and confidence.

Whether you are presenting a cloud migration strategy to executive leadership, explaining an AI solution to a non-technical client, participating in an agile sprint or scrum meeting, writing technical documentation, managing a SaaS implementation, or navigating stakeholder conversations in a complex digital environment: how you communicate is just as important as what you know.

With 20 years of hands-on experience across healthcare IT, enterprise technology, government digital programs, and international business in Canada and Europe, I have worked across the full technology stack from clinical systems and interoperability to cloud platforms, project delivery, and emerging technologies. I follow the industry closely and stay current across AI, SaaS, cloud computing, and digital transformation trends.

We focus on technical vocabulary in context, communication across technical and non-technical audiences, presentation and documentation skills, meeting and stakeholder communication, and the professional English that makes you stand out in any digital environment.

Real scenarios, real terminology, and real practice built around your specific technology environment and career goals.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Project and Program Management Professionals
pro_course_detail.description:
In project and program management, how you communicate is just as important as what you deliver.

This lesson is built for project and program management professionals who need English that leads, aligns, and drives results. Whether you are presenting a business case to a steering committee, managing stakeholder expectations, facilitating a team meeting, negotiating scope and timelines, or writing a project status report, the way you communicate directly impacts your outcomes.

We work on the language of leadership and delivery. How to present project updates with clarity and confidence, how to manage difficult conversations with stakeholders, how to communicate risks and issues without causing panic, and how to facilitate meetings that actually move things forward.

We also focus on the everyday communication that separates good project managers from great ones. Emails that get action, status reports that are read, and conversations that build trust across teams and cultures.

Real scenarios, real PM vocabulary and terminology, and real practice built around your specific role, methodology, and industry.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
The goal of this lesson is to practice your conversational skills with a Native English speaker. In these lessons, I will help you to facilitate a sense of ease and confidence with your abilities to speak and listen. There are various topics that we can discuss during this class. While we converse, we will also be able to take notes on grammar, pronunciation, and interesting expressions to use. Class time will be fun, easygoing, and most of all, a way for you to feel comfortable speaking, writing, and listening in English.


*****IMPORTANT NOTES*****
     (1) These lessons are most suitable for students that have a B1 or HIGHER conversational English level. If you think you are a beginner or low-intermediate (A1-A2), please send me a message before booking a class with me, as I will strongly recommend to book a PERSONALIZED GENERAL LESSONS instead. 
     (2) If you are booking a class for your CHILD, please contact me before booking as we will need to discuss their age, level, and learning plan. All lessons with kids and teens should be booked under "ENGLISH FOR KIDS AND TEENS."
     (3) For communication platforms, please do NOT book 45-minute or 1-hour lessons on ZOOM, as I am limited to 40-minute meetings only. If you have already done so, please contact me right away so we can choose another platform for our lesson. :)


Absences and Lateness Policies: 
If you plan to be late or miss a lesson, please message me beforehand. I am very accommodating to last-minute cancelations/tardiness for any reason with PRIOR NOTICE (as these things also happen to me!).  If you have not notified me before the start of the lesson, I will wait up to 10 minutes past the scheduled lesson time for you to arrive. Late arrivals after 10 minutes will be considered as an absence, and we will not be able to reschedule or recover the lesson.

teacher_info.intro:
👋 Hi, I’m Mariam—a linguist (BA) and educator (MA) with 10+ years of experience. I specialize in helping children and professionals unlock their English potential—improving grammar, building fluency in daily communication, mastering industry-specific English for professionals, e.g. pharmaceutical English, preparing for interviews, and advancing their careers.

My journey began as a volunteer, continued with a school internship, and grew through university lecturing and my work as a Development and Education Quality Assurance Officer. I now work as a trainer in education.

pro_course_detail.title: General English course for young adults and adults
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is ideal for students who want to start learning general English or take their skills to the next level. I teach all CEFR levels and provide high-quality materials, including PDF textbooks, audio and video files, and interactive presentations.

We will focus on improving your reading, speaking, listening, and writing skills in a practical and enjoyable way. I’m also happy to work with your own materials to ensure lessons perfectly meet your needs.

pro_course_detail.title: Pharmaceutical English course
pro_course_detail.description:
If you’re planning to become a pharmacist—or already are—or if you work in any related healthcare profession, this course is for you.

Whether you need English to communicate effectively in the pharmaceutical industry or handle day-to-day interactions in a professional healthcare setting, I can help. This course is designed to support pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, medical researchers, and other healthcare professionals who need practical, industry-specific English skills. 

I provide all necessary materials, including PDFs, audio and video files, and I’m happy to work with your own materials as well.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English course for teenagers and young adults and adults
pro_course_detail.description:
If you want to speak English confidently, this course will help you build fluency in a fun and practical way!

You’ll develop your skills using top-quality materials while exploring a wide range of topics — from daily life and travel to current events and settling abroad. Lessons are fully tailored to your interests and goals, and we can also focus on any specific topics or materials you choose.

I provide all the necessary resources, including PDFs, audio and video files, and I’m always happy to work with your own materials to make the lessons as relevant and effective as possible.

pro_course_detail.title: English for kids and teenagers
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is perfect for children and teenagers who want to begin learning English or take their skills to the next level. Lessons focus on building a solid foundation in grammar, reading, writing, and listening, with special emphasis on developing confident conversational skills.

I’m happy to work with your own school materials to support classroom learning, or I can provide my own carefully selected materials and audio and video files to make lessons structured, accessible, and enjoyable.

pro_course_detail.title: Business Communication (job interviews, meetings, negotiations, etc.)
pro_course_detail.description:
If you’re planning to improve your English for job interviews or to get ahead at work, this multi-level course is for you. It offers extensive communication and language practice to help you develop the business communication skills you need for negotiations and meetings.

The course is suitable for a wide range of learners, as it addresses the language and communication needs of both job seekers and employees in various fields.

I will provide all the necessary materials, including PDFs and audio and video files, and if you need specific materials for your field or role, I’m happy to work with those as well.

course_info.trial_description:

Next, the teacher will mention sets of two words each and the student will choose one quickly. (e.g.: Mountain-beach // camp-hotel // winter-summer//etc.) Then the teacher and the student will maintain a conversation with the words chosen by the student.

pro_course_detail.title: Best holidays

Next , the teacher will mention some groups of two words and the student will choose one quickly. Then , both will maintain a conversationabout the words chosen by the student. Finally, the student will take part in a role play in which he/she will be a travel agent and will sell the best holidays ever to the teacher.

pro_course_detail.title: 🌟 CHILDREN'S Lessons
pro_course_detail.description:
Is your child learning English or do you want to give them a boost of confidence in their SPEAKING, LISTENING, WRITING and READING skills? My lessons are designed especially for children as they combine FUN ACTIVITIES and STRUCTURED LEARNING that supports their schoolwork and provides results. 

With my background in primary education, I know how to make the English engaging and achieve progress. 

🌟 Lesson inclusions:

✅ Speaking practice through puzzles, games and stories, with pronunciation focus. 
✅ Reading activities to suit their age and level. 
✅ Writing and spelling practice. 
✅ Clear learning goals to see your child's progress. 
✅ Homework to help and guide practice. 

✨Lesson Options
 
📖 30 minutes - for younger children with shorter attention spans. 
📖 45 minutes - for a balanced session of reading, speaking, spelling and reviewing, 
📖 60 minutes - for older children and more advanced learners.

pro_course_detail.title: 🗝️ ADULT English Mastery
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you ready to take your English to the next level?
These lessons are designed for adults who want to understand the rules of English, sharpen pronunciation, and strengthen every skill—reading, writing, listening, and speaking.

Each session is more structured than a casual conversation class and includes:
✅ Clear explanations of English grammar with practical examples.
✅ Focused pronunciation work to improve clarity and confidence.
✅ Targeted vocabulary and usage exercises to expand your range.
✅ Integrated skills practice—listening, speaking, reading, and writing—through engaging activities.
✅ Personalised feedback and homework to reinforce what you learn.

With an emphasis on accurate language use and real communication, you’ll build the knowledge and confidence to express yourself naturally and correctly in any setting.

Whether your goal is professional growth, smoother travel, or simply feeling more at ease in English, these lessons provide the structure, practice, and expert guidance to help you succeed.

pro_course_detail.title: 🎯 IELTS Exam Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you preparing for the IELTS exam or looking to strengthen your advanced English skills? 

These classes are designed to help you achieve your target score while building confidence in all areas: reading, writing, listening, and speaking. 

These lesson are MORE STRUCTURED than the conversation classes. Each includes: 
✅ Structured practice tailored to your level and goals. 
✅ Focused grammar and vocabulary exercises for academic and formal English. 
✅ Exam strategies and tips for each section of the IELTS. 
✅ Homework booklet and feedback to ensure steady progress. 
✅ Personalised guidance on improving speed, accuracy, and fluency. 

With a strong emphasis on PRACTICAL LANGUAGE and exam preparation, you will gain skills and confidence to perform under real exam conditions. Lessons are interactive, goal-oriented, and designed to help you improve quickly. 

Whether your goal is university admissions, professional advancement, migration, or personal achievement, these lessons will give you the tools, structure and support you need to succeed. Every session is tailored to your needs, ensuring that you will get that most out of your study time.

pro_course_detail.title: ✨Project Power English - Learn through creating
pro_course_detail.description:
🚀 Create. Collaborate. Communicate.

Turn your English practice into something REAL! In this dynamic lesson you’ll team up to plan, design, and present a mini-project — anything from a short podcast 🎙️ to a travel guide 🌍, a colorful digital poster 🎨, or even write and illustrate your own children’s book 📚🧸

✅ Build speaking confidence
✅ Sharpen writing & listening skills
✅ Learn practical vocab while having fun

🎯 Goal: Finish with a polished project you can proudly share—and English you can actually use outside class!

These classes are best booked in packages to ensure that the project is finished at the end of those sessions. Additionally, homework will be involved. 

* I do not guarantee that the finished product will be successful for resale purposes or making money, it is merely a fun, different learning opportunity for English.

pro_course_detail.title: 👥💬 CONVERSATION Lessons
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to feel more confident when speaking English? These classes are designed to help you practice real conversation while also improving your grammar, vocabulary, and fluency.

Each lesson includes:
✅ A short article or text to spark discussion
✅ Key vocabulary and useful expressions
✅ On the spot corrections of vocabulary choices and grammar points
✅ Lots of speaking practice in a supportive environment

The goal is to give you the tools and confidence to use English naturally in everyday situations, at work, or while travelling. The sessions balance structured learning with free-flowing conversation, so you build accuracy and fluency at the same time.

✨ What you’ll gain:

Confidence speaking with clarity
Expanded vocabulary for everyday and professional contexts
Stronger grammar skills through practice, not memorisation
The ability to express your thoughts and opinions in English with ease

Whether you’re preparing for a new job, studying abroad, or just want to speak more comfortably, these classes will help you achieve your goals while keeping learning engaging and practical.

By focusing on topics they are interested in and making English learning a game, children can sometimes "forget" that they are taking classes and become interested in getting better at English in order to win the games :)

pro_course_detail.title: English: Adult Beginners level 0 to A2
pro_course_detail.description:
Hello!

We can use pictures, videos and pantomime to help you learn important English words and phrases.

In my experience, the best lesson structure is when you choose a movie for us to talk about and later during the lesson you describe the story and your observations (what you liked/disliked) while I ask you questions, correct your grammar and teach you new words.
Please send me a message telling me the movie's title before the lesson time, so that I can ask the right questions and help you if you need help.

But of course that's optional! We can also just have a fun conversation :)

*To Hebrew speakers: 
I avoid using any language other then English as much possible for you to achieve the most progress during our lessons. So while you can speak Hebrew, I will reply in English.

pro_course_detail.title: Hebrew: One-on-one conversational practice for (Adult) beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
Shalom! !שלום

If you want to come to Israel for vacation or to make Aliyah, why not pick up a couple of key words and phrases before landing at the ''Ben Gurion" airport?

We will: Introduce ourselves, talk about your topics of interest and role-play common everyday situations (such as going to the store for example).

If you have any questions about Israeli culture and what it is like to live here, I will be happy to answer them! :)

pro_course_detail.title: Hebrew: One-on-one conversational practice for children (ages 6 -14)
pro_course_detail.description:
We will communicate with the use of pantomime, pictures, crafts and songs doing our best to speak only in Hebrew.

We will learn simple new words and form fun and memorable sentences!

Is there a topic your child can talk about for hours or even days? 

Animals? Art? Cartoons?

Let me know! So we can talk about it in Hebrew :)

* Note: I only do one-on-one lessons, I do not teach more than 1 child at a time.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational lessons in Croatian
pro_course_detail.description:
Bok!

For people who are interested in visiting the sunny beaches of the Croatian islands, touring around the old castles or coming home to visit family it is good to know at least little bit of the language.

These lessons will be focused on helping you learn new words and phrases and practice pronunciation and grammar.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational lessons in Serbian

Zdravo!

Serbia is a country with beautiful mountains and rivers, welcoming people and delicious food.

These lessons will be focused on helping you learn how to read and write using the Cyrillic script, learn new words and phrases and practice pronunciation and grammar.

course_info.trial_description:
First, tell me if you want IELTS Speaking OR Writing for our first lesson

Speaking Option
- Our first speaking lesson will start with a diagnostic, mock speaking exam. This is the best way to immediately identify your strengths & weakness to make a plan moving forward. During this lesson you will get VERY specific feedback using the IELTS Speaking Band Descriptor so you understand approximately how you're doing. This will also give us time for very detailed feedback as well as some strategies to deal with your issues. Plus, there will be a little extra time at the end of class for a bit more practice.

Writing Option
- Our first writing lesson will start with a diagnostic evaluation. You will be required to submit samples of your IELTS writing BEFORE the class so we can discuss them during the lesson. This is the best way to immediately identify your strengths & weakness to make a plan moving forward. During the lesson, you will get very specific feedback using the IELTS Writing Band Descriptor so you understand approximately how you're doing. We can do either General or Academic writing, Task 1, Task 2 or both.

Once we've completed the trial, we can decide how I can help you to improve your Band Score with the language you already have.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Preparation - Speaking
pro_course_detail.description:
If this is your first lesson with me, we will start with a diagnostic speaking exam. This is the best way to immediately identify your strengths & weaknesses in order to make a plan moving forward. During this lesson you will get very specific feedback using the IELTS Speaking Band Descriptor so you understand approximately how your doing. 
- In a 30-minute diagnostic, you will do a mock test with somewhat limited feedback and no additional practice or strategies. This might just be a good way to practice with a general idea of your approximate level or to see if you like my teaching style. 
- In a 60-minute diagnostic, we have have more time for even much detailed feedback as well as some strategies to deal with your specific issues. Plus, there will be a little extra time at the end of class for a bit more practice.

After you have completed a diagnostic lesson, ALL FUTURE LESSONS ARE 60 MINUTES. Our classes will focus on Speaking Exam Preparation Skills so you will understand what is expected during the test. These skills include, but are not limited to: 
- Giving structured responses
- Displaying grammatical knowledge
- Paraphrasing

In each class, I will introduce you to the specific skill and give you plenty of opportunity to practice it. I will never promise you a certain Band Score, but I promise you will better be able to achieve a score representative of your actual level.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Preparation - Writing
pro_course_detail.description:
If this is your first lesson with me, we will start with a diagnostic writing evaluation. You will be required to submit a sample/samples of your IELTS writing before the class so we can discuss them during the lesson. This is the best way to immediately identify your strengths & weaknesses to make a plan moving forward. 

During the lesson, you will get very specific feedback using the IELTS Writing Band Descriptor so you understand approximately how you're doing. We can do either General or Academic writing, Task 1 or Task 2
- a 30-minute diagnostic will involve one writing sample; either Task 1 or Task 2. NOT both. 
- a 60-minute diagnostic will allow for two writing samples; typically it is most useful to do one Task 1 and one Task 2

After doing a diagnostic, ALL FUTURE LESSONS WILL BE 60 MINUTES. Any individual lessons or lesson packages might include a number of specific skills necessary to meet the IELTS assessment criteria. These include, but are not limited to:
- Maintaining consistent and appropriate tone
- Addressing the requirements of the task
- Presenting a clear purpose
- Logical organization 
- Paragraphing
- Demonstrating a range of cohesive devices

In each class, I will introduce a certain skill, then give you the opportunity to practice it during a live writing activity and assign homework based on the lesson. Of note, I use GoogleDocs for teaching, so if you are from China you will need a VPN to participate in my writing lessons.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Preparation - Reading
pro_course_detail.description:
Reading is often ignored by most students. However, it is a skill which still needs to be practiced. Generally, it is something you can do on your own with self-study materials, although a little help would be beneficial. 

In this reading lesson, we'll look at skills like "Skimming & Scanning" to speed up your answering, as well as a few other tips & tricks to ensure you're following the IELTS format. Of course... with some practice.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Preparation - Listening
pro_course_detail.description:
Listening is often ignored by most students. However, it is a skill which still needs to be practiced. Generally, it is something you can do on your own with self-study materials, although a little help would be beneficial. 

In this listening lesson, we'll look at the main reason IELTS listening tasks are so complicated, as well as a few other tips & tricks to ensure you're following the IELTS format. Of course... with some practice.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Preparation mixed-skills package
pro_course_detail.description:
***This package is ONLY meant for students who book the 5-lesson package, DO NOT book it for a single lesson***

This package will mix a couple of exam skills together. 

For example, maybe we notice you need a lot of help with your writing, but a bit of feedback on your speaking too– then we’ll do 4 writing and 1 speaking classes. Maybe, we identify that your speaking is a little weaker, but your writing needs attention too – then we’ll do 3 speaking and 2 writing lessons. Or any other combination of skills we agree would best fit your learning needs.

pro_course_detail.title: CELPIP Preparation
pro_course_detail.description: We will start with an introduction to the CELPIP speaking exam for immigration purposes to Canada. You will become familiar with the test format as well as practice some key language required and expected for each part of the speaking test.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational Russian for different levels
pro_course_detail.description: Very practical lessons. Do you remember your first conversation with a native speaker in a target language? Maybe, the epithet unforgettable is an exaggeration, but memorable is surely appropriate for this experience. Live speech is like performance or improvisation where you have a chance to apply all acquired skills and constantly improve them and learn new ones. Being understood by a native speaker brings you a feeling of achievement and inspiration. These lessons provide spontaneous communication in natural context. Grammar and vocabulary are explained. You learn how to combine words like a skillful painter combines colours so that they look natural, you sound natural, no matter what level you are now. Experience builds up your confidence step-by-step. We will discuss topics you are passionate about, you will get first-hand information without prejuce or stereotypes.  In informal lessons you, as a student and me, as a tutor possess a great deal of freedom. It is usually a benefit for both sides on all levels - educational, cultural, intellectual and emotional.

pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to speak English more confidently and naturally without overthinking every sentence? This conversation-focused lesson helps you improve fluency, pronunciation, and clarity through guided, level-appropriate discussions. Each session is structured around real-life topics so you can speak more comfortably in everyday situations, social settings, and general work conversations.

In this lesson, you will:
- practise natural conversations at your level
- expand useful vocabulary and expressions
- improve pronunciation, rhythm, and clarity
- gain confidence speaking with less hesitation
- receive clear corrections and constructive feedback

Lessons are personalised and guided to support steady improvement. This package is ideal for learners who want to speak more smoothly and confidently without pressure.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Travel – Speak with Confidence Everywhere!
pro_course_detail.description:
Planning a trip or moving to an English-speaking country? English for Travel is designed to help you communicate easily in everyday situations, whether you're booking a hotel, ordering food, asking for directions, or making new friends.

In this course, you’ll learn how to:
-Navigate airports, hotels, restaurants, and tourist attractions
-Understand common travel phrases and expressions
-Build confidence in asking for help or making small talk
-Practise listening and responding to real-life travel scenarios
-Master key vocabulary related to travelling, transport, and sightseeing

Each lesson is focused on practical English you'll use right away! I’ll guide you through travel scenarios, correct your pronunciation, and teach you the most important phrases for a smooth and stress-free trip.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English for Professionals – Meetings, Emails & Presentations
pro_course_detail.description:
Whether you’re preparing for an interview, leading meetings, or negotiating with clients, Business English will help you speak confidently and professionally in the workplace.

In this course, you’ll:
-Improve your vocabulary for business contexts (meetings, emails, negotiations, presentations, etc.)
-Learn effective business communication strategies
-Practise formal and informal business language
-Understand cultural differences and etiquette in global business settings
-Master written and spoken business communication (emails, reports, presentations)

We’ll focus on your specific business needs, whether you’re looking to improve your email communication, present ideas in meetings, or navigate difficult conversations at work.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Kids – Fun, Friendly & Full of Learning!
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want your child to learn English in a way that’s fun, engaging, and effective?

In these lessons, I create a safe and exciting space where your child will:
-Build strong vocabulary through games, songs, and stories
-Learn how to introduce themselves, ask questions, and speak confidently
-Improve listening, speaking, reading, and basic writing
-Develop natural pronunciation through repetition and practice
-Enjoy interactive activities that make learning English fun!

I adapt each lesson to your child’s age, personality, and level. Whether your child is just starting out or wants to become more fluent, I’ll guide them step by step with lots of encouragement and praise.

Your child will look forward to class every week!

pro_course_detail.description:
Work in tech but struggle to express yourself clearly in English? Let’s fix that. This class is for developers, designers, UX professionals, and remote team members who want to communicate smoothly in English, whether it's in meetings, emails, or daily conversations.

We’ll focus on:
Real tech-world vocabulary & expressions
Clear communication during meetings, demos, and team updates

Speaking with confidence even under pressure

I come from a UX/UI design background and understand the communication challenges in tech teams. My lessons are practical, relaxed, and tailored to your role.

pro_course_detail.description:

Lessons focus on all four exam skills: Speaking, Listening, Reading, and Writing, using authentic exam-style tasks. You’ll learn how to manage time, avoid common exam traps, and approach each section with confidence.

Lessons are personalised based on your level, target score, and timeline. Whether you need results for university admission, immigration, or professional requirements, we’ll follow a clear and realistic study plan.

Suitable for learners at A2 level and above.

Includes:
• Real IELTS/TOEFL-style practice tasks
• Detailed speaking and writing feedback
• Practical score-building strategies

Book a trial lesson to assess your current level and set a focused preparation plan.

teacher_info.intro:

With over 30 years’ experience as a Portuguese examiner, university tutor, and bilingual translator, I specialize in helping students master Portuguese and English for exams, business, or travel. teacher_info.intro:
Hello, my name is Sarah and I am from Canada. I have over 15 years of experience teaching English as a second language and have lived in China, Taiwan, Thailand, and Mexico. I hold a bachelor’s degree in Communications and a TEFL certification.

I love traveling and have visited more than 60 countries, with Italy, Thailand, and Spain among my favorites. Learning about different cultures, art, music, and healthy living are some of my passions.

My teaching style is patient, flexible, and focused on the individual needs of each student. I primarily teach conversational English, with an emphasis on grammar, pronunciation, vocabulary, idioms, and natural speaking skills. Whether you want to improve your English for travel, business, interviews, presentations, or everyday conversation, I am happy to help.

I work with beginner to advanced students and enjoy creating lessons that match each learner’s goals and learning style. My most popular course is my intermediate to advanced travel English course, inspired by my passion for travel and international experiences.

I look forward to helping you build confidence and improve your English in a supportive and enjoyable environment.

teacher_info.about_teacher: I enjoy getting to know my students and helping them improve their English at the same time.  I'm patient and understanding, and appreciate how effortful an hour of English can be.  I also know that speaking a foreign language can be scary, so I do my best to make students feel comfortable and provide a space for them to gain confidence and even come to enjoy English.
teacher_info.teaching_style: My lessons are quite structured in that all the mistakes a student makes are typed so we can correct them together.  The lesson notes can be studied between class and the corrected forms used in the next lesson.   Ideally, I like students to read an article, listen to a podcast or watch a video before our lesson so our conversation can be about challenging topics as well as the everyday; but I'm also happy just to chat and teach the language points that come up naturally.

course_info.trial_description: I'll ask you to speak about about yourself and perhaps about a more challenging topic.  All the while, I'll be typing your mistakes and assessing your English.   Then we'll talk about your strengths and weaknesses and what you want to achieve by taking lessons.  Finally, I'll share my screen and we'll look at the mistakes in grammar, vocabulary and pronunciation that you made during our chat, correcting them at the same time.  All these notes will be on a Google Doc that I'll share with you.  We can also work out a self-study plan and determine the approach that best suits you.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation with error correction and detailed lesson notes
pro_course_detail.description: This is a normal conversation, except that I'll be typing all your grammar, vocabulary and pronunciation mistakes.  I'll then share my screen and we'll go through them together, practising any complex grammar, difficult pronunciation and so on.  All your lessons notes will be on a Google Doc that I'll share with you, allowing for easy revision and effective progress.  I'll also be happy to work out a self-study plan with you and provide you with homework.

pro_course_detail.title: Pronunciation focus
pro_course_detail.description: We'll begin the lesson with normal conversation, except that I'll be typing any pronunciation mistakes you make.  I'll then share my screen and we'll go through the difficulties you may have with individual words as well as wider issues such as stress, intonation, linking and sound formation.  Whether you need to communicate more clearly or would like to tone down your accent, I'll explain the rules and show you how to apply them.  All your lesson notes will be on a Google Doc that I'll share with you.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS ONLINE
pro_course_detail.description:
Master the IELTS exam with creative multi-media approaches to learning.
                                    
TOP BAND SCORES:

Academic & General

This course is designed by a professional with over twenty years' experience teaching and ten years' experience involved with Educational Technology & eLearning.

WRITING:

1) Practise writing creatively via collaborative editing software.
2) Learn how to plan and organise reports and essays.
3) Develop a rich arsenal of vocabulary and expressions to deal with any IELTS writing task.
4) Learn sophisticated grammatical constructions to earn the highest band scores.
5) Master analysing visual data and describing what it represents.

SPEAKING:

1) Communicate effectively while building fluency and confidence.
2) Have fun practising questions relevant to the IELTS exam.
3) Develop your powers of description.
4) Organise your thoughts and speak naturally.
5) Become an articulate communicator and good listener.

READING:
1) Enjoy a wide variety of quality texts to read.
2) Master crucial reading skills to ensure exam success.
3) Build up a rich vocabulary through reading practice and assignments.
4) Access top quality exam materials and authentic texts for focused practice.
5) Expert editing, marking, feedback and support.

Listening:

1) Fine-tune listening skills through various listening techniques.
2) Practise techniques to master the listening tasks in IELTS.
3) Increase vocabulary through exposure to various listening resources.
4) Access rich multi-media resources to accelerate learning.
5) Gain a natural understanding of English in various different settings and situations.

pro_course_detail.title: *Hispanohablantes* Unidades de Gramática en Inglés – Práctica Guiada
pro_course_detail.description:
Esta clase está diseñada específicamente para estudiantes hispanohablantes que quieren entender bien la gramática inglesa y usarla con más seguridad al hablar.

Los paquetes de gramática están escritos en español, con explicaciones claras y detalladas para que puedas comprender completamente cada punto gramatical, sin confusión ni traducciones literales.

Antes de empezar, realizaremos un language quiz para evaluar tu nivel y detectar qué áreas necesitas trabajar. A partir de ahí, podemos:

- centrarnos en temas concretos según tus necesidades, o

- hacer un recorrido completo por todo el curso de gramática

Cada clase (60 minutos) se basa en un paquete de gramática muy completo (20+ páginas) con explicaciones, ejercicios y quizzes extensos al final (para hacer como deberes).

Temas disponibles (Grammar Packs):

1. To Be + Basics

2. To Have + There is / are

3. The Tenses

4. Questions

5. Present + Present Continuous

6. Past Simple + Present Perfect

7. Future + Conditional

8. How long? (Durations + Timelines)

9. Conditionals 1–2–3

10. Articles, Adjectives + Verbs

11. Comparatives + Superlatives

12. Conjunctions, Relative Pronouns + Subjunctive

13. Prepositions

14. Tenses with -ing

15. Modal Verbs

16. The Passive

17. Reported Speech

18. Linking 2 verbs with -ing

19. Verbs + Prepositions

20. Phrasal Verbs

Cómo funciona la clase:

La gramática se explica por escrito en español

La clase se desarrolla en inglés, con apoyo cuando sea necesario

Practicamos speaking y listening con la gramática del tema

Todas las clases incluyen deberes y quizzes

Ideal si buscas estructura, claridad y progreso real.

pro_course_detail.title: *Francophones* Modules de Grammaire Anglaise – Pratique Guidée
pro_course_detail.description:
Ce cours est conçu spécifiquement pour les apprenants francophones qui souhaitent comprendre clairement la grammaire anglaise et l’utiliser avec plus de confiance à l’oral.

Les supports de grammaire sont rédigés en français, avec des explications claires et détaillées afin de bien comprendre chaque point grammatical, sans confusion ni traduction approximative.

Avant de commencer, nous ferons un court quiz de langue pour évaluer votre niveau et identifier les points à travailler. Ensuite, nous pourrons :

- travailler des thèmes précis selon vos besoins, ou

- suivre un parcours complet et structuré de grammaire anglaise

Chaque cours (60 minutes) est basé sur un pack de grammaire très complet (20+ pages) comprenant des explications, ainsi que des exercices et quiz approfondis à la fin (à faire en devoirs).

Thèmes disponibles (Grammar Packs) :

1. To Be + Basics

2. To Have + There is / are

3. The Tenses

4. Questions

5. Present + Present Continuous

6. Past Simple + Present Perfect

7. Future + Conditional

8. How long? (Durations + Timelines)

9. Conditionals 1–2–3

10. Articles, Adjectives + Verbs

11. Comparatives + Superlatives

12. Conjunctions, Relative Pronouns + Subjunctive

13. Prepositions

14. Tenses with -ing

15. Modal Verbs

16. The Passive

17. Reported Speech

18. Linking 2 verbs with -ing

19. Verbs + Prepositions

20. Phrasal Verbs

Comment fonctionne le cours :

La grammaire est expliquée par écrit en français

Le cours se déroule en anglais, avec soutien si nécessaire

Nous pratiquons le speaking et le listening à partir du thème étudié

Chaque cours inclut des devoirs et des quiz

Idéal si vous recherchez structure, clarté et progrès réels.

- Travelling abroad or settling into a new country—handling airport questions, accommodations, and cultural exchange

- Structured study programs built to track progress
- Personalized lesson notes
- Immediate feedback to correct errors and improve accuracy

Hi, I’m Tanike—a TEFL-certified English coach from South Africa, fluent in both English and Afrikaans. With 5+ years of experience, I specialize in Conversational Fluency and Business English, helping students like you speak confidently for work, travel, or daily life. 

My secret? A friendly, adaptable approach—honed by teaching diverse learners worldwide. When I’m not teaching, you’ll find me hiking or geeking out on finance—because learning should always connect to real life. 

Ready to learn? Let’s chat! 😊
teacher_info.about_teacher:
As a TEFL/TESOL-certified ESL teacher with over 5 years of experience, I’ve taught students of all ages—from children to adults—and at all proficiency levels. I’ve had the privilege of working with learners from Asia, South America, and Europe, which has deepened my respect for diverse cultures.

My adaptability enables me to customize lessons to suit each student’s unique needs, helping them achieve their language goals and open new opportunities, whether it’s studying abroad, landing a new job, or preparing for a life-changing presentation or event. I believe in the transformative power of education. "The whole purpose of education is to turn mirrors into windows." – Sydney J. Harris
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching style is friendly, patient, and supportive. I create a comfortable, relaxed environment where students feel confident to ask questions and make mistakes. I believe learning should be enjoyable, so I tailor lessons to each student’s unique needs and pace.

In our classes, you can expect engaging lessons with activities like conversation practice, vocabulary building, and discussions on various topics. I use multimedia resources such as videos and articles to make learning interactive and ensure comprehension.

I focus on improving conversational skills, and offer homework if desired, helping you achieve your language goals and open new opportunities.

edu_info.description: I am currently studying the first year of my Interior Design diploma, where I am building a solid foundation in design principles, space planning, and color theory. I’m gaining hands-on experience with design software and learning how to create functional, visually appealing spaces. I’m eager to continue developing my creativity and technical skills throughout my studies.

During my training at Berlitz, I learned the Berlitz Method, which focuses on immersive language learning and real-world communication. I gained valuable skills in fostering conversational fluency, promoting active learning, and using dynamic teaching techniques to keep students engaged. The training also emphasized cultural sensitivity and adaptability, enabling me to tailor lessons to the unique needs of students from diverse backgrounds and proficiency levels.

I completed a 120-hour TEFL/TESOL certification at Dux TEFL, where I learned the fundamentals of teaching English, including lesson planning, classroom management, and language acquisition techniques. I also completed a 60-hour advanced course focusing on effective online teaching methods, which equipped me with strategies to engage students in virtual settings and deliver interactive, personalized lessons

teaching_experience.description: At Berlitz, I taught English to students from Japan, ranging from beginners to advanced levels, in a dynamic, immersive environment. I used the Berlitz method, focusing on conversational practice, language immersion, and real-life application. My experience with Japanese students helped me develop a tailored approach, ensuring every lesson was engaging and effective in improving their language skills and boosting their confidence.

At LatinHire, I taught English to students from South America, Turkey, and Russia, focusing on enhancing their conversational skills and overall language proficiency. I tailored lesson plans to meet the unique needs of each student, adapting to different cultural backgrounds and proficiency levels. This experience allowed me to develop a flexible teaching approach, ensuring effective learning and helping students achieve their language goals.

pro_course_detail.title: ESL Lessons for Kids – Fun, Interactive, and Educational!
pro_course_detail.description:
(English as a Second Language) Lessons specially designed for children! These lessons are perfect for young learners who are just beginning their English journey or looking to build confidence and fluency in a fun, supportive environment.

🌟 What to Expect:
In each lesson, your child will:

Learn English through play – Songs, games, flashcards, and stories help make learning exciting and memorable.

Practice speaking and listening – We focus on clear pronunciation, basic conversation skills, and listening comprehension.

Build vocabulary – We cover useful everyday topics such as colors, animals, food, family, numbers, and more.

Improve reading and writing – Depending on age and level, we explore letters, phonics, simple words, and sentence-building.

Engage through activities – Crafts, drawings, and interactive worksheets make the lessons dynamic and hands-on.

🎓 My Approach:
I create a warm, encouraging space where kids feel safe to try and speak. Every lesson is tailored to the child's age, language level, and interests. I use a variety of visual aids, real-life examples, and repetition to ensure they understand and remember what they’ve learned.

Whether your child is just starting out or needs extra support, I’ll guide them step-by-step in a positive and fun learning environment!

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation - Grammar | Vocabulary | Idioms | Phrases | Pronunciation |
pro_course_detail.description:
In this class, the main focus is conversation. You will have the opportunity to speak naturally while I guide and correct you in real time. We will work on the essential areas that make communication effective: grammar, vocabulary, idiomatic expressions, useful phrases, pronunciation, and accent reduction.

The lessons are designed to be interactive and practical. You won’t only learn new words and rules, but also how to use them confidently in different situations—whether in daily conversations, professional contexts, or more formal discussions.

By combining structured activities with free-flowing dialogue, you will build accuracy and fluency at the same time. Expect role-plays, targeted exercises, and feedback that helps you notice and fix mistakes immediately. Each class is tailored to your needs, so you progress faster and feel more confident every time you speak.

pro_course_detail.title: Personalized English Lesson's
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are fully tailored to your individual needs and goals. Whether you want to improve your speaking, writing, listening, or a specific area such as business English, exam preparation, or everyday communication, the content will be adapted to suit you.

Each class is built around what matters most to you: expanding your vocabulary, mastering grammar, improving pronunciation, or gaining confidence in real-life situations. We will also use engaging materials and discussion topics connected to your interests, making the learning process more natural and enjoyable.

The focus is on practical progress—you will notice improvements from the very first lessons, with clear feedback and activities that help you apply what you’ve learned immediately.

pro_course_detail.title: Speaking Practice - All levels
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are designed to help you speak with confidence, no matter your level. Through guided conversations, role-plays, and targeted feedback, you will practise expressing yourself more naturally and fluently.

We will focus on vocabulary, pronunciation, and common expressions, while also correcting mistakes in real time. Each session is adapted to your goals—whether you want everyday conversation, professional communication, or preparation for specific situations.

The aim is simple: to make you feel comfortable speaking English and to improve step by step with every class.

pro_course_detail.title: the English café |☕| Conversation, Grammar, Natural Expression, Functional Language Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
Benvenuti to the English café! Here we'll craft your ideal English learning experience. Here's a taste of what's available:

☕️ Do you want to have spontaneous chats to practice your conversational English? Be prepared to talk! In this lesson, you are the barista - the architect of your own learning and success. I will encourage you and we will address vocabulary and difficulties as they arise.
✨As a slight modification, we can choose a specific topic to focus on.

☕️ Do you prefer a bit more structure to a lesson? I have a few options for you! 

A] Guided conversation classes on various topics. I will send you a few options and let you choose before the lesson. This requires no preparation on your part, just show up and engage!

B] 'Reading Club': You will receive a choice of articles, choose one that piques your interest, read the article before the lesson, then we will discuss it together and ensure you not only understand the article, but can confidently speak about the topic thereafter.

C] Lessons personalized to your specific needs. We will work on the 4 skills (reading, listening, speaking, writing) and the 3 systems (grammar, vocabulary, functional language). 

☕️ Do you have material you want to bring to the table and get practice with? Great! Let me know what you have prepared so we can discuss and refine it.

‼️ Must be strong A2-B1. If below (A1-A2), we will focus primarily on the systems needed at lower levels before true skills and conversational abilities are feasible.


**Lessons may start OR end up to 5 minutes late/early
**Important: 18+/Adults only. No children. 
‼ I do not offer 90-minute lessons. Do not book multiple lessons that exceed 1 hour total.
‼️ In case of failure to show (15 minute grace period) or cancellation within 3 hours of the lesson, full payment will be required. The lesson can be made up at no additional cost on Google Meet at an agreed time (for 30 minutes). For cancellation 3-24 hours prior, I will return the lesson to you.

pro_course_detail.title: Bean to Brew |✨|  Mini English Courses A1-C1 || Improve your productive/receptive skills + grammar and vocabulary!
pro_course_detail.description:
Like a precious coffee bean, you hold the potential for confident and fluent conversation!

Not sure where to start with your online English journey? Looking to develop your productive and receptive skills? Want to improve your grammar and vocabulary? This is the choice for you! Each mini-course contains structured lessons which will help you improve your English skills across the 4 skills (reading, writing, speaking, listening) and the 3 systems (grammar, vocabulary, functional language). 

>A1: 34 lessons. A2: 20 lessons. B1: 25 lessons. B1-B2: 26 lessons. B2: 23 lessons. C1: 21 lessons. 

>After the course concludes, continue to book the "English Cafe" option to take more lessons with me at your level! 

>These courses cover important grammar/functional language for each level, but do not increase your level. To obtain A2 from A1 requires 100-200 hours of practice. Each CEFR level you wish to reach will require an additional 200-300 hours of practice. Don't lose hope!

Message me before booking if you have any questions.

***Important Notes***
>> Lessons may start OR end up to 5 minutes late/early
>> Not for absolute beginners; please ensure you are a strong A1+
>> Please, no children; Adults only.

This lesson will help both adults and children learn how to talk about their daily activities in simple English. We'll cover common actions like waking up, going to school or work, playing, and more! By the end of the lesson, you'll be able to describe your daily routine with ease, no matter your age.

Perfect for A2 learners, this fun and interactive lesson is great for families or anyone looking to practice everyday English!

pro_course_detail.title: Exploring the Bible: Your Open Topic Journey
pro_course_detail.description: Hello, friend! Are you curious about the Bible and its timeless wisdom? Join me for a warm and engaging Bible Study session where we dive into an Open Topic discussion. You're in charge. Whether you want to explore a specific Bible verse, a particular theme, or have questions about the Scriptures, I'm here to guide you. With my background as a former Sunday School teacher and my studies in theology, we'll embark on a meaningful journey together. Let's unravel the beauty and insights of the Bible in a way that resonates with you. Looking forward to sharing and learning with you!

teacher_info.about_teacher: You can expect meticulous attention to detail and serious dedication from me as a teacher. We can have casual conversations, which will include a lot of laughter, but I'll always be listening for mistakes. I expect students to be as dedicated as I am because the goal here is to make observable improvements in your ability and proficiency with English. After all, that is why we're doing this, right? You can also expect me to be punctual and prepared. I never miss lessons and I'm quite flexible when it comes to rescheduling, as long as you give me 24-hours notice. I am passionate about English and I hope you will be too.
teacher_info.teaching_style: First, I should mention that I work with intermediate to advanced students only. My lessons are fun and my teaching style laid back, relaxed. I like to be at ease in my classes so my students can be too.  As I mentioned above, laughter plays a big part in my approach to teaching. We can all learn and remember a lot more when we associate something with laughter than with nervousness or anxiety. When studying with me, you will have great conversations, learn and practice grammatical concepts, and improve your reading and pronunciation. This latter activity is especially fun, because we will read new things together and, thus, learn new things together.
teacher_info.cancel_policy: When a student wishes to cancel a lesson, I require him or her to provide me with twenty-four hours notice. If the cancellation occurs within the twenty-four-hour period, I will expect payment in full. Of course, this policy does not apply if there is an emergency, illness, or any unforseen technical difficulties. In every case of a requested cancellation, I will be willing to reschedule as long as it fits my availability. Thank you.

teacher_info.intro:
Hi! I’m Xenia, a native Russian speaker living in Greece.
I teach Russian and English with one goal: helping you actually speak with confidence.

I also study Greek myself, so I know language learning is a mix of progress, confusion… and the occasional “why is this so hard?” moments.

In my lessons, we speak a lot. We build vocabulary naturally, improve pronunciation, and only use grammar when it helps you express yourself more clearly. No pressure, no stress - just real conversation and steady progress.

I’m patient, supportive, and I always adapt to your level and personality. Whether you’re a beginner or want to sound more natural, I’ll help you feel comfortable speaking from day one.

We can talk about everyday life, travel, culture… and yes, even Dostoevsky (if you’re brave enough).

If you can make mistakes and still keep talking - you’re doing it right. Let’s get you there.

pro_course_detail.title: Russian Literature & Reading Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is an extra option for students who want more variety and deeper real-language practice. It can be taken together with your standard lessons to enrich learning, improve reading skills, expand vocabulary, and discuss Russian literature and culture in a more advanced, engaging way. In this lesson, we read Russian texts together and use them as a base for speaking, vocabulary building, and improving overall language confidence. The materials are always chosen for your level and interests.

30 minutes:
Short texts for beginners - simple stories, adapted passages, comics, or children’s tales. We focus on basic vocabulary, pronunciation, and reading confidence.

45 minutes:
THE MOST EFFECTIVE FORMAT. We read longer texts or chapters, learn useful expressions, discuss main ideas, characters, and your personal opinion. Includes mini-debates, guided questions, and vocabulary explanations.

60 minutes:
For higher levels or students who love deep discussion. We analyse themes, compare characters, explore cultural context, and practice advanced speaking structures. Great for B2-C2 learners who want more detailed conversation.

During the lesson you will:
• read the text together with me
• learn new vocabulary and natural expressions
• practice speaking through guided discussion
• improve comprehension and interpretation skills
• ask questions and explore the ideas of the author
• connect the text to real-life situations and your own opinions

We’ll use short scenes, dialogues, and interesting situations to practice speaking, discuss characters and reactions, learn useful phrases, and improve your confidence in a relaxed way.

pro_course_detail.title: Russian Through Movies & Series
pro_course_detail.description:

We’ll talk about characters, reactions, expressions, and the way real Russian is used in different situations. You’ll also get plenty of speaking practice, so you’re not just understanding Russian - you’re actually using it.

Perfect for students who want to sound more natural, understand real spoken Russian, and enjoy learning through something interesting instead of only textbooks.

The goal is to help you speak clearly, understand others, and feel comfortable when you travel or live abroad.

pro_course_detail.title: Introduction to Bislama 🌏🌏
pro_course_detail.description: Bislama is a creole language, and one of the 3 official languages of Vanuatu. More than 95% of Bislama words are of English origin, whilst the remainder comprises a few dozen words from French, as well as some specific vocabulary inherited from various languages of Vanuatu. If you have family and friends from Vanuatu, or would love to visit our beautiful country when possible, give yourself a leg up and take a course with me, and I'll make sure you're well equipped to mingle with the locals with your language skills in Bislama! :)

teacher_info.teaching_style: What I love doing in my classes is incorporating fun and games into the lessons to make learning easier. For example, If I want my students to memorize the forms of the verbs in the past and the past participle, I'll do that through a song which would make it ten times easier for them to know the forms of the verbs. Later, I will make them use what they have learned in games and challenges to make sure that they don't forget what they've learned. pro_course_detail.title: FCE / PET Speaking Test Preparation / FCE / PET 口语考试准备
pro_course_detail.description:
This class focuses only on the speaking part of the Cambridge exams.

Are you preparing for the Cambridge FCE (B2 First) or PET (B1 Preliminary) exam? In this class, we will practice only the speaking section of the test.

You can choose how many lessons to book:

⸻

1 lesson
We will complete a full speaking test (FCE or PET), just like the real exam. After the test, I will give you personal feedback and suggestions for improvement.

⸻

5 lessons
We will focus on one part of the speaking test in each lesson:
	•	Lesson 1: Part 1 – Personal questions (FCE and PET)
	•	Lesson 2: Part 2 – Describing a photo (PET) / Comparing two photos (FCE)
	•	Lesson 3: Part 3 – Discussion  (PET) / Collaborative task (FCE)
	•	Lesson 4: Part 4 – Giving your opinion and answering questions (FCE and PET)
	•	Lesson 5: Full test and feedback

⸻

10–20 lessons
In a longer course, we can also work on:
	•	Speaking fluency and confidence
	•	High level vocabulary, linking words, and idioms to boost your score
	•	Useful grammar for speaking
	•	Test-taking skills and strategies

⸻

Important information:
	•	This class is only for the FCE and PET exams
	•	We will practice only the speaking section
	•	We do not prepare for other Cambridge exams
	•	We do not work on reading, writing, or listening in this class

pro_course_detail.title: Improve Your Conversational English with Confidence
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to feel more confident when speaking English in everyday situations? This lesson is designed to help you improve your conversational skills through engaging and practical discussions tailored to your interests and goals.

In our lessons, we’ll focus on building your fluency, expanding your vocabulary, and refining your pronunciation. Whether you want to talk about your job, hobbies, travel experiences, or even day-to-day activities, I’ll create a relaxed and friendly space where you can practice speaking and listening without fear of making mistakes.

Conversation is one of the best ways to learn English because it combines all the essential skills—listening, speaking, vocabulary, and grammar. Our lessons will also help you:

• Improve your ability to express thoughts and ideas clearly.

• Learn how to ask and answer questions naturally.

• Understand idioms and expressions that native speakers use.

• Build confidence in real-life situations, from casual chats to formal discussions.

Whether you’re preparing for a trip abroad, want to sound more natural in meetings, or simply enjoy talking about your favourite topics, this lesson is perfect for you. Each session is customized to your needs, ensuring steady progress at your pace.

Let’s make English conversation enjoyable and effective!

pro_course_detail.title: Master Your B1-B2 Exam: English Exam Prep Lessons
pro_course_detail.description:
Ready to take your English skills to the next level? This lesson package is designed for students at the B1-B2 level who are preparing for English exams such as FCE, IELTS, or TOEFL. Whether you’re aiming for better speaking fluency or improving your writing and listening skills, I’ll help you strengthen your abilities and build confidence for your upcoming exam.

In these lessons, we will cover:
• Advanced Vocabulary: Expanding your vocabulary to express yourself more clearly in a variety of contexts.
• Grammar and Sentence Structure: Mastering more complex grammar points to improve your writing and speaking accuracy.
• Speaking Practice: Focusing on real-world conversations, role plays, and exam-specific speaking tasks to help you feel confident in the speaking section.
• Writing Techniques: Developing strategies for writing clear and coherent essays, letters, and reports.
• Listening and Reading: Enhancing your comprehension skills with practice materials that reflect exam formats.
• Practice Tests: Regular mock exams to familiarize you with the format and reduce exam-day anxiety.

This package is perfect for students who are already at an intermediate level (B1-B2) and want to fine-tune their skills to excel in their exams. I’ll tailor each lesson to your unique needs and help you progress at your own pace. Together, we’ll work towards achieving your exam goals!

pro_course_detail.title: Building English Skills For Kids: Speaking, Vocabulary, Reading, and More! (Ages 7-12)
pro_course_detail.description:
Learning English can be fun and exciting! In these lessons, I create a positive and engaging environment where children aged 7 to 12 can explore the English language through games, songs, stories, and interactive activities. Whether your child is a beginner or looking to improve their skills, these lessons are designed to make learning enjoyable while focusing on the basics of speaking, listening, reading, and writing.

In our lessons, your child will:
• Build Confidence in Speaking: Through fun conversations and role plays, your child will feel comfortable speaking English.
• Learn New Vocabulary: We’ll explore words in everyday contexts—like colors, animals, food, and more!
• Practice Pronunciation: Through fun songs and games, your child will learn how to pronounce words correctly.
• Improve Listening and Reading Skills: Your child will listen to short stories, songs, and videos that help them understand English better.
• Engage in Fun Activities: Each lesson is designed to keep your child motivated and excited to learn through games, quizzes, and creative tasks.

I tailor each lesson to meet the needs and interests of children aged 7 to 12, ensuring they are not only improving their English skills but also having fun while doing it! These lessons will help them develop a strong foundation for learning English and building confidence in the language.
