pro_course_detail.title: General American English - Speak with Confidence
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is perfect if you want to speak English naturally, confidently, and without stress. Whether you’re shy, nervous, or simply need more real conversation practice, I guide you step-by-step using a friendly, relaxed style. We focus on REAL English - the way native speakers talk every day.

We talk about daily life, travel, culture, hobbies, news, or anything you enjoy. I gently correct your mistakes, teach new phrases, improve your pronunciation, and help you speak with more rhythm and confidence. Every lesson feels like talking to a friend, but with real learning and real progress.

You’ll learn:
• Common expressions & natural phrases
• Phrasal verbs used in daily life
• Fast English patterns (“gonna, wanna, lemme”)
• Accent tips (mouth position, stress, rhythm)
• How to sound clearer and more confident
• How to think in English instead of translating

My method:
In many lessons, we use short articles that I create myself around useful and enjoyable topics like travel, culture, daily life, slang, expressions, phrasal verbs, and real American speech, culture, etc. These articles are easy to read but packed with natural phrases. After reading, we use guided discussion prompts to help you speak clearly, confidently, and spontaneously.

If you’re preparing for travel, we can practice airports, restaurants, hotels, conversations, emergencies, and cultural differences. I’ve lived in Italy, Argentina, and the U.S., so I understand how language and culture interact. If you enjoy global topics, we can even explore cultural differences using Hofstede’s dimensions - perfect for international discussion. 

This lesson is relaxed, friendly, and perfect for beginners to intermediate students who just want to speak without fear and enjoy the process.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Italian Speakers – Pronunciation, Fluency & Real Conversation 🇮🇹
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed specifically for Italian speakers who want to speak clearer, faster, and more natural English. Because I lived in Italy, Rome and Codogno specifically, and speak Italian (B2), I fully understand the typical challenges Italians face - pronunciation, verb tenses, intonation, prepositions, and the “Italian rhythm” that often transfers into English. Here, we fix those problems one by one.

What we work on:
• Pronunciation of difficult sounds: TH, short vowels, R, H, word stress, ED-endings
• Minimal Pairs and understanding the difference between vowel sounds like E, I
• Grammar Italians struggle with: present perfect, modal verbs, phrasal verbs, articles, prepositions
• Fast English: linking words, reductions (“gonna, wanna, gotta”)
• Speaking with confidence without translating from Italian

Common Mistakes we will work on and correct:
• Overusing the present tense
• Translating word-for-word (“make a photo,” “I have 20 years”)
• Trouble with silent letters (walk, talk, could, should)
• Difficulty hearing reduced sounds in fast English

I'll give you clear explanations in English or Italian when needed, and provide practice exercises, recordings, PDF materials, and pronunciation drills.

Perfect for: A1–B2 Italian learners who want fast progress, better pronunciation, and more natural conversation. 

You will speak more confidently, understand native speakers better, and finally feel comfortable using real English.

pro_course_detail.title: Accent & Pronunciation Training – American English (NY/NJ Sound)
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is for learners who want to sound clearer, more natural, and more confident in American English. If you struggle with pronunciation, listening to fast speech, or speaking smoothly, this training gives you the tools, techniques, and practice you need. My background growing up in New Jersey (near New York City) allows me to teach real American rhythm, stress, intonation, and connected speech - the way people truly speak.

What we train:
• Mouth position, tongue placement, and airflow
• Difficult sounds: R, L, TH, V, short vowels, long vowels, H
• Minimal pairs to fix confusing pronunciation
• Word stress and sentence stress
• Linking and connected speech (“wanna, gonna, lemme, gimme”)
• Reductions used in fast English
• Natural American intonation
• Listening to native-speed English without getting lost

My method:
Many lessons use short custom articles I write about travel, culture, slang, phrasal verbs, and real American situations. We read them at slow, medium, and native speed. Then we train your pronunciation, rhythm, and tone through guided exercises, shadowing, repetition drills, and real-life roleplays.

This lesson is highly practical and results-focused. You will speak more clearly, understand fast English better, and sound more natural every week. Whether your goal is work, travel, immigration, or personal growth, this training will help you communicate confidently with native speakers.

Perfect for A2–C2 learners who want to fix pronunciation problems and finally FEEL comfortable speaking English.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Korean, Chinese, Japanese Speakers – Clear Pronunciation, Fluency & Natural Speaking 🇰🇷🇨🇳🇯🇵
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed specifically for Korean, Japanese, and Chinese learners who want to improve pronunciation, understand fast English, and speak naturally with confidence. After teaching many Korean, Japanese, and Chinese students, I fully understand the unique pronunciation challenges, rhythm differences, and grammar patterns that make English difficult - and I help you fix them step by step.

What we focus on:
• R / L distinction (precise tongue placement & muscle training)
• Short vs. long vowels (ship/sheep, bit/beat, full/fool)
• Final consonants and consonant clusters
• TH sounds (voiced & voiceless)
• Stress timing vs. syllable timing
• Natural American intonation
• Linking & reductions (“gonna, wanna, lemme, didn’tcha”)
• Clear, confident speaking without hesitation
• Fast-English listening — understanding native speakers

My method:
I use short articles I create about topics students enjoy: travel, culture, lifestyle, everyday problems, slang, modern expressions, and real American communication. These articles naturally include new vocabulary, phrasal verbs, expressions, and pronunciation challenges. After reading, we practice speaking, repeat key phrases, shadow native patterns, and use guided discussion prompts.

We also simulate real-life situations:
• ordering food
• small talk
• workplace communication
• social interactions
• asking for help or clarification
• reacting quickly in conversation

You will learn:
• to speak more smoothly and confidently
• to understand fast native English
• to reduce your accent and build clear pronunciation
• to use natural expressions instead of textbook phrases
• to think in English instead of translating

Perfect for A2–C1 students who want practical, modern English that actually improves fluency and confidence in real situations.

pro_course_detail.title: Speak Real English: Phrasal Verbs, Expressions, Slang & Fast Natural Speech
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed for students who want to sound more natural, fluent, and confident using the English that real Americans speak in daily life — not the stiff, formal English taught in textbooks. We focus on the expressions, slang, phrasal verbs, rhythm, and fast speech patterns that you will hear from native speakers on the streets of the USA, especially around New Jersey and New York.

What you will learn:
• Everyday phrasal verbs used constantly by Americans
• Common expressions for daily life, work, travel, friendships, and emotions
• Useful slang (modern, safe, and practical — nothing “useless”)
• Fast-English reductions (“gimme, lemme, shoulda, gonna”)
• Linking & connected speech
• Natural American rhythm, tone, and conversational flow
• How to understand fast native speakers more easily
• How to express yourself more freely and naturally

My method:
Many lessons use short articles I write based on real-life topics: travel, culture, funny stories, daily routines, problems, opinions, or situations you will actually experience in the United States. These articles include phrasal verbs, idioms, slang, and expressions in context — the BEST way to learn natural English.

After reading, we use guided discussions, pronunciation practice, and short role-plays to help you speak more naturally. You’ll learn when expressions are formal, casual, friendly, humorous, or very American.

You will practice:
• sounding confident in everyday situations
• speaking faster and more smoothly
• listening to real American speech
• choosing the right expression for the right moment
• avoiding awkward or unnatural phrasing
• understanding NJ/NY style English (my region)

Perfect for A2–C2 learners — travelers, young adults, professionals, and anyone who wants REAL English that native speakers use every single day.

This lesson makes your English modern, expressive, and truly alive.

pro_course_detail.title: Accent and Fluency Coach for Professionals
pro_course_detail.description:
In a fast-paced work environment, you need to get your point across quickly and effectively. This lesson focuses on the mechanics of a clear American accent combined with the communication systems used by top professionals to lead with authority.

The American Accent & Rhythm: We master the mechanical sounds (the American R, Flap T, and vowel reductions) and the "Stress-Timed" rhythm of US speech. This ensures you are never asked to repeat yourself in a meeting.

Strategic Communication Methods: We practice the "Sandwich Method" for delivering difficult feedback, the "BLUF" system (Bottom Line Up Front) for emails, and the art of "Hedging" to maintain diplomacy.

Action Verbs & Phrasal Verbs: We replace weak language with high-impact "Power Verbs" (spearheading, leveraging, optimizing) and the essential business phrasal verbs (circle back, touch base, run by) that native speakers use daily.

Cultural Context (Low-Context Logic): I teach you how to bridge the gap between European/Latin business styles and the direct, time-sensitive culture of American corporate environments.

Industry Simulations: We use role-plays based on your actual job.

The System: 
The Speech Audit: We identify the specific sounds and patterns holding back your clarity.

The Drill & Execute Flow: 20 minutes of pronunciation mechanics followed by 40 minutes of high-stakes business role-play.

The "Meeting Minutes" Feedback: After every session, you receive a professional feedback document containing your pronunciation "corrections" and strategic communication notes.

teacher_info.intro: I am a CELTA-certified English instructor from the United States, currently serving as a university lecturer in Hungary. My professional background includes teaching English at an educational institution in Morocco, with experience spanning all age groups from young learners to adults. I specialize in instructing students at various proficiency levels, from beginner to advanced. My online teaching methodology emphasizes efficient language skill development through structured practice. As a multilingual educator with fluency in German (C1), proficiency in formal and Moroccan Arabic (B2), and active studies in Slovak and Hungarian, I possess firsthand insight into language acquisition.
teacher_info.short_signature: Certified CELTA teacher
teacher_info.introduction:
My goals in teaching you English are the following: 1. Communication: Language is a social activity. As such, it is important that you have the means to interact with other human beings using in this case the English language. Therefore, you will practice formally reading, writing, speaking, and listening. Furthermore, you will eventually practice informal and colloquial English so as to better comprehend and communicate with native English speakers from the United States. 2. Participation: You will be the one using the English language during our sessions. My job is to prepare the lesson for you and your job is to be ready and willing to use English. I will not judge you but I will help you to improve your English language skills through repetition and your active participation; in fact, having learned language myself here on Italki, I understand how important it is for you to have a patient and supportive teacher. 3. Cultural Immersion: I believe that language exists in a cultural context. For those of you who are interested, I will provide you with contemporary media meant to teach you the English language in a north American context. Moreover, I can provide you with suitable literature to examine, too.

My promises to you: 1. During our first lesson, I will evaluate your English level. I will plan your lessons accordingly so that they are not too difficult, but at the same time will challenge you enough that your English will improve. 2. I will prepare each and every lesson for you beforehand. Each lesson will have a particular outcome in mind. 3. I will adapt our lessons to your particular goals. Are you preparing for an English language exam? Or are you planning to travel or to undertake business in an English- speaking country? In both cases the lessons I will plan will be different. 4. I cannot promise that you will become fluent in only a few months, but I can promise you that your English will improve steadily with your hard work.

I have been in your shoes, whether it is preparing for the TOEFL, drilling grammar or trying to understand your favorite tv show, I can give you a hand to achieve your goals.  // Tengo experiencia enseñando español e inglés a través de conversaciones. teacher_info.teaching_style: I focus on teaching through conversations. For that, we walk though a topic in a socratic way, which means I ask you questions about the topic. In a way, you are being interviewed and that allows you to express yourself as widely and freely as possible, with me jumping in to aid you in developing your language skills. // Me concentro en enseñar a través de conversaciones. En clase, tomamos un tema y lo conduzco de manera socrático, lo que significa que yo hago preguntas sobre el tema. De esta manera, estás siendo entrevistado y esto te da una oportunidad de expresarte libremente. Intervengo para serte de ayuda en desarrollar tus pensamientos y habilidades linguisticas.

pro_course_detail.description: In this lesson, we will have a conversation in Spanish about one or two topics per lesson (e.g. hobbies, work, philosophy, psychology, medicine, religion, you name it). We will work in your vocabulary as you speak, I will correct you in your use of words or sentences, and we will work in your accent. During class, I have a word document open where I type words you are not familiar with, expressions, and sentences. After class, I share with you this document for you to review the material we discussed on your own time.

I can type for you any sentence you do not understand, so that you can have a record of words/grammar you can review later. // En esta lección, hablaremos sobre cualquier tema de tu interés, o puedo elegir el tema. Practicaremos para mejorar tu vocabulario, mejorar tu estructura de oraciones y tu acento.

I love meeting new people and sharing cultures through language. In my free time, I enjoy reading, baking, painting, discovering new foods, and taking long walks.

With thousands of successful hours of experience, I am here to help learners gain confidence, improve pronunciation and practice their English speaking skills. If you want to improve your fluency and casual conversation skills, then I am here to help you reach that goal. Lessons with me will not only help you practice your speaking skills, but also advance your writing, reading, and grammar! If you are looking to improve your english medical vocabulary, I can also help with that!

My method of teaching is through conversations and reading to improve vocabulary and pronunciation, but can be altered to fit your needs. I also provide online classroom lessons if needed.

I’m a curious person with broad interests, so you can freely share your thoughts and experiences while learning new vocabulary, expressions, and pronunciation. I’ll guide you to speak more fluently and help you sound more natural in real conversations.

pro_course_detail.title: Daily English for ALL AGES Chinese speakers - 面向所有年龄段中文使用者的日常英语学习
pro_course_detail.description:
My conversation lessons are for Chinese speakers of all ages.

I live and work in China, so I truly understand Chinese students — their thinking, their challenges, and their common expressions. I also speak Chinese, which helps me connect with you better and explain things more clearly when needed.

During each lesson, we talk about everyday life — morning routines, work, shopping, travel, dining out, hobbies, emotions, and more. You choose the topics, or I can suggest them. We cover all kinds of daily activities.

What makes my lessons different? We don't memorize textbook lines. Instead, we use natural, real-life situations to hold discussions. The class is interactive, practical, fun, and engaging — you'll speak most of the time, with my real-time guidance.

The goal? Help you speak like a native, impress your friends, and feel confident in real conversations. Short, fun, and practical lessons designed for Chinese speakers. Join me — let's make your daily English better.

我的对话课面向所有年龄段的中文使用者。

我在中国生活和工作，因此非常了解中国学生的思维方式、学习难点以及常用表达。我也会说中文，这让我能更好地与你们沟通，在需要时更清晰地讲解。

我们会聊日常生活——早晨例行程式、工作、购物、旅行、外出用餐、兴趣爱好、情绪表达等等。你可以选话题，也可以由我来推荐。课程涵盖各种日常活动。

我的课有什么不同？我们不背课本上的句子，而是用真实、自然的生活场景展开讨论。课堂互动性强、实用、有趣、引人入胜——大部分时间你都在开口说英语，我会实时给予指导。

目标是什么？帮助你像母语者一样说话，在朋友面前惊艳一把，在真实对话中充满自信。专为中文使用者设计的简短、有趣、实用的课程。加入我，让日常英语成为你的第二天性。

pro_course_detail.title: Elementary or Pre-intermediate
pro_course_detail.description:
My lessons are based on the latest edition of English File, which allows my students to build confidence to communicate with a proven balance of Grammar, Vocabulary, Pronunciation, and Skills Development in every lesson. 

For example, the lesson begins with VOCABULARY and we learn useful vocabulary related to airports, then we READ an article about a start-up for travelers and LISTEN to a traveler meeting his guide at the airport in Rome. This leads us into the usage of GRAMMAR construction “to be going to” for future plans and predictions.  The lesson ends with the SPEAKING activity in which we plan a tour for travelers in our city.

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate or Intermediate Plus
pro_course_detail.description:
My lessons are based on the latest edition of English File, which allows my students to build confidence to communicate with a proven balance of Grammar, Vocabulary, Pronunciation, and Skills Development in every lesson. 

For example, the lesson begins with VOCABULARY and we learn useful vocabulary related to airports, then we READ an article about a start-up for travelers and LISTEN to a traveler meeting his guide at the airport in Rome. This leads us into the usage of GRAMMAR construction “to be going to” for future plans and predictions.  The lesson ends with the SPEAKING activity in which we plan a tour for travelers in our city.

pro_course_detail.title: Разговорный урок
Начальный уровень
pro_course_detail.description:
The course contains 15 sections. Each section examines a part of day-to-day life like IN THE CITY or TRAVELING and covers up to 3 grammatical and/or phonics points and vocabulary.

For example, we have a topic “Life in the City”, we start with eliciting what you already can say about it in Russian, then find blind spots and learn new vocabulary to eliminate them, like different names of places around town and so on, after that we move to the Prepositional case as we use it to talk about the LOCATIONS when we say things like “in the shop/ В магазинЕ”. At the end we summarize what we’ve learned by writing a speaking point about the city you live in.

GRAMMAR

Gender of Russian nouns // Plural Nouns // Pronouns Basics

Russian Verb Basics ( First and Second Conjugation, The Present, Past and Future Tenses in Russian, Imperfective and Perfective Verbs)

Russian Cases Basics ( Prepositional Case, Accusative case, Genitive case, Dative case, Instrumental case)

Compounds sentences, Building Questions

PHONICS
 
How to read Cyrillic?
What is Ь and Ъ?
Hard and Soft consonants (НЯ - НА // НЕ - НЭ)
What are Я, Ю, Е, И and Ё?
How to read these??? Ж// Ш// Щ// Ч
and this Ц 
and the epic Р

TOPICS

Everyday Life
Leisure time
In the city
Work
Sports
Traveling
Food 
Computing

pro_course_detail.description: The aim of this class is giving you confidence in speaking, activating all the vocabulary and grammar which you have learnt, as well as improving your listening skills along the way. pro_course_detail.description: I have taught and spoken with a huge number of people who are not native English speakers and I see that many of them, while being able to express themselves, make serious grammar mistakes now and then, which everyone should avoid if they want to speak correct English and not make their interlocutors confused. Besides, knowing grammar is highly important if you plan to take English exams. In this course I can help you understand all nuances of different tenses without any confusion, start using sophisticated grammar constructions which would give you higher scores on exams, and more.

pro_course_detail.title: Cultural Expertise
pro_course_detail.description:
Have you ever engaged with different cultures, and wanted to understand them better?  We work through the English associated with different cultural approaches, and how to understand others from the point of view of aspects such as:
- honour/shame cultures
- time-based versus people-based cultures
- efficiency versus community
And so much more. 
This lesson will give you the tools to handle conversation with other cultures in a meaningful manner from someone who is proficient in cross-cultural engagement.

We will read, converse, and listen, but you have to be prepared to have more than one lesson a week, and to work outside the lesson time on your pronunciation.

English/Spanish can be easier than you think! 
Focus is learning by doing.

First, I want to meet you and discuss your difficulties and goals. What you like, what you don’t and finish with a sample lesson.

The personalized plan would be created especially for you so, that you can practice after the lesson and use it to improve your English/Spanish whenever you want.

My classes are held in a fun and interactive way. We’ll be describing pictures, playing games and watching your favourite videos, movies, series and even listening to your favourite songs/artists and using FlashCards decks to practice new vocabulary online, all adapted ion the age and level. 

I use various textbooks, websites, apps like Roblox, etc. and we also tackle grammar, vocabulary and pronunciation along with other activities.  If you have a book, we can use that too, the idea is to create habits that will help you become fluent speaker.

Homework might be assigned after each class (don’t panic, is funnier than it sounds).

Topic basic conversations: debates, free talk, movies, 1D, Harry Styles, books, etc. 
Please, let me know if there’s anything specific that you would like to learn or discuss.

Remember Fluent English/ Spanish doesn’t happen overnight, it’s a process and a journey.  Enjoy it!
Looking forward to meet you and help you with your language skills.

pro_course_detail.title: Book Club Conversation 📚🗣️
pro_course_detail.description: This lesson is designed for learners who want to improve fluency, vocabulary, and confidence through meaningful discussion. Before class, students read a short text, article, or book excerpt (adapted to their level). During the lesson, we focus on guided conversation, opinion sharing, and critical thinking in a relaxed, supportive environment. You’ll practice natural expressions, learn useful vocabulary, and receive gentle corrections and feedback. Perfect for intermediate to advanced learners who enjoy reading, exchanging ideas, and speaking more naturally in real-life conversations.

pro_course_detail.title: Club de Lectura – Conversación 📚🗣️
pro_course_detail.description: Esta clase está diseñada para estudiantes que desean mejorar su fluidez, vocabulario y confianza a través de conversaciones significativas. Antes de la clase, el estudiante leerá un texto corto, artículo o fragmento de un libro, adaptado a su nivel. Durante la clase, nos enfocamos en la conversación guiada, la expresión de opiniones y el pensamiento crítico en un ambiente relajado y de apoyo. Practicarás expresiones naturales, aprenderás vocabulario útil y recibirás correcciones y retroalimentación de forma clara y amable. Ideal para estudiantes de nivel intermedio a avanzado que disfrutan leer, compartir ideas y hablar de manera más natural.

pro_course_detail.title: Formación en Interpretación 🎧🗣️

Practicarás técnicas clave como la escucha activa, la toma de notas, el entrenamiento de la memoria y la transmisión precisa del mensaje entre idiomas. Las sesiones pueden incluir discursos cortos, diálogos o situaciones de juego de roles, según tu nivel y objetivos. Recibirás retroalimentación estructurada sobre precisión, claridad, registro y entrega. teacher_info.intro:
Hello! My name is Elaheh Rezvani. I have had the privilege of living in various parts of the world, including England, Turkey, and Australia. I hold a Master's degree in English Literature, a field with which I genuinely connect. I have been teaching English since 2013, and it's remarkable how quickly time has passed!
In addition to my passion for English, I am also an avid photographer. I have been practicing photography for nearly eight years, and I believe that literature and photography are intertwined in many ways.

As a teacher, I strive to create an interactive learning experience for my students. I tailor my teaching materials to their individual skill levels, incorporating a variety of resources such as videos, podcasts, music, films, and flashcards. Unlike some teachers, I do not rely solely on a set text. I also don't believe in administering quizzes, as I feel that progress can be demonstrated through the natural learning process, which has its ups and downs.
You can find me on social media as  ela_the_coach.

pro_course_detail.description: Hello! When conducting my speaking classes, I typically begin by providing introductory information about the topic or lesson we will be covering. Before each session, I ensure that the subject matter is agreed upon with you to prepare accordingly. By starting with this information, I am able to outline the rest of the discussion for the class. To make the lessons more engaging, I utilize various materials, such as TED Talks, reading PDFs, short stories, and films. This approach allows us to cover a wide range of subjects and identify any areas where you may need improvement. Ultimately, this leads to diverse and captivating discussions.

pro_course_detail.title: Learn what is essential for reading and writing
pro_course_detail.description:
Hello! Welcome to Italki. In my writing and reading classes, I will thoroughly cover every aspect of grammar, which is crucial for improving your writing and speaking skills. We will use various materials to gain a comprehensive understanding of structure and writing regulations. 

Moreover, reading different contexts is one of the best ways to practice grammar. During our lessons, you will have the opportunity to check intonations, pronunciations, etc.: while also improving your reading skills. Your interests will guide the selection of specific passages, where we will analyze the language, grammatical structures, new words, and punctuation together. 

As a former English student, I understand what is essential for language learners. My experience has helped me make language learning more enjoyable for my students. Thank you for choosing me as your tutor!

pro_course_detail.title: learning about the Persian language
pro_course_detail.description: Greetings! If you're curious about the Persian or Farsi language, which is my mother tongue, I can teach you how to speak it in my classes. I'll use English to help you understand the meanings, so it's a chance to practice both languages at once. Many people who attend Persian learning courses are interested in its literature as one of the oldest and most mythical forms of art. I'd be honored to help you read various masterpieces in Persian and comprehend all the metonyms, metaphors, and ironies in each piece of art. I hope you'll join me in my classes.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English
pro_course_detail.description: During our classes, we can focus on various aspects of business English such as vocabulary, reading, and writing, based on your personal requirements. While there are several books available, I typically recommend Market Leader as it covers all the essential topics. However, it is not mandatory to use this specific book. Often, individuals may feel anxious about business interviews or writing emails in English. With consistent practice and self-assurance, you can overcome any language barriers. I look forward to our next session!

Fluency and Coherence
Grammatical Range and Accuracy
Lexical Resource
Pronunciation

teacher_info.intro:
Hi! My name is Alex. I’m 20 years old and a native English speaker from Yorkshire, England. I hold a CELTA certificate in teaching English to adults, and I enjoy meeting people from different backgrounds and cultures. If you’re interested in learning with a friendly native speaker in a relaxed and supportive environment, feel free to get in touch.

My passion for teaching sparked when I began working as a stallholder. I realised I genuinely enjoy communicating and explaining things to people, which then led me to my true calling: teaching! As a teacher, I’m friendly and patient. I aim to create a relaxed learning environment where students feel comfortable making mistakes and practising English without pressure. I believe we learn best when lessons are enjoyable, so I work hard to make my classes interesting and engaging whilst also giving you the right level of challenge to help you improve.

I like to make my lessons as student-centred and practical as possible, which means we'll focus on real-life examples and authentic materials to practise English as it's actually used. We’ll practise speaking as much as possible, while also improving listening, reading, and writing, so you can use English confidently in everyday situations. But most importantly, each lesson will be designed around your needs so that you can progress in the areas that matter most to you.

pro_course_detail.title: Basic English基础英语
pro_course_detail.description:
初阶课程内容：
1.掌握四大文法以及句型：一般现在时，现在进行时，一般过去时，一般将来时
2.掌握生活中常用基本单字：衣服，颜色，星期，月份，时间，动物，心情等的基础单字
3.掌握基础词性：名词，形容词，副词，介词，代词的使用
4.掌握一些字母在单字中的发音，能够自然拼读出来
5.进行简单的听力练习，熟悉英语的发音，能打好听力基础
6. 能够简单表达自己的意思，与别人进行基本交流

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate English中阶英语
pro_course_detail.description:
初阶课程内容：
1.掌握其他常用时态与语态：现在完成时，过去进行时，过去完成时，过去将来时与被动语态
2.掌握中阶常用单字：建筑物，身体疼痛，药物，常用动作等词语与短语
3.掌握词性中阶使用：形容词的比较级与最高级，副词的比较级与最高级，介词短语，复合代词
4.掌握一些字母组合的发音，能够自然拼读出来
5. 掌握句型：1.虚拟语气 2. 宾语从句 3.定语从句 4.状语从句
6. 进行中阶文章的听力练习，帮助听懂长且复杂的句子的意思
7. 能与别人自然谈论不同的话题。

pro_course_detail.title: Traveling English 旅游英语
pro_course_detail.description:
1. 掌握不同场景需要的基础单字：机场，餐厅点餐，问路，购物，到酒店取房，在国外租车等
2. 掌握通俗易懂的基础句型。
3. 进行简单的听力练习，可以轻松听懂外国人表达的意思
4.通过角色扮演来进行对话模拟，让你无痛开口

pro_course_detail.title: Preparation for Test 考前准备
pro_course_detail.description:
1. 根据提供的考试范围进行单字复习与听写
2. 查漏补缺，学习考试常用的短语搭配
3. 时态与语态检测，帮你有效掌握所有考试的时态与语态
4. 词性的使用，例如介词短语，介词与时间/地方等之间的使用
5. 阅读训练，教你如何在阅读中拿高分
6. 写作特训，提供优美，高级的词汇与句型/模版，进行文章点评与分析，让你写出好文章。
7. 听力特训，让你能在听力抓重点，获取信息找到答案

teacher_info.introduction:
Hi, my name is Andy, and I have been teaching languages since 2001. I have worked in different countries with students from different nationalities, that´s why I love learning languages to be able to help and understand better my students. I have taught students of all ages and levels. I have to confess that I enjoy teaching beginners and see their progress until they are able to communicate in the new language. I also learn languages, so I know that what a language student wants is to be able to speak and understand the new language, that´s why my classes are based on speaking, that means, from the very first class you will be speaking and I will be giving you the instructions in the language you are learning. I also understand that there are some students that prefer to receive some explanations in their own languages, so that´s why I speak English, Portuguese, Spanish, German and I´m doing my best to improve rapidly my French. I also prefer teaching in an organized way, that means by levels. So during our first class I check your level and I get informed about what you are looking for. And from there we plan what we will learn and how our classes will be organized, so you will always know during the months, in what level you are and if for any reason you have to stop our classes, when you return to study with me or any other teacher you will know exactly where to continue. If you are an intermediate or advanced student we can go on progressing and also improving those small (or big) mistakes that for sure you are trying to get rid off. pro_course_detail.title: English - Beginner (A1) / Elementary English (A2) / Intermediate English (B1)
pro_course_detail.description:
BEGINNER  (A1) 
Description: At the end of the course you will be able to understand and use familiar everyday expressions and very basic phrases aimed at the satisfaction of needs of a concrete type. You will be able to introduce yourself and others, ask and answer questions about personal details such as where you live, people you know and things you have. You will be able to interact in a simple way provided the other person talks slowly and clearly and you'll be prepared to help.

ELEMENTARY ENGLISH (A2)
Description: At the end of the course you will be able to understand sentences and frequently used expressions related to areas of most immediate relevance (e.g. very basic personal and family information, shopping, local geography, employment). You will be able tocommunicate in simple and routine tasks requiring a simple and direct exchange of information on familiar and routine matters. You will be able to describe in simple terms aspects your background, immediate environment and matters in areas of immediate need.

INTERMEDIATE ENGLISH (B1)
Description: At the end of this couse you will be able to understand the main points of clear standard input on familiar matters regularly encountered in work, school, leisure, etc. You will be able to deal with most situations likely to arise whilst travelling in an area where the language is spoken. You will be able to produce simple connected text on topics which are familiar or of personal interest. You will be able to describe experiences and events, dreams, hopes & ambitions and briefly give reasons and explanations for opinions and plans. 


Material: 
1 PDF Class Book
1 PDF Homework Book 
1 MP3  Audio CD

All this material  will be sent to you for free!

pro_course_detail.title: English - Upper-Intermediate (B2) / Advanced English (C1) / Proficiency (C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
UPPER-INTERMEDIATE (B2)
Description: at the end of this course you will be able to understand the main ideas of complex text on both concrete and abstract topics, including technical discussions in your field of specialisation. You will be able to interact with a degree of fluency and spontaneity that makes regular interaction with native speakers quite possible without strain for either party. You will be able to produce clear, detailed text on a wide range of subjects and explain a viewpoint on a topical issue giving the advantages and disadvantages of various options.

ADVANCED ENGLISH (C1)
Description: At the end of this course you will be able to understand a wide range of demanding, longer texts, and recognise implicit meaning. You will be able to express yourself fluently and spontaneously without much obvious searching for expressions. You will be able touse language flexibly and effectively for social, academic and professional purposes. pro_course_detail.title: Portuguese – Beginner (A1) / Elementary Portuguese (A2) / Intermediate Portuguese (B1)
pro_course_detail.description:
From A1 to B1, students will build a solid foundation in Portuguese and gradually become confident, independent speakers.

At the Beginner (A1) level, students will learn basic pronunciation, essential vocabulary, and simple grammar. They will practice introducing themselves, talking about their family, asking and answering simple questions, ordering food, shopping, and handling everyday situations.

At the Elementary (A2) level, students will expand their vocabulary and start forming longer sentences. They will learn to talk about daily routines, past experiences, future plans, travel, hobbies, and personal opinions. Listening and speaking confidence will grow through practical conversation.

By the Intermediate (B1) level, students will be able to communicate more comfortably and naturally in real-life situations. They will learn to express ideas, describe experiences, explain opinions, and participate in longer conversations. At this stage, students begin to use Portuguese more independently in work, travel, and social contexts.

pro_course_detail.title: Portuguese – Upper-Intermediate (B2) / Advanced Portuguese (C1) / Proficiency Portuguese (C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
From Upper-Intermediate (B2) to Proficiency (C2), students will refine their Portuguese skills and gain fluency, accuracy, and confidence in any situation.

At the Upper-Intermediate (B2) level, students will expand their vocabulary and grammar to discuss complex topics. They will practice expressing opinions, giving detailed explanations, debating, and understanding more nuanced texts and spoken Portuguese. Communication becomes more natural, even in professional or unfamiliar contexts.

At the Advanced (C1) level, students will develop a high level of fluency and sophistication. They will learn to use idiomatic expressions, advanced grammar structures, and subtle language nuances. Students will confidently participate in discussions, give presentations, write formal texts, and understand almost all forms of spoken and written Portuguese.

By the Proficiency (C2) level, students will master Portuguese at a near-native level. They will be able to understand and produce complex texts, engage in debates on specialized topics, and communicate effortlessly in academic, professional, and social settings. At this stage, students can express themselves precisely, fluently, and creatively in all situations.

I use a variety of engaging methods—songs, visuals, games, stories, and activities—to make sure your child stays focused, has fun, and learns effectively. Every lesson is tailored to the student’s level, age, and learning style.

🎯 What’s included:

Games and activities that make learning enjoyable

Practice in 2–3 key language skills per lesson

Personalized homework and optional quizzes

Vocabulary and grammar building

Gentle correction and feedback during every class

📈 Progress tracking:
For long-term students, I provide bi-weekly or monthly progress tests to measure improvement and adjust lessons based on their evolving needs.

This class helps your child grow in confidence, use English naturally, and enjoy learning in a stress-free environment. Whether your child is just starting or building on existing skills, I’ll support their growth every step of the way!

We’ll focus on building your skills in grammar, reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Each lesson includes 2–3 skills, personalized practice, and clear goals to help you make steady progress. I also include engaging activities like quizzes, games, and homework to support your learning between lessons.

✨ What to expect:

Grammar explained in a clear, simple way

Speaking activities to help you speak more fluently and confidently

Listening and reading practice using real-world materials

Personalized feedback to correct mistakes and strengthen your weak areas

Fun games and quizzes to make learning enjoyable

👩🏽‍🏫 For beginners (A1–A2), we’ll start by building strong language foundations so you can communicate in everyday situations.

🧠 For intermediate learners (B1–B2), we’ll strengthen your grammar, fix common mistakes, and expand your vocabulary to help you speak and write more naturally.

Whether you're learning English for everyday life, travel, or personal growth, I’ll help you build confidence and reach your goals—one step at a time.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Preparation Course (B2–C2) 🎓📈📝 | Targeted Practice & Band Score Estimates
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is designed for learners aiming to succeed in the IELTS exam, whether for university admission, immigration, or professional certification. It is best suited for upper-intermediate to proficient students (B2–C2).

Each lesson is tailored to your specific goals: the band score you aim to achieve, your current strengths and weaknesses, and your test date. I provide:

A full breakdown of the IELTS test format and requirements

Practical strategies for each section (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking)

Timed practice tests and real exam-style questions

Detailed feedback with estimated band scores

Support with academic or general training modules

Whether you're taking IELTS for study, work, or relocation, I will help you develop the skills and confidence needed to perform at your best.

Note: This course is not suitable for beginner or intermediate-level learners. You should already be comfortable having conversations, reading academic texts, and writing coherent paragraphs in English. If you're unsure of your level, feel free to book a trial lesson first.

pro_course_detail.description:
These fun and gentle lessons are designed to help your child learn to read and speak in English—perfect for beginners and children aged 3 and up.

We’ll focus on the very beginning of your child’s English journey:

Learning the alphabet and letter sounds

Blending sounds to read words

Recognizing sight words and simple sentences

Practicing speaking and pronunciation through songs and games

Your child will learn through stories, visuals, and phonics-based games that make reading fun and interactive. Each class is paced according to your child’s ability, so they feel confident, supported, and encouraged every step of the way.

🎯 What’s included:

Step-by-step phonics instruction

Practice reading real words and simple sentences

Speaking exercises to build confidence and pronunciation

Optional homework or printable activities

Positive, child-friendly feedback

Help your child become confident in reading and speaking English from the very start. With patient guidance and playful learning, they’ll grow a love for the language that lasts!

Let’s practice speaking English naturally and confidently—one conversation at a time!

pro_course_detail.description:
This course is designed to prepare you for both the speaking and writing sections of the IELTS exam, making it ideal for students who will be taking the test in the next month. While many students can effectively train themselves for the reading and listening components, they often struggle to achieve the same scores in speaking and writing. 

We will concentrate on the most common topics you will encounter on the IELTS and work on all the necessary sub-skills to ensure you achieve the score you deserve. I have successfully trained students who achieved Band 7 and Band 8 results, and I am confident in the effectiveness of my teaching methods.

Each class will include a Word document, which will provide you with a model answer, additional advice, and vocabulary specific to IELTS writing. You will use this document to craft your own high-level response to a real IELTS question, which I will review during the next class.

In particular, I focus strongly on teaching the following areas:
1) Idiomatic language
2) Precise pronunciation
3) A range of advanced vocabulary
4) Structure
5) Fluency
6) Phrasal verbs

This lesson is specifically designed for improving your "Speaking" skill and you need to be at least B1 to have this kind of lesson. Persian speech is quite different from its actual written form and that means you need to have a lot of conversation practice in order to become fluent in speaking Persian. In these lessons, various topics will be discussed, which are mainly about Iranian culture and introducing it to you and of course, topics of your interest and in need of practice will never be neglected. The main speaker will be you and I'll be the listener and you'll receive notes and corrections on your speech during the lesson. New words and expressions and idioms will also be taught and you can expect your vocabulary to improve. 

If you do regular conversation practices and constantly improve your vocabulary, you can finally become a fluent Persian speaker.

teacher_info.about_teacher: I've worked with all ages , including young children so I am patient & understanding. I remember what it was like as a student trying to learn different languages, sometimes I felt overwhelmed. I like to introduce things to students at a pace that feels right for them. I always follow up with an exercise to ensure that they are retaining just as much as they are consuming. I have several years' experience teaching online so I understand that teaching virtually can be challenging to maintaining one's attention. Rather than "lecture-style" I like to present an outline of topics to introduce, then begin with a warm up and ask the student questions with ways to engage them right from the onset!
teacher_info.teaching_style: I love to interact with people! I think that is the best way to learn. Everyone has a different method by which they consume and retain information and I am a firm believer in honoring whatever individually works. (For example, some people are visual learners, others are audio learners, some learn audio-visually, while others learn through physical movement, etc) We are all different and that's completely okay! What's important, as an instructor, is to acknowledge these differences and still be able to teach effectively. I like presenting to students first and then let them gravitate to whatever resonates best ! Thus creating a fun learning and teaching experience for everyone!

If you are late without any prior notice I will apply the following:
30 minute lessons - 5 minute waiting period
45 minute lessons - 10 minute waiting period
60 minute lessons - 15 minute waiting period

If you are longer than these specified times, you will be charged for the lessons. If you are within these times we will be able to continue with the lesson until the specified end time. 

I will gladly reschedule lessons with anyone that has let me know they can't make our time, even if it is within the 24 hours of the lesson start time, but then it is up to each student to reschedule.

teacher_info.introduction:
Hello! My name is Oxana. I'm a native Russian speaker living in Moscow. I give lessons of Russian to students of all levels. Whether you want to learn basic everyday phrases, or achieve good writing skills, or read Leo Tolstoy's "War & Peace" in original - I'll be glad to help. 

My TESOL certification allows me to teach English to learners of all levels. However, students who'd benefit from my lessons most of all are native Russian speakers, who can't communicate with English native speakers efficiently yet. Please note that I prefer NOT to teach kids online since in my opinion they need different approach.

My main goal is to help you begin talking and communicating. I am proud when my students make progress.The best reward for me is when my students overcome their “no mistakes” mindset or shyness, and begin interacting in their target language. 

Individual approach - My lessons are student-centered. I create a personalized learning plan for each student. 

I love both teaching and learning languages online. Being an enthusiastic language learner helps me enrich my teaching experience. 

Learning Materials - I have a collection of textbooks that I can share with my students. I also believe online tools are very helpful for learning languages. So, I create various materials and I also post learning materials on social media

teacher_info.intro:
I am Allan, an experienced English teacher specialising in grammar, pronunciation, speaking and exam preparation. I help students build confidence, communicate clearly and achieve strong results.

I have extensive experience preparing students for IELTS, CAE, FCE, PET and KET. My students consistently achieve high pass rates and improved band scores through my structured and practical approach. I also provide "FREE MOCK TESTS", along with  "FREE BOOKS, LEARNING MATERIALS AND PROOFREADING". 

With over 16 years of online teaching experience, including 11 successful years on Italki and more than 15,500 lessons taught, I have supported learners from a wide range of backgrounds. I am a retired SIM Manager with professional certifications from CMI, ILM and NEBSS, alongside a TEFL qualification.

Every lesson is tailored to your goals and learning style. I support reading, writing and speaking, with a focus on natural, fluent English. I also offer Interview Preparation, Role-Play Practice and CV Support.

My teaching style is clear, supportive and results-focused. We identify areas to improve, set realistic goals and follow a personalised plan. I provide regular feedback and track your progress carefully to ensure steady improvement and exam readiness.

Outside of teaching, I am an active member of a running and swimming club. I also enjoy cycling when the weather is good, and I love travelling, often combining it with diving. I am also passionate about writing.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation with a Grammar Focus - Using Verb Tenses with Confidence
pro_course_detail.description:
Understand and use English verb tenses with confidence. Clear explanations, common mistakes, and guided speaking practice to help you communicate more naturally.

We will practise a combination of activities to achieve this: fluency practice with a specific grammar focus; and accuracy practice to help you speak correctly.  I do not just do free conversation lessons but I will support you to develop your skills in a structured and progressive way. 

I have a lot experience teaching grammar and in this lesson (or lesson package) I will help you to use a range of verb forms to talk about the past, present and future.   

We can practise:
✔ present simple, continuous, perfect 
✔ past simple, continuous, perfect, 'used to'
✔ future simple, continuous, perfect, 'going to', 'will'
✔ conditionals (zero, first, second, third, mixed)
✔ question tags
✔ passive 
✔ phrasal verbs 
✔ ...and more 👍

I have created many materials to help you and to practise!  I recommend 5 x 60 min. lessons for a good review of all the tenses (or 10 x 30 min.). 

This lesson can be flexible.  Please feel free to mention a specific area of difficulty you might have with English tenses for a one-off lesson or we can work through them progressively in a lesson package.  I can adapt the lesson(s) to suit your needs.

Join me soon and I can help you to speak with more confidence!   Please feel free to send me a message on italki and we can plan our first lesson.

I prefer to use Zoom or the italki Classroom because they have excellent features for teaching.  After the lesson I like to send you the material (eg a pdf) and also some homework if you would like.

pro_course_detail.title: Spanish Conversation: ¡Habla español como un nativo! Speak Spanish Like a Local!
pro_course_detail.description:
¡Hola, amigo/a! Soy Neb, y estoy aquí para llevarte en un viaje emocionante por el vibrante mundo del español. ¡Olvídate de esas aburridas tablas de conjugación y listas interminables de vocabulario—vamos a HABLAR español de verdad y enamorarnos juntos de este hermoso idioma!

Imagínate pidiendo tapas en Madrid, bailando salsa en Colombia o explorando ruinas antiguas en México—todo mientras conversas con confianza con los locales. ¡Exactamente ahí es donde vamos! En nuestras clases, hablaremos de todo lo que te apasiona: música, comida, viajes, cultura, deportes, películas—lo que quieras. Aprender español debe sentirse como pasar tiempo con un amigo, no como estar sentado en un salón de clases aburrido.

¿Mi estilo de enseñanza? Piensa en mí como tu guía amigable, no como un profesor estricto. Creo un espacio relajado y de apoyo donde puedes hablar libremente sin preocuparte por la perfección. ¡Cometer errores es parte de la aventura! Te ayudaré a sonar más natural, expandir tu vocabulario con palabras que realmente usarás, y entender los matices culturales que hacen al español tan rico y expresivo.

Ya sea que estés comenzando con "¡Hola!" o que estés listo para debatir filosofía en español, personalizaré cada clase para que coincida con tu nivel y tus sueños. Usaremos música, videos, artículos de noticias e información cultural para mantener las cosas dinámicas y divertidas. Además, aprenderás no solo el idioma, sino el corazón y el alma de las culturas hispanohablantes.

¿Listo para hablar español con confianza y estilo? ¡Vamos! Reserva tu clase de prueba y ¡comencemos juntos esta increíble aventura!

Recommended Pathway: 

Step 1: Letters & Sounds. 
Goal: Familiarize students with the major sounds in the English language. ✔️
Step 2: Basic Nouns Lessons. Subject-Pronouns. Object-Pronouns. Singular-Plural-Regular-Nouns.  
Goal: Basic understanding of pronouns and simple sentences. Exposure to a large number of nouns and their regular plurals. ✔️
Step 3: Beginner Listening Activities. 
Goal: Increased familiarity with basic sentence structure and parts of speech. ✔️
Step 4: The Verb To-Be. 
Goal: Expressing basic ideas and thoughts using the verb to be and familiarity with the contracted forms used in everyday spoken English. ✔️
Step 5: Simple Conversations. 
Goal: Confidence Boost. ✔️

This pathway is only meant to provide a starting point. It can and should be adapted for the unique needs of students as you progress through our lesson content. 
There is no minimum level required to take these lessons.

pro_course_detail.title: Basic Tagalog for all ages
pro_course_detail.description:
Whether you're visiting the Philippines for a holiday or a business trip, or you have ties to the large Tagalog-speaking community in many areas of the world, or you're simply a language enthusiast, I'll help you learn Tagalog (Filipino) on your own, fast and accurately.

For Beginners, we may have talks, cultural information, and activities in Tagalog.  We can conduct Tagalog for Beginners talks, cultural information, and exercises. You will be able to use Tagalog (Filipino) in a variety of everyday scenarios. I'll help you improve your communication skills in a variety of ways, from grocery shopping to asking directions, from telling time to expressing how you feel.

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate-Advanced Tagalog for all ages
pro_course_detail.description:
For those who already know or comprehend some basic Tagalog and want to improve their proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing standard Filipino, the Philippines' national language.
I'll show you some of the most typical grammar mistakes Tagalog learners make when speaking the language, as well as "real-life" discussions showcasing how Tagalog is used in the Philippines nowadays.


This class will teach you all of the fundamental abilities you'll need to speak Tagalog fluently:
pagsasalaysay (the capacity to tell a story—whether a news story, a folktale, or an anecdote); paglalarawan (the ability to describe people, locations, and feelings);
paglalahad (explaining anything, such as a custom or tradition or how to prepare a food);
as well as pangangatuwiran (reasoning and abstract thinking).

You'll be able to converse about yourself, your family, and your daily experiences in Intermediate-Advanced Tagalog utilizing grammatically accurate phrases and a native-speaker vocabulary.

pro_course_detail.title: Tagalog Free Conversation for all ages
pro_course_detail.description: Immerse yourself in a Tagalog-speaking environment daily. In this way, you can gradually improve your listening comprehension, vocabulary, pronunciation, sentence structure and grammar until you are finally fluent. We can talk anything under the sun!

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS/CELPIP/TOEFL/Cambridge Test
pro_course_detail.description:
This preparation program is designed for students aiming to succeed in internationally recognized English proficiency exams such as IELTS, CELPIP, TOEFL, and Cambridge Tests. The course focuses on two essential goals: strengthening your overall English ability and mastering the specific exam techniques required to achieve a higher score.

Through structured lessons, practice activities, and discussions on recent and relevant topics, you will:

Build confidence.

Develop strategies to meet the unique requirements of each exam format.

Enhance fluency, vocabulary, and accuracy for academic and real-life contexts.

Practice exam-style tasks with personalized feedback to refine your performance.

Whether your goal is academic admission, immigration, or professional certification, this course equips you with the skills and strategies to perform at your best. With guided support, you’ll be prepared not only to take the test—but to excel in it.

pro_course_detail.description:

✔️Supporting a point of view.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English

Here you can find a range of tasks to help you improve your interviewing skills, compose clear English emails, and learn about business subjects and challenges.

pro_course_detail.title: The Philippines Survival Guide: A Systematic & Cultural Crash Course for Travelers
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you heading to the Philippines and want to do more than just "get by"?
Whether you’re a total beginner who loves understanding the logic of a language or someone looking to refresh their conversational skills, this intensive course is designed to get you "island-ready" in record time!

What makes this course different?
We bridge the gap between systematic learning and authentic connection. I tailor every lesson to your specific travel itinerary, ensuring you have the right words for every destination on your map.

What we will cover:
• ⚙️ The Logic of Tagalog: We break down the language into easy-to-follow patterns—perfect for analytical learners who want to understand the "why" behind the phrases.

• 🚲 Navigating the Islands: Real-world practice for transportation (Jeeps, trikes, Grab), ordering at the palengke (market), and "survival" requests.

• 🤝 The Power of "Po": Master the essential etiquette and polite particles that win the hearts of locals and reflect the true spirit of Filipino hospitality.

• 🗣️ Interactive "Kwentuhan" (Small Talk): Move beyond basic greetings to simple, everyday conversations that allow you to truly connect with the people you meet.

Book a class now!

pro_course_detail.title: Tagalog Together
pro_course_detail.description: Discover Tagalog in a warm, interactive setting where each session blends practical conversation, cultural insights, and engaging activities that bring the language to life. Learners enjoy meaningful exchanges, motivate one another, and build confidence through shared practice. Whether for travel, family connection, or personal growth, this course provides a supportive environment that makes learning Tagalog both enjoyable and memorable.

All I'm saying is that I need you to use your 10 lessons within 10 weeks.

Well... there's the learning aspect of it, and my professional stability aspect. 

Learning aspect: I do firmly believe that you lose a lot when you miss weeks of practice. You lose things that you could have prevented losing. 

Professional stability: In order to do what I do, the way that I do, I need to have a somewhat regular income. 
-
Of course you can take breaks after your package is over.

pro_course_detail.description:
In this package you must commit to a once weekly program. You can definitely reschedule your lesson all you want to the same week. Or you might choose to have two lessons in the following week, and none in the current week.
All I'm saying is that I need you to use your 10 lessons within 10 weeks. 


Why?
Well... there's the learning aspect of it, and my professional stability aspect. 

Learning aspect: I do firmly believe that you lose a lot when you miss weeks of practice. You lose things that you could have prevented losing. 

Professional stability: In order to do what I do, the way that I do, I need to have a somewhat regular income. 
-
Of course you can take breaks after your package is over.

teacher_info.intro:
Hi! I’m Andrea 😊 I’m from Mexico and I’m a lifelong language learner who truly loves communication, culture, and human connection. I speak Spanish as my native language, English fluently, and I can also communicate in Chinese, so I understand very well what it feels like to learn a language.

I’ve been teaching Spanish for several years, and I’ve also been a student on italki myself, so I know what students usually look for in a lesson: clarity, patience, motivation, and real progress. 

Languages are not just grammar and vocabulary — they are people, culture, humor, emotions, and everyday life. That’s exactly what I try to bring into my lessons. 😸

pro_course_detail.title: Let's chat! 😸 Practica inglés conmigo☕️我们一起练习英语吧✨
pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to English Conversation Practice! ✨

This is your space to relax, talk freely, laugh a little, and actually enjoy speaking English. No pressure. No awkward silence. Just real conversation.

I’ll always bring fun, unexpected, and interesting topics — we will never run out of things to talk about. Every lesson, you’ll pick up new vocabulary, express bigger ideas, and improve your grammar naturally (without feeling like you’re “studying”).

You’ll be surprised how fast your confidence grows.
Let’s make English something you look forward to.😸

¡Bienvenido/a a la clase de conversación en inglés! ✨

Este es tu espacio para relajarte, hablar con libertad, reír un poco y realmente disfrutar el inglés. Sin presión. Sin silencios incómodos. Solo conversación real.

Siempre traeré temas divertidos, curiosos e inesperados — nunca nos quedaremos sin cosas de qué hablar. En cada clase aprenderás vocabulario nuevo, expresarás ideas más complejas y mejorarás tu gramática de forma natural (sin sentir que estás “estudiando”).

Te sorprenderá lo rápido que crecerá tu confianza.
Hagamos que el inglés sea algo que esperes con emoción.😸

欢迎参加英语会话练习！✨

这是一个属于你的空间，可以放松、自由表达、轻松聊天，真正享受说英语的感觉。没有压力，没有尴尬的沉默，只有自然真实的对话。

我会准备有趣、特别、甚至有点出乎意料的话题，我们永远不会没话题。每一节课你都会学到新词汇，用更丰富的表达方式说话，并在不知不觉中掌握语法。

你会惊讶自己的进步有多快。

让英语变成你期待的一件事。😸

pro_course_detail.title: Fun Spanish conversation lesson for kids ages 7 –15! 😸🌠🚀
pro_course_detail.description:
¡Hola! Tired of boring textbooks? Let's make Spanish FUN! 🎉

In this class, speaking Spanish feels like an adventure. Younger students learn through silly, imaginative stories filled with funny characters and unexpected situations. Even the shyest kids start speaking naturally as we laugh, act out scenes, and help the characters solve their problems.

For older kids, we explore fun and interesting conversation topics that make practicing Spanish exciting. We might talk about crazy inventions, dream vacations, favorite movies, or funny “what would you do if…” situations. Students get to share ideas, ask questions, and express their opinions in Spanish.

As we talk and play, students naturally learn lots of new words and useful expressions. Grammar is introduced in a simple and friendly way, so it feels easy and natural instead of confusing or boring!

My goal is to create a relaxed, encouraging space where kids feel confident, curious, and excited to speak Spanish. By the end of class, students won’t just be learning Spanish—they’ll be having fun using it! 🌟

¡Hola！觉得课本太无聊了吗？那我们来把西班牙语学得又好玩又有趣吧！🎉

小朋友会通过搞笑又有想象力的故事来练习西班牙语，一起演故事、一起帮角色解决问题，不知不觉就开口说西班牙语了。

大一点的学生会聊很多好玩的主题，比如奇怪的发明、梦想旅行、神秘生物，还有各种“如果……会怎么样？”的问题。大家可以分享想法、聊天、练习表达。

在聊天和活动中，学生会自然学到很多新词，语法也会变得简单又容易理解。 🌟

pro_course_detail.description: 本课程专为以中文为母语的英语初学者设计。在上课前，我会提前发送一些实用词汇给你；课堂中我们将围绕这些词汇进行轻松、有趣的对话练习，帮助你自然开口、逐步建立表达信心。课程氛围轻松友好，注重实用与互动，让你在愉快中稳步提升英语能力。😸

pro_course_detail.title: 🌞Summer Math Boost 🌞– Grades 1st to 7th🚀📖😎✨
pro_course_detail.description:
Math doesn’t have to feel stressful or repetitive! 😸 

This summer, we’ll review important math skills through games, puzzles, brain challenges, teamwork activities, and creative problem-solving designed to keep kids thinking, curious, and confident.

Each week introduces different kinds of activities so students stay engaged while practicing the skills they learned during the school year in a fun and relaxed environment.

🚀Week 1 — Math Detectives 🔍
We’ll solve mysteries, crack number codes, and play fast-paced math games while reviewing core math skills from the school year.
Activities may include:
✔️ mystery number challenges
✔️ mental math races
✔️ logic clues

🚀Week 2— Builders & Creators 🎨
A creative week full of shapes, design, visual puzzles, and hands-on activities.
Activities may include:
✔️tangrams
✔️ geometry art
✔️LEGO/building challenges
✔️symmetry games

🚀Week 3 — Math in Real Life 🛒
Kids use math in real-world situations through interactive activities and mini challenges.
Activities may include:
✔️ shopping & budgeting games
✔️cooking/math activities
✔️ measurement challenges
✔️real-life problem solving

🚀Week 4— Math Olympics & Final Challenges
The final week brings everything together with large group games, collaborative activities, and fun review challenges. Students have the opportunity to apply what they practiced throughout the program while celebrating their progress in a positive and supportive environment.
Activities may include:
✔️Math Olympics
✔️review games
✔️final creative projects

This is an example schedule to give an idea of the types of activities and skills we may work on throughout the program. 😸 Classes can be adjusted based on each student’s grade level, goals, and interests. Feel free to contact me for a more personalized schedule or to discuss your child’s specific needs and learning style. ✨

pro_course_detail.title: Mathematics practice with games! ➗
pro_course_detail.description:
Let’s make math fun! In this class, we’ll practice math by playing interactive online games together.

We’ll use games to review topics like multiplication, division, fractions, integers, exponents, and more. Students should already be familiar with these concepts from school—this class is designed to reinforce and review them in an enjoyable, low-pressure way.

As we solve problems, we’ll help a spaceship reach the next planet, guide an otter across the river, or help a puppy pull a string!

Perfect for students who want extra practice in a relaxed environment while building confidence through play.

--------
¡Hagamos que las matemáticas sean divertidas! En esta clase, practicaremos matemáticas jugando juntos juegos interactivos en línea. 😸

Usaremos juegos para repasar temas como multiplicación, división, fracciones, números enteros, exponentes y más. Los estudiantes ya deben estar familiarizados con estos conceptos de la escuela—esta clase está diseñada para reforzarlos y repasarlos de una manera divertida y sin presión.

Mientras resolvemos problemas, ayudaremos a una nave espacial a llegar al siguiente planeta, guiaremos a una nutria a cruzar el río o ayudaremos a un perrito a tirar de una cuerda.

Perfecto para estudiantes que quieren práctica extra en un ambiente relajado, mientras construyen confianza a través del juego. ✨

pro_course_detail.title: 📚✨ Reading/Writing in Spanish — Personalized Texts & Word Games ✨📚🇲🇽
pro_course_detail.description:
Whether you are interested in 👽 aliens, 🌊 strange deep-sea creatures, 🛸 conspiracy theories, 🏚️ abandoned places, 📰 world news, 🐉 dragons, 🧠 psychology, 🚀 space, 🚢 ships, 🔍 true crime, 📖 bizarre history, or even everyday life topics ☕🍕, we can improve reading comprehension through personalized Spanish texts adapted to your level ✨🇲🇽

Classes include:

📖 Reading short and increasingly complex texts together

💡 Learning vocabulary naturally through context

🎮 Word games, ✏️ fill-in-the-blank activities, and 🧩 comprehension challenges

🔎 Identifying useful grammar patterns while reading

🗣️ Practicing pronunciation and fluency aloud

📈 Slowly building confidence with longer and more advanced texts

✍️ Writing our own short stories, news articles, or creative texts together

🌟 The goal is to make reading feel interesting, fun, and manageable while expanding vocabulary, improving comprehension speed, and understand authentic Spanish 🇲🇽💬✨

teacher_info.about_teacher: I have worked as a Chinese speaking teaching assistant and general teaching assistant in an international school in Thailand. My role was to help provide well structured lessons to children and explore academia through the English language. I used a variety of methods such as worksheets, presentations and one to one oral lessons. This has allowed me to fully understand how students respond to different teaching methods and how using different languages whilst teaching helps their understanding of the English language.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My lessons will be structured in a way that focus on your oral and comprehension ability. We will generally pre-discuss topics that you are interested in then we will read a short text about your area of interest, we will then discuss new vocabulary, tenses, sentences structures and that appear in them and consolidate them. Then we will use your new learnt skills to have a free flowing conversation regarding the topic. 

我的课程将重点提升你的英语口语和阅读能力，帮助你建立清晰、自信地用英语表达自己的能力。
在上课前，我们会选择你感兴趣的话题。上课的时候，我们会先阅读一篇与该话题相关的文章，我会帮助你理解新的词汇、句子结构和英语时态。在充分理解内容之后，我们将进行自由交流练习，尝试运用刚刚学到的知识进行表达。

这些课程适合任何想要找老师练习英语口语的人！我会帮助你提高语法、发音以及整体表达能力！

pro_course_detail.description: This type of lesson is based on a course book according to your level and preferences. I'll help you to build and develop all language skills (speaking, listening, reading and writing), improve your pronunciation, enlarge your vocabulary and learn grammar.  We'll use various sources and games in the lessons for them to be more authentic and engaging. I prefer giving HW for better results in studying. See you in my class!

pro_course_detail.title: English lessons (A1-B2) Structured lessons with a course book
pro_course_detail.description:
This type of lesson is based on a modern coursebook depending on your level and preferences (for example, Speakout, Outcomes, Solutions for teens). We study together grammar topics, vocabulary, practise speaking and listening, pay attention to spelling. I prepare for my student additional tasks and games to review our grammar and vocabulary topics. I prefer giving home tasks to my students.

See you in my class!

pro_course_detail.title: Russian (B1-C1) - special course for literature, music, art enthusiasts
pro_course_detail.description:
Here's my special course for literature, music, art enthusiasts!

Being a big fan of Russian culture I use materials in my classes designed by me based on different internet and books sources. We'll study new words and expressions, a bit of grammar and discuss interesting and thought-provoking topics of literature, music, art, biographies of famous people. 

My popular topics and materials: biography and works of
- Lev Tolstoy
- Fyodor Dostoevsky 
- Mikhail Bulgakov
- Ilya Repin
- Pyotr Tchaikovsky 

and many other monumental figures of Russian culture.

You can pick a figure you'd like to study and discuss from my list of names above or suggest to me your favorite figure/figures. If you have any questions or suggestions for our lesson plan, please, give me a message. 

Looking forward to meeting you in my class!

pro_course_detail.title: Russian (B1-C1) - special course for artists and art lovers
pro_course_detail.description:
Here's my special course for artists and art lovers! 

Being an art lover and a devoted self-taught artist myself, I invite you to my special course. Using my own materials based on different sources we'll study new words and expressions, a bit of grammar and discuss interesting topics of fine art, such as fine art styles, art studio equipment, biographies of famous artists and other topics. You'll learn how to describe famous paintings using a plan. 
There are several parts of materials we are going to complete in about 10 lessons based on you skills and preferences. 
I'll send my students 3 parts of materials on art topics with vocabulary and tasks, 2-3 files with the most famous Russian paintings to practice how to describe them and 2 biographies of famous artists for us to study and discuss. We usually take biographies of a pioneer of French impressionism - painter Claude Monet and famous Russian realist painter Ilya Repin) 

Looking forward to meeting you in my class!

pro_course_detail.title: Russian - speaking classes (A1 - C1)
pro_course_detail.description:
In this class we'll speak about general topics, like hobbies, countries, lifestyles, jobs and other topics of our choice. I don't prepare for this class. For structured, fundamental classes book another type of class, please.

If you have any questions, please, let me know.

See you in my class!

teacher_info.intro: Certified hyperpolyglot with fluency in 8+ languages, specializing in English, Spanish, and Balkan languages (Serbian/Croatian/Bosnian). With over 5,000 hours of teaching experience, I combine structured grammar instruction with cultural immersion—incorporating Montenegrin wit, Italian expressiveness, and interdisciplinary tools like film, sports, and technology. My methodology prioritizes conversational fluency for real-world applications, whether for travel, professional settings, or casual communication.
teacher_info.short_signature: Certified language teacher and a hyperpolyglot and with 5000+ hours of experience in teaching
teacher_info.introduction: First, I’m a professional language teacher. I have a TEFL/TESOL certificate, I have a certificate that guarantees I am able to prepare others for English exams  and I also have a certificate from the Institute Cervantes for advanced level.  I’ve been working on this website as a professional teacher for 1 year and six months (and I’ve been also working as an informal tutor for two years). Second, I’ve been working as a Serbian language expert for three years and three months: I created Serbian lessons and taught foreign people my native language. Third, I’ve been a translator for one year and six months: I translated English and Spanish lessons to Serbian. Also, I translated the synopses of the movies from English to Serbian. Finally, I'm a language expert who speaks many languages. I correct English, Spanish and Italian exercises, and I explain all grammar rules so that they can be understood by other people. My lessons are very creative, interesting and fun. I am going to teach you how to read, speak and write step by step. When you finish my Serbian classes, you're going to be ready to speak in Serbian without any problem in all kinds of situations. All materials that I have are going to be at your disposal. You can download them, and they can serve as an aid in your studies. Also, I'm going to give you various types of exercises so you can improve your language skills. Why should you choose me? The Serbian phrase is: “The more you know - the more you're worth”. Also, Serbian is spoken in all parts of ex-Yugoslavia (Serbia, Montenegro, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia ...), in some parts of Greece, Bulgaria, etc. If you decide to travel, it is going to be convenient for you. Please try my introductory 30-minute lesson. Additionally, during the introductory lesson, I'm going to assess your level of knowledge so I can personalize lessons to suit your personal needs. I´m looking forward to working with you! I wish you all the best.
teacher_info.about_me: Certified hyperpolyglot with fluency in 8+ languages, specializing in English, Spanish, and Balkan languages (Serbian/Croatian/Bosnian). With over 5,000 hours of teaching experience, I combine structured grammar instruction with cultural immersion—incorporating Montenegrin wit, Italian expressiveness, and interdisciplinary tools like film, sports, and technology. My methodology prioritizes conversational fluency for real-world applications, whether for travel, professional settings, or casual communication.
teacher_info.about_teacher: I believe language learning should be both enjoyable and effective. Book a trial lesson and let’s build a personalized plan that fits your goals and learning style! We'll work on reading, writing, speaking, grammar, and listening using a variety of resources. Whether you're starting from scratch or aiming to refine your skills, I’m here to guide you. I also teach English, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Serbian, Bosnian, Croatian, and Montenegrin.
teacher_info.teaching_style: Hi! I’m Suzana, a certified online language teacher with over 10 years of experience. I love teaching because it’s dynamic, creative, and a great way to connect cultures. Each lesson is personalized to your level, goals, and interests. I assess speaking and writing, take notes, and adapt lessons to help you improve steadily. We can cover grammar, conversation, travel, culture, or business topics. When working with children, I use interactive tools to make learning fun and effective. Let’s enjoy this journey together!
teacher_info.cancel_policy:
Dear students, 
if you realize you can not attend the lesson, please, feel free to let me know and to reschedule it (just in time). If you want to reschedule, you will have to leave some space (at least 24 hours so you can  do it). 
If you do not appear + I receive no information from you = I shall claim my money (because italki confirms the lessons after 2 days). 
On the other hand, if something urgent has just happened to you and you left me a message (where you explained why you could not attend the lesson), then we can discuss when it is going to be convenient to you so we can do our lesson. 
Thank you for your attention.
