teacher_info.intro:
Hi! 👋🤓 I'm James, an English teacher from London, England.

Classes should have two key qualities: 
1️⃣ Be interesting!
2️⃣ Be productive.

So, I focus every lesson around your goals. I use a systematic approach to get you from A to B. You will find my lessons interesting and efficient in helping you get to where you want to go.

I love reading 📚, walking Stan the Dog 🐶, researching health and fitness👨‍⚕️and discussing EXCITING topics. 😄

I graduated in Politics, Psychology, Sociology, and International Relations, and love talking about science, technology, medicine, and am reading about philosophy just now. Oh, and I love travel. 

I can't wait to learn about you! ☺️
teacher_info.short_signature: CAMBRIDGE graduate 👨‍🏫 IELTS expert 📝 HEALTHCARE enthusiast! 👨‍⚕️ LET'S MAKE PROGRESS! 🤓🚀
teacher_info.introduction: Hello and welcome! My name is James. I'm an English teacher and a UK (London) native, with a clear accent. I have taught thousands of students for over 8 years and have experience teaching in schools throughout Europe and in Vietnam. I'm CELTA qualified, with thousands of hours of experience teaching on Skype and in school. I have been teaching since receiving a BA from the University of Cambridge. I can help in a number of ways. For general English some students prefer to use a textbook, which I can provide. This can help students to gain a strong foundation in English. Other students may wish to use 'real life' materials and to focus on practice. For these students we use media, presentation and conversation as the main structure of the lesson. I also love using academic texts and reading literature, philosophy, history, psychology, politics etc. If these topics interest you I would be happy to read and discuss them with you in class. I also provide a service to support students with their academic English. I can help you write essays, proposals etc. for your studies. I have helped in many academic contexts, including helping students prepare applications, essays, theses etc. at BA / MA / PhD / Professorship level at Cambridge, Yale, Harvard, Stanford, Brown, UCL, KCL and so on. This academic support service can help support students with their academic work in an English language environment. I am also happy to help students who wish to improve their business English. In this instance I can offer a full curriculum at all levels to help your business English in general. Alternatively, if you have a specific request I am happy to help with that. From a South American doctor who urgently needed to communicate with her English speaking colleagues, to an Italian lawyer who needed a precise understanding of legal English, or the countless students I have coached for job interviews, I am always happy to help. Thank you for reading my introduction and...see you in class!

teacher_info.cancel_policy:
Feel free to reschedule classes wherever possible using the iTalki scheduling system. 

Once a lesson is booked and there are less than 24 hrs until the class starts the time belongs to you. No other students can book and the teacher will wait for you for the entire time before he is free to start the next class or leave the office.

From time to time, daily or work activities can get in the way of your appointments. Unfortunately, the teacher cannot be responsible for this and would kindly ask that you confirm the lesson as complete.

If you have experienced family bereavement, hospitalisation or other emergency, please contact me as you may be eligible for a refund of credits.

course_info.trial_description:
Welcome to my Trial Lesson! 🌟  

This is a personalized session where we’ll get to know each other and explore your language-learning goals. During the trial, we’ll:  

- Discuss your current level and learning objectives.  
- Identify the best methods and resources to help you succeed.  
- Have a short, fun activity or conversation to get started right away!  

The trial lesson is a great opportunity to see if my teaching style matches your needs. I look forward to helping you on your language-learning journey!

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice (free speaking, chatting, informal)
pro_course_detail.description:
Let’s chat! 🥳 We’ll dive into fun, relaxed discussions about topics you love—perfect for boosting your fluency naturally. 🌟

We’ll keep things chill, with natural conversation. Together, we’ll watch your fluency skyrocket! 🚀

Why not book a lesson now? Let’s get started! 😊

Please note:
- This is not for reviewing academic essays, CVs, exam preparation, or formal study.
- If I don't understand something you say during the class, I will let you know. 
- For a lesson with feedback on: pronunciation, grammar, vocabulary, your good use of English, suggested phrases and new language, follow-up homework, targeted lessons, textbook chapters for improvement, and more, please choose a General English class.
- According to italki policy, lessons may be 55 minutes to allow a 5 minute changeover time between students.
- In order to work within the platform algorithm, prices may change over time.

pro_course_detail.title: Academic Support
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are to support students who are undertaking academic work (Bachelor's, Master's, PhD, etc.). 

The classes can be used to support you in a specific project, such as writing a thesis, or to develop your academic English generally. Usually students who undertake these classes with me require help in the researching, structuring and writing extended academic texts in English. 

Examples of academic help I have worked on before are Ma theses, university applications and supporting students in the preparation of academic research papers for publication. Student's have requested this help for universities such as Cambridge, Harvard, University of London, Yale and Brown. 

Subjects supported are usually in the humanities, such as Politics, Philosophy, English Literature, History, Sociology and Media. Please send me a message to find out if these lessons are appropriate for you.

pro_course_detail.title: General English (professional, formal classes)
pro_course_detail.description:
This course will teach you English for General Purposes, such as living or travelling in an English-speaking country, or interacting with others at a high level. 🌎🤝

The class offers:

⭐️ A speaking focus. 
⭐️ Constant, detailed corrections in a correction document (pronunciation, vocabulary and grammar, good usages, and suggested new language).
⭐️ Vocab and grammar homework for those who want it! Of course we can cover everything in class if you prefer.
⭐️ Reading and listening homework, based on topics you love. 
⭐️ Diagnostic testing to measure your progress and set learning goals.

This is a professional, goal-driven, learning experience, designed to take your English to the next level as fast as possible. 🎯

Send me a message if you would like more information, or book a class now and let's get started! 👨‍🏫 See you soon!

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Test Preparation - Achieve Your Target Band! 🎯
pro_course_detail.description:
Achieve your dream IELTS score with expert help! As a former IELTS trainer at IDP with years of experience and tens of thousands of online students who followed my methods to improve their IELTS, I know what it takes to succeed.

Here’s what you’ll get:
✨ Tailored practice for Speaking, Listening, Reading, and Writing based on your needs.
✨ Detailed feedback on your speaking and writing to sharpen fluency, grammar, and coherence.
✨ Proven strategies to handle tricky questions and manage time effectively.
✨ Extensive, detailed homework to reinforce your learning between lessons.
✨ Practice exams and exam feedback

Every session is fully customized to your goals, whether you’re aiming for academic or general training. With focused test prep and personalized support, you’ll gain the skills and confidence to excel.

Let’s get you that score! Book a session today and start your journey to success. 🚀

teacher_info.intro: Hello! I’m Margarita—Margi for short. I'm originally from Belarus but now live in Cyprus. 學生將學習與日常生活相關的詞彙，例如：學校、興趣愛好、食物、旅行、天氣和休閒活動。課程幫助學生建立通過 Cambridge English: A2 Key for Schools 考試所需的詞彙基礎。

🗣️ 口語與交流能力

學生將練習回答問題、描述圖片以及進行簡短對話，例如：

談論興趣與日常生活

描述人物與地點

提問與回答簡單問題

表達喜好與觀點

幫助學生準備 KET 口語考試。

🎧 聽力與理解能力

學生透過對話、公告和日常情境練習理解英語。

活動包括：

聆聽關鍵資訊

理解指示

辨識短對話中的細節

✏️ 閱讀與寫作能力

學生學習閱讀短篇文章並撰寫簡單的訊息和電子郵件。

技能包括：

理解標誌與通知

配對文章中的資訊

撰寫簡短電子郵件（25–35字）

完成句子與表格

🎯 考試技巧與練習

學生將熟悉 KET 考試結構，並使用 Trainer 教材進行真題練習，包括：

閱讀與寫作考試題型

聽力練習

口語模擬考試

完整模擬測試

🎲 互動式學習活動

透過有趣的互動活動幫助學生建立英語自信，例如：

口語遊戲與角色扮演

圖片描述挑戰

詞彙競賽

小組討論

學生在輕鬆有趣的學習環境中提升英語能力並準備考試。

teacher_info.intro:
Hey language lovers! I'm a certified TESL teacher fluent in English, Tamil, Malay, and Indonesian. I'm also a language learner myself, currently tackling Mandarin and Korean. I love to travel and connect with people from different cultures. Let's learn and have fun together!

嗨，大家好！ 我是经过认证的TESL老师。
 
我精通多种语言，包括英文、泰米尔文、马来文和印度尼西亚文，目前正在学习中文和韩文。我喜欢学习新语言并结识新朋友。这也是我也喜欢旅行的原因之一！

안녕하세요 저는 공인된 TESL 선생님입니다.

저는 영어, 타밀, 말레이어, 인도네시아어를 다국어로 구사하고 있으며, 새로운 언어를 배우고 새로운 사람들을 만나는 것을 좋아하기 때문에 현재 만다린어와 한국어를 배우고 있습니다. 이것이 저 또한 여행을 좋아하는 이유 중 하나입니다!
teacher_info.short_signature: ESL Certified 10 Years of Experience in Teaching Online
teacher_info.introduction: ABOUT ME -Hi everyone! I’m Yuwanes. I have a Degree in TESL. I have been teaching English and Malay to students and adults from beginners to advance level from around the globe. -I am a multi-lingual speaker of English, Tamil and Malay, and now learning Mandarin, Korean and Japanese as I find learning new languages fascinating. -Being raised in a multi-cultural society allows me to understand the cultural differences and learner’s needs for learning a new language. TEACHING STYLE -I focus on conversations as I believe that conversing is the most efficient way to learn a new language. -We can discuss any topic you like. Through this, I hope to expand your vocabulary, idioms, phrasal verbs and more. If there are any mistakes made such as pronunciation, grammar, word usage, etc, I will help to correct your mistakes. -Depending on your level and interest, I use various teaching resources such as videos and article to aid better listening and speaking. -For advanced speakers, I like to discuss topics that challenge learners. -You can have writing homework so we could discuss & analyze them -I am friendly, patient, and easy going who can talk about anything and quite versatile towards your learning needs and style. ENGLISH -I can help with both British English and American English from beginner to advanced learners from ages 8 and above. *If you are interested, I can also teach you English creole-based language, MANGLISH, and SINGLISH which is widely spoken in Malaysia and Singapore respectively. MALAY - Formal Malay is very different than informal Malay that native speakers use. -I teach both formal and colloquial Malay, including Malay for travelling from beginner to advanced learners. -For beginners, you will learn to read Malay in just one lesson. We will then continue with the basics of the language, where I will explain the usage and grammar. -For intermediate & advanced learners, let’s have conversations just like the native speakers! -I hope to see you soon!

Growing up in a multicultural society taught me the value of diversity, and as a language teacher, I'll use my experience to help you connect with new cultures. I'm a fun and easy-going person who can adapt to your learning needs and style. Let's learn together!

我从小在多元文化社会中长大，这使我能够了解文化差异，也能更好地理解学习者在学习新语言时的需求。
 
我是一个友好、耐心且随和的人，可以跟您谈论任何事情，并且可以根据您的学习需求和风格进行灵活调整。

다문화 사회에서 자라면서 문화적 차이를 이해할 수 있고 새로운 언어를 배우려는 학습자의 필요를 더 잘 이해할 수 있습니다.

저는 친절하고, 인내심이 많고, 여러분의 학습 요구와 스타일에 대해 어떤 것도 말할 수 있고, 꽤 다재다능할 수 있는 사람입니다.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I'm all about helping you speak like a native, but don't worry - I've got you covered in all aspects of the language! Grammar, writing, vocabulary, and pronunciation - I can teach it all.

And get this - my teaching materials are totally tailored to you! I'll whip up some awesome customized materials based on your level and needs. Let's get started!

我认为对话是学习语言的最有效方法。通过这种方式，我希望扩大您的词汇量、成语、短语动词等。

我们也可以讨论语言的其他方面，如语法、写作、词汇和发音。

-将提供材料和作业。

저는 대화를 하는 것이 언어를 배우는 가장 효율적인 방법이라고 믿습니다. 이를 통해 어휘, 숙어, 표현 동사 등을 넓히고 싶습니다. 
 
하지만, 우리는 문법, 글쓰기, 어휘, 발음과 같은 언어의 다른 측면에 대해 논의할 수 있습니다.

- 자료와 숙제를 제공합니다.

pro_course_detail.title: Reading and pronunciation
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is perfect for students who want to strengthen their pronunciation and reading skills. Together, we’ll read through an article, and I’ll guide you on how to pronounce each word clearly and accurately. This approach helps refine your accent and also ensures you grasp the meaning of any new or challenging words.

After we finish reading, we’ll discuss the topics covered in the article, giving you a chance to ask questions and clarify anything you might not fully understand. This discussion will deepen your comprehension and help you feel confident with the new vocabulary. Step by step, you’ll find reading in English becomes smoother, and your pronunciation will continue to improve with each session.

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar and Sentence Structure
pro_course_detail.description:
In these grammar and sentence structure lessons, we’ll focus on identifying and strengthening your specific areas for improvement. At the start, you can share any challenges you have, like punctuation, verb tenses, or sentence clarity. Based on this, I’ll tailor our lessons to address these needs through engaging, practical exercises.

Each lesson will break down the rules of grammar in a simple way, using relatable, everyday examples to show how these rules apply in real life. For example, we might use examples of texting conversations to highlight common sentence structure mistakes, or create sentences about favourite hobbies or daily routines to practice correct verb tenses.

By connecting grammar to familiar contexts, you will see how clear communication improves your writing and speaking skills. These lessons will help you develop confidence in using grammar accurately, making your communication smoother and more effective.

course_info.trial_description:
🌟 Join the experimental class  with a CELTA-Trained Tutor! 🌟

Are you excited to learn English in a fun and interactive way? In my experimental class, I will create a unique experience just for you! As a CELTA-trained tutor, I focus on your interests while making learning feel enjoyable.

What to Expect:

🎮 Gamified Learning: Experience English through games and challenges that match your hobbies and interests. Learning will feel like playtime!

🔍 Personalized Content: I will tailor activities specifically for you, making lessons enjoyable and relevant to your life.

🌐 Cultural Exploration: Discover new cultures while sharing your own. We’ll learn together!

📈 Skill Development: Improve your speaking, listening, reading, and writing skills in a fun way. You’ll gain confidence as you play and learn.

✨ Supportive Environment: Join a friendly space where you can feel comfortable and motivated. I’m here to help you succeed!

📰 Access to International Materials for Free: You’ll have access to high-quality resources from National Geographic Learning, Oxford University, and Pearson during our classes. While our lessons are tailored to your interests, you’ll be using renowned materials that are recognized worldwide!

Methodology Overview:

In our class, I’ll use innovative methodologies tailored to your learning profile:

Project-Based Learning (PBL): Work on real-life projects that interest you, encouraging collaboration and problem-solving while practicing English in a meaningful context.

Engage-Study-Activate (ESA): Enjoy a dynamic approach that starts with fun activities, followed by focused language study, and ends with real-life practice to reinforce what you’ve learned.

Bilingualism: Embrace your native language alongside English to enhance understanding and boost your confidence.

Whether you’re a beginner or advanced and want to improve, my gamified classes are perfect for you. Let’s make learning English an exciting adventure together—sign up today!

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Skills with Real-Time Feedback |  Engaging Class
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you ready to boost your English speaking skills with consistent, personalized feedback in a dynamic and interactive environment?

What makes my classes different?
You receive structured, real-time and post-production feedback with clear correction on vocabulary, pronunciation, and grammar, so you always know exactly how to improve.

In my conversation-focused ESL classes, you won’t just talk, you’ll improve with purpose. Each lesson is built around engaging discussions, practical tasks, and interactive activities designed to build fluency and confidence.

Learning should be effective and enjoyable. That’s why I combine high-energy interaction with targeted feedback to help you speak more naturally, accurately, and confidently.
